lines.en: The rope is in my chest. The winch is on the landing. The rest is hands.
lines.zh: 绳子在我箱子里，绞盘在码头上。剩下的就看你的手了。

lines.en: Thirty-one years I've kept this crossing. I know every snag between here and the narrows.
lines.zh: 这个渡口我守了三十一年。从这儿到窄口，水底下哪里有暗桩，我都知道。

lines.en: Aldo built that winch. Built the raft too. The river took him the spring after. I stayed.
lines.zh: 那个绞盘是阿尔多造的，筏子也是他造的。第二年开春，河把他带走了。我留了下来。

lines.en: Aldo and Joss built the footbridge, twenty years back. A rider in white took it apart in one night, and laid the nails on my pier.
lines.zh: 那座小桥是阿尔多和乔斯二十年前一起搭的。有个白衣骑手，一夜之间就把它拆了，还把钉子一根根摆在我的码头上。

lines.en: That tree at the narrows has been dead ten years. Aldo always said it would fall the wrong way.
lines.zh: 窄口那棵树枯了十年了。阿尔多一直说，它倒的时候会往不该倒的那边倒。

text.en: The river is loud in spring, with the snowmelt. By autumn you can hear the fish jump.
text.zh: 开春化雪，河水响得很。到了秋天，静得能听见鱼跳。

text.en: Rope wants oiling before the cold, or it stiffens. I do mine every autumn. Aldo showed me how.
text.zh: 天冷以前，绳子得上一遍油，不然会发硬。我每年秋天都上。是阿尔多教我的。

text.en: Aldo used to bring me {favourite} from the far bank. I haven't had it since. If you have some, I won't say no.
text.zh: 阿尔多以前常从对岸给我带{favourite}。他走了以后，我就再没有过。你要是有，我不推辞。

text.en: …{item}. Aldo used to— Thank you.
text.zh: ……{item}。阿尔多以前也——谢谢你。

text.en: The storm took the ferry rope in the night. Nobody crosses till it's mended. … There's a spare in my chest. My hands won't splice it any more. Yours might.
text.zh: 夜里起风暴，把渡绳扯断了。绳子不接上，谁也过不了河。……我箱子里有一根备用的。我这双手接不了绳了，你的手也许行。

text.en: The rope is in my chest. The winch is on the landing. The rest is hands.
text.zh: 绳子在我箱子里，绞盘在码头上。剩下的就看你的手了。

text.en: Thirty-one years I've kept this crossing. I know every snag between here and the narrows.
text.zh: 这个渡口我守了三十一年。从这儿到窄口，水底下哪里有暗桩，我都知道。

text.en: Aldo built that winch. Built the raft too. The river took him the spring after. I stayed.
text.zh: 那个绞盘是阿尔多造的，筏子也是他造的。第二年开春，河把他带走了。我留了下来。

text.en: Aldo and Joss built the footbridge, twenty years back. A rider in white took it apart in one night, and laid the nails on my pier.
text.zh: 那座小桥是阿尔多和乔斯二十年前一起搭的。有个白衣骑手，一夜之间就把它拆了，还把钉子一根根摆在我的码头上。

text.en: The evenings come sooner every week. I light the lamp earlier and earlier.
text.zh: 天黑得一个礼拜比一个礼拜早。我点灯也一回比一回早。

text.en: The rider is down? ...Then I'll build the bridge again. Properly, this time.
text.zh: 那个骑手倒了？……那我就把桥再修起来。这回要修结实些。

text.en: That tree at the narrows has been dead ten years. Aldo always said it would fall the wrong way.
text.zh: 窄口那棵树枯了十年了。阿尔多一直说，它倒的时候会往不该倒的那边倒。

text.en: Water is high. It will be high all day.
text.zh: 水涨了。今天一整天都会这么高。

text.en: Keep near the fire after dark. Things come up out of the hollow.
text.zh: 天黑以后待在火边。会有东西从洞里爬出来。

text.en: … Go to sleep.
text.zh: ……去睡吧。

text.en: Get under something. Lightning likes that dead tree.
text.zh: 找个地方躲一躲。闪电专劈那棵枯树。

text.en: Rain. Nothing will catch fire today, at least. My knees don't like it.
text.zh: 下雨了。今天起码烧不起火来。就是膝盖受罪。

text.en: The line holds. When you are ready, say so, and I will take you over.
text.zh: 绳子吃住劲了。你准备好了就说一声，我送你过河。

text.en: Well. Aldo was wrong. It fell the right way after all.
text.zh: 哼。阿尔多说错了，它到底还是往对的那边倒了。

text.en: Tobin gave you something off that cart? He must have been very hungry. He doesn't give things away.
text.zh: 托宾从车上拿东西给你了？那他是真饿坏了。他那个人，平常什么都舍不得给。

text.en: I saw that. Put it back when you are done with it.
text.zh: 我看见了。用完了放回去。

text.en: Good hands. Better than mine now.
text.zh: 手巧。比我现在强。

text.en: Eat it yourself. … Fine. Thank you.
text.zh: 你自己吃吧。……好吧，谢谢。

text.en: Not to me. To the winch.
text.zh: 别给我。给绞盘。

text.en: What would I do with that?
text.zh: 我要这个干什么？

lines.en: I'd trade the whole cart for a hot meal. Well — not the whole cart. Most of it.
lines.zh: 为了一顿热饭，我愿意拿整车货来换。嗯——也不是整车。大半车吧。

lines.en: That blue wand? Frost from the tip. Freezes a puddle solid. A river, I would not know — never tried.
lines.zh: 那根蓝魔杖？杖尖冒寒气，能把水洼冻得结结实实。河嘛，我不知道——没试过。

lines.en: Hesper says I still owe her last autumn's fare. I told her we'd settle up once the ferry's running again. She just glared at me.
lines.zh: 赫斯珀说我还欠她去年秋天的船钱。我跟她说，等渡船修好了再算。她瞪了我一眼，一句话也没说。

lines.en: Lamp oil, one flask. It burns hot and fast, and spilt on the ground it's slick as ice. Be careful with it. Last time I set my own sleeve alight.
lines.zh: 这是灯油，一瓶。烧起来又旺又猛，洒在地上滑得站不住人。用的时候小心点。我上回就把自己的袖子给点着了。

lines.en: I sold a frost charm to a man in grey last winter. Paid in old coin — no king on it. Never seen coin like it. Kept one for luck.
lines.zh: 去年冬天我卖了个寒霜护符给一个穿灰衣服的人。他用旧钱币付的——上面没有国王的头像。那样的钱我从没见过。留了一枚图个吉利。

ties.npc.hesper: the ferrykeeper he owes a fare

text.en: Every charm on this cart, I can tell you where it came from. This bell I had off an old nun on the coast road, and that red cord — no, wait, don't go, I haven't got to the good part yet.
text.zh: 这车上的护符，每一个我都能给你讲出来历。这个铃铛是在海边那条路上跟一位老修女换的，那根红绳嘛——哎，你别走啊，最好听的还没讲到呢。

text.en: Where am I from? I usually give three places, depending on the day. One of them is even right.
text.zh: 问我是哪儿人？我一般说三个地方，看那天的心情。其中有一个还真是对的。

text.en: They say the dragon's dead and the road to Emberfall is open again! At last there's somewhere to sell what's on this cart. When I've some coin, I'll buy you a drink — I mean it.
text.zh: 听说龙死了，去余烬镇的路又通了！我车上这些东西总算有地方卖了。等我手头有了钱，一定请你喝一杯——说真的。

text.en: You crossed Vesper Ford! Then the road east is yours to try. Bring me back something strange.
text.zh: 你过了晚祷渡！那东边的路就归你闯了。回来时给我带点稀奇东西。

text.en: Welcome to Firstlight Village! Tobin, of the eastern road. Charms, oils, oddments — the ferry is still broken, so I brought the cart here. You wouldn't have anything to eat?
text.zh: 欢迎来初原村！我叫托宾，跑东边那条路的。护符、灯油、杂货都有——渡船还没修好，我就把货车拉到这儿来了。你身上没带点吃的吧？

text.en: I'd trade the whole cart for a hot meal. Well — not the whole cart. Most of it.
text.zh: 为了一顿热饭，我愿意拿整车货来换。嗯——也不是整车。大半车吧。

text.en: That blue wand? Frost from the tip. Freezes a puddle solid. A river, I would not know — never tried.
text.zh: 那根蓝魔杖？杖尖冒寒气，能把水洼冻得结结实实。河嘛，我不知道——没试过。

text.en: Hesper says I still owe her last autumn's fare. I told her we'd settle up once the ferry's running again. She just glared at me.
text.zh: 赫斯珀说我还欠她去年秋天的船钱。我跟她说，等渡船修好了再算。她瞪了我一眼，一句话也没说。

text.en: Lamp oil, one flask. It burns hot and fast, and spilt on the ground it's slick as ice. Be careful with it. Last time I set my own sleeve alight.
text.zh: 这是灯油，一瓶。烧起来又旺又猛，洒在地上滑得站不住人。用的时候小心点。我上回就把自己的袖子给点着了。

text.en: I sold a frost charm to a man in grey last winter. Paid in old coin — no king on it. Never seen coin like it. Kept one for luck.
text.zh: 去年冬天我卖了个寒霜护符给一个穿灰衣服的人。他用旧钱币付的——上面没有国王的头像。那样的钱我从没见过。留了一枚图个吉利。

text.en: The man in grey? The frost charm! That is how he crossed — oh, Hesper will never forgive me for that one.
text.zh: 那个灰衣人？寒霜护符！他就是靠那个过的河——哎呀，这件事赫斯珀永远不会原谅我了。

text.en: The village fire is warm. Better than sleeping by the hollow at Vesper Ford with one eye open.
text.zh: 村里的火真暖和。总比在晚祷渡那个坑边上睡觉强，那边还得睁着一只眼睛。

text.en: Shh. Did you hear that? … Probably nothing. Probably.
text.zh: 嘘。你听见了吗？……大概没什么。大概。

text.en: Not under the tree! Never under the tree in a storm. My uncle — well. Never mind my uncle.
text.zh: 别站树底下！打雷的时候千万别站树底下。我叔叔他——算了，别提我叔叔了。

text.en: Rain on the charms. The little bells rust if they get damp — I'd better cover them.
text.zh: 下雨了，护符都淋湿了。那些小铃铛一受潮就生锈，我得赶紧盖上。

text.en: Go on, take the wand off the cart. A deal is a deal, and that bread was a very good deal.
text.zh: 去吧，把魔杖从车上拿走。说好的就是说好的，那块面包可太划算了。

text.en: The line is mended? Then Hesper will take you — and maybe me, if I promise to pay. Again.
text.zh: 渡绳接上了？那赫斯珀会送你过去——说不定也肯送我，只要我再保证一次会付钱。

text.en: You felled the dead tree! Across the river! I'll be telling that one in every inn from here to the coast.
text.zh: 你把枯树砍倒了！正好横在河上！这件事我要从这儿一路讲到海边，每家客栈都讲一遍。

text.en: I saw that. I'm a peddler — I always see that.
text.zh: 我看见了。我是货郎——这种事我总能看见。

text.en: Oh — oh, thank you. Two days. Two whole days.
text.zh: 哦——哦，谢谢你。两天了。整整两天了。

text.en: For me? I'll find a buyer for it somewhere. I always do.
text.zh: 给我的？我总能给它找到买主。一向如此。

lines.en: Every house keeps two full buckets at the door, day and night. When the dragon's fire comes down, there is no time to run to the well.
lines.zh: 镇上每家门口都要摆两桶水，白天黑夜都不许空着。龙火落下来的时候，再跑去井边就来不及了。

lines.en: The dragon nests up on Cinder Peak. We used to go up there for wood and to graze the sheep. Nobody goes that way now.
lines.zh: 那条龙的巢在烬峰上。以前我们上山砍柴、放羊，现在没人敢往那边走了。

ties.npc.garrick: the smith she trusts with the village gate
ties.npc.wren: the herbalist she taught her letters

text.en: I've buried two husbands, and I've watched the dragon burn a whole season's wheat to ash. I am not leaving this town.
text.zh: 我送走过两个丈夫，也眼看着那条龙把一整季的麦子烧成了灰。这个镇子，我不会丢下。

text.en: This well is forty-one buckets deep. I counted them one by one the year it nearly ran dry.
text.zh: 这口井有四十一桶深。差点干掉的那年，我一桶一桶数过。

text.en: Every house keeps two full buckets at the door, day and night. When the dragon's fire comes down, there is no time to run to the well.
text.zh: 镇上每家门口都要摆两桶水，白天黑夜都不许空着。龙火落下来的时候，再跑去井边就来不及了。

text.en: The dragon nests up on Cinder Peak. We used to go up there for wood and to graze the sheep. Nobody goes that way now.
text.zh: 那条龙的巢在烬峰上。以前我们上山砍柴、放羊，现在没人敢往那边走了。

text.en: Garrick has finished the blade, then. I heard his hammer all night.
text.zh: 加里克把剑打好了吧。我听了一整夜的锤子声。

text.en: Wren's draught. Drink it at the mouth of the lair, not before. It doesn't last long.
text.zh: 雷恩的药。到了巢穴门口再喝，别喝早了，药劲撑不了多久。

text.en: You did it. I will have your name cut into the well. Do not argue.
text.zh: 你做到了。我要把你的名字刻在井上。别跟我争。

text.en: For the town? Thank you.
text.zh: 给镇上的？谢谢你。

lines.en: Five iron ore and three coal. The Embervein Mine north of the square has both, and things that bite.
lines.zh: 五块铁矿石，三块煤。广场北边的烬脉旧矿里两样都有，里头也有咬人的东西。

lines.en: A pickaxe opens a vein in two blows. Don't let the cyclops see you at it.
lines.zh: 用镐子敲两下，矿脉就开了。敲的时候别让独眼巨人看见。

ties.npc.mara: the elder who pays for his coal

text.en: MIND THE SPARKS! ...Sorry. I shout when I'm at the iron. My father did too.
text.zh: 当心火星子！……对不住，我一打铁嗓门就大。我爹也是这样。

text.en: Twelve smiths before me kept that pattern, father to son. Not one of them ever had the ore. I never thought I would be the one to forge it.
text.zh: 我前面十二代铁匠，一代传一代守着那张图样，谁也没弄到过那种矿石。我从没想过，会轮到我来打。

text.en: Garrick. I'm the smith. If you've come about the dragon, so has everyone else this month. Nobody has brought me a horseshoe in weeks.
text.zh: 我是加里克，这里的铁匠。你要是为了魔龙来的——这个月来的人都是为这个。已经好几个礼拜没人找我钉马掌了。

text.en: Five iron ore and three coal. The Embervein Mine north of the square has both, and things that bite.
text.zh: 五块铁矿石，三块煤。广场北边的烬脉旧矿里两样都有，里头也有咬人的东西。

text.en: A pickaxe opens a vein in two blows. Don't let the cyclops see you at it.
text.zh: 用镐子敲两下，矿脉就开了。敲的时候别让独眼巨人看见。

text.en: There. Twelve of us kept the pattern, and I'm the one who forged it. Swing it hard. It was made for that dragon.
text.zh: 好了。十二代人守着这张图样，到我手上总算打出来了。用力挥，它就是为那条龙打的。

text.en: Hm. I'll find a use for it.
text.zh: 嗯。我找个地方用上。

lines.en: Fireweed grows in open meadow; frostcap in the shade of Hushwood. Bring me three of each, and I can brew something against fire.
lines.zh: 火焰草长在开阔的草原上，霜盖菇长在噤声林的阴凉处。各给我带三份来，我就能熬出防火的药。

lines.en: The book says a dragon calls its young when it's hurt. It doesn't say what to do when that happens. Be careful.
lines.zh: 书上说，龙受了伤就会把幼龙叫来。真到了那时候该怎么办，书上没写。你要当心。

ties.npc.mara: the elder who taught her letters

text.en: Fresh fireweed stings — that's what these red spots on my hands are. It only works while it still stings. Once it's dried it stops, and it's not half as strong.
text.zh: 新鲜的火焰草会蜇手，我手上这些红点就是这么来的。蜇手的才有药性，晒干了就不蜇了，药性也差了一大半。

text.en: When Mara taught me my letters, the first book I finished was about dragons. It's the only one in town, and I've read it more times than I can count.
text.zh: 玛拉教我认字的时候，我读完的第一本书就是讲龙的。镇上就那么一本，我翻了不知道多少遍。

text.en: Oh! A visitor. I'm Wren; I make herbal remedies and salves. Mind the cauldron — now and then it goes off.
text.zh: 哦！来客人了。我叫雷恩，在这儿配草药、熬药膏。小心那口锅，它有时候会炸。

text.en: Fireweed grows in open meadow; frostcap in the shade of Hushwood. Bring me three of each, and I can brew something against fire.
text.zh: 火焰草长在开阔的草原上，霜盖菇长在噤声林的阴凉处。各给我带三份来，我就能熬出防火的药。

text.en: The book says a dragon calls its young when it's hurt. It doesn't say what to do when that happens. Be careful.
text.zh: 书上说，龙受了伤就会把幼龙叫来。真到了那时候该怎么办，书上没写。你要当心。

text.en: One at the mouth of the lair, and one when the first wears thin. And come back.
text.zh: 到了巢穴门口喝一瓶，第一瓶快没效了再喝第二瓶。还有——一定要回来。

text.en: For my shelves? Thank you!
text.zh: 给我的架子添货？谢谢！

lines.en: Pick a road and keep to it. You can change if you must, but the new road starts again from the first step.
lines.zh: 选了一条路，就一直走下去。真想换也可以，只是新的那条得从头练起。

lines.en: The dagger works from behind. Sword and shield from the front. The bow from far off. The staff from wherever you stand. Which will you be?
lines.zh: 匕首是从背后下手的，剑和盾是正面硬碰的，弓是远远地射，法杖站在哪儿都能施法。你想当哪一种？

lines.en: Tobin stands at the edge of every drill and talks the whole way through. I have given up telling him to go.
lines.zh: 托宾每回都站在边上，一边看操练一边说个没完。我已经懒得赶他走了。

ties.npc.tobin: the peddler who talks through his drills

text.en: Before the storms I trained the road wardens in this yard. The road is cut now. I train whoever comes down the mountain.
text.zh: 起风暴以前，我在这个院子里练巡路的卫士。现在路断了，从山上下来的人，谁来我就教谁。

text.en: Sleep before a long fight. When the arm tires, the guard drops first. I tell every one of them. Few listen.
text.zh: 打大仗之前先睡够。人一累，最先垂下来的就是护身的那只胳膊。这话我跟每个人都说过，没几个听的。

text.en: If you want to see an old man pleased, bring me {favourite}. Tobin knows I like it, and charges me more for it.
text.zh: 想让我这老头子高兴，就带{favourite}来。托宾知道我喜欢，每回卖给我都要多收几个钱。

text.en: Off the mountain, are you. When you have a few fights behind you — level five — come to me, and I will set you on a road: dagger, sword and shield, bow, or staff. Choose when you are ready.
text.zh: 从山上下来的吧。等你打过几场仗、到了五级，再来找我，我给你指一条路：匕首，剑和盾，弓，或者法杖。想好了再选。

text.en: Pick a road and keep to it. You can change if you must, but the new road starts again from the first step.
text.zh: 选了一条路，就一直走下去。真想换也可以，只是新的那条得从头练起。

text.en: The dagger works from behind. Sword and shield from the front. The bow from far off. The staff from wherever you stand. Which will you be?
text.zh: 匕首是从背后下手的，剑和盾是正面硬碰的，弓是远远地射，法杖站在哪儿都能施法。你想当哪一种？

text.en: Tobin stands at the edge of every drill and talks the whole way through. I have given up telling him to go.
text.zh: 托宾每回都站在边上，一边看操练一边说个没完。我已经懒得赶他走了。

text.en: The light is going. Practise your footwork; you do not need light for that.
text.zh: 天快黑了。去练步法吧，步法不用看也能练。

text.en: Rain makes the grip slip. Wrap the handle in cloth, and hold it tighter.
text.zh: 下雨天手握不稳。拿布把握柄缠一圈，再握紧些。

text.en: Keep it. You will need it more than I do.
text.zh: 你留着吧。你比我用得着。

lines.en: You've come down off the mountain, then. I'm Rowan; I'm elder here, for what that's worth. The day the storm broke, two of ours went into Longsleep Barrow to the south for shelter — Lina and Oskar. They've not come back. The dead lie in that barrow. They used to lie quiet. Not lately. I'm too old to go down there myself, and we've few left who can hold a blade. If you'd go: south through Dusklea and Hushwood to Thornwood Hollow. The barrow mouth is between two standing stones. I'd be grateful.
lines.zh: 你是从山上下来的吧。我叫罗万，是这个村子的长老。起风暴那天，村里有两个人去了南边的长眠冢避雨，一个叫莉娜，一个叫奥斯卡。到今天还没回来。那座长眠冢里埋的都是死人。以前死人是安安静静躺着的，这阵子不是了。我年纪大了，下不去。村里能拿兵器的人，也没剩几个。你要是肯走一趟：往南穿过暮牧原和噤声林，到荆棘谷，两块立石中间就是长眠冢的入口。拜托了。

lines.en: The barrow is in Thornwood Hollow to the south, between two standing stones. Lina and Oskar — I'm counting on you.
lines.zh: 长眠冢在南边的荆棘谷，两块立石中间。莉娜和奥斯卡，拜托你了。

text.en: Every morning I count the chimneys with smoke from the porch. There are a few fewer than last winter.
text.zh: 我每天早上都在门廊上数一遍冒烟的烟囱。比去年冬天少了几根。

text.en: When I was a boy, Firstlight had a hundred souls or so. There are far fewer now. Most of those who left went east, and I've not seen one of them come back.
text.zh: 我小时候，初原村有一百来口人。如今少多了。走的人大多是往东去的，我没见谁回来过。

text.en: Someone came up the Sunrise Road and said the dragon of Emberfall is dead, and that it was you who killed it. I'm glad. The whole village is glad today.
text.zh: 东边路上来的人说，余烬镇的那条龙死了，是你杀的。我很高兴。今天全村的人都很高兴。

text.en: You've come down off the mountain, then. I'm Rowan; I'm elder here, for what that's worth. The day the storm broke, two of ours went into Longsleep Barrow to the south for shelter — Lina and Oskar. They've not come back. The dead lie in that barrow. They used to lie quiet. Not lately. I'm too old to go down there myself, and we've few left who can hold a blade. If you'd go: south through Dusklea and Hushwood to Thornwood Hollow. The barrow mouth is between two standing stones. I'd be grateful.
text.zh: 你是从山上下来的吧。我叫罗万，是这个村子的长老。起风暴那天，村里有两个人去了南边的长眠冢避雨，一个叫莉娜，一个叫奥斯卡。到今天还没回来。那座长眠冢里埋的都是死人。以前死人是安安静静躺着的，这阵子不是了。我年纪大了，下不去。村里能拿兵器的人，也没剩几个。你要是肯走一趟：往南穿过暮牧原和噤声林，到荆棘谷，两块立石中间就是长眠冢的入口。拜托了。

text.en: The flame has burned here longer than these houses have stood. That heretic walked into the chapel and carried it off, and not one of us stopped him. I am the elder. I should have stopped him.
text.zh: 圣火在这里烧得比这些房子还久。那个异端走进礼拜堂，把它拿走了，我们谁也没拦住。我是长老，我该拦住他的。

text.en: I've heard about the Church's letter. They want you to go east. Go, then; the whole village will pray for you. And if you meet that thief in grey on the road, remember what he took from us.
text.zh: 教会的信我听说了，是叫你往东去。去吧，全村的人都会替你祷告。路上要是遇见那个穿灰衣的贼，别忘了他从我们这里拿走了什么。

text.en: The Crown of Thorns is here in our village, and the chapel altar is still cold. The Church tells us to be patient. To be honest, I am running out of patience.
text.zh: 荆棘冠现在就在我们村里，可礼拜堂的祭坛还是冷的。教会叫我们忍耐。说实话，我快忍不下去了。

text.en: The barrow is in Thornwood Hollow to the south, between two standing stones. Lina and Oskar — I'm counting on you.
text.zh: 长眠冢在南边的荆棘谷，两块立石中间。莉娜和奥斯卡，拜托你了。

lines.en: Since the storm nothing's come in from the fields or up the road. The stew gets thinner every day.
lines.zh: 起了风暴以后，地里的东西收不上来，路上的货也进不来。我这锅汤一天比一天稀。

lines.en: Pell and his grey man again. Stories all day long. He gets that from his father, who went east and never wrote.
lines.zh: 佩尔又在说他那个灰衣人，整天编故事。这毛病随他爹——他爹往东去了，一封信也没寄回来过。

text.en: Salt goes in last. Put it in at the start and the beans never go soft, however long you cook them.
text.zh: 盐要最后放。一开始就放的话，豆子怎么煮都煮不烂。

text.en: Mia eats the crust and leaves the middle. Her father used to do the same. I never told her that.
text.zh: 米娅吃面包只吃皮，把芯剩下。她爹以前也是这样。这个我没跟她说过。

text.en: You killed a dragon, and you still come back for my stew! Sit down. Today you get two bowls.
text.zh: 杀了一条龙，还记得回来喝我的汤！坐，今天给你盛两碗。

text.en: You've been across the river already? Eat first, then. Nobody over there will cook for you.
text.zh: 你已经过了河了？那先吃饭。对岸可没人给你做饭。

text.en: The Firstlight's gone. I still lit my fire this morning and cooked like always, but I've felt uneasy all day.
text.zh: 圣火没了。我早上照样生火做饭，可这一整天心里都不踏实。

text.en: Since the storm nothing's come in from the fields or up the road. The stew gets thinner every day.
text.zh: 起了风暴以后，地里的东西收不上来，路上的货也进不来。我这锅汤一天比一天稀。

text.en: Sit, eat. It isn't much, but it's hot.
text.zh: 坐下吃吧。东西不多，但是热乎。

text.en: Pell and his grey man again. Stories all day long. He gets that from his father, who went east and never wrote.
text.zh: 佩尔又在说他那个灰衣人，整天编故事。这毛病随他爹——他爹往东去了，一封信也没寄回来过。

lines.en: Mum says I'm not allowed past Hushwood. I only went a little way. Only a tiny bit, honest.
lines.zh: 妈妈不让我走过噤声林那边。我就走了一点点，真的就一点点。

lines.en: Do frogs sleep? This one doesn't.
lines.zh: 青蛙睡觉吗？这只不睡。

text.en: I can hold my breath for a whole song. Pell can't even do half.
text.zh: 我能憋气憋一整首歌。佩尔连半首都憋不住。

text.en: Mum says the pot is never empty. It looks empty. I checked.
text.zh: 妈妈说锅里从来不会空。可它看着就是空的。我去看过了。

text.en: If you ever find {favourite}, I would trade you my best frog for it. Not this one. A different one.
text.zh: 你要是找到{favourite}，我拿我最好的青蛙跟你换。不是这只，是另一只。

text.en: Mum says I'm not allowed past Hushwood. I only went a little way. Only a tiny bit, honest.
text.zh: 妈妈不让我走过噤声林那边。我就走了一点点，真的就一点点。

text.en: Do frogs sleep? This one doesn't.
text.zh: 青蛙睡觉吗？这只不睡。

lines.en: It's safe inside the fence. Past Dusklea, keep your blade out. After dark, keep it out everywhere.
lines.zh: 围栏里头太平。出了暮牧原就把刀拿在手上。天黑以后，在哪儿都别收刀。

text.en: A quiet night is a good night. I've had three this week. That's more than last week.
text.zh: 夜里安安静静的就是好夜。这个礼拜有三个，比上个礼拜多。

text.en: Fennick taught me to stand still. It's harder than it sounds. Try it for an hour.
text.zh: 站着一动不动，是芬尼克教我的。听着容易，你站上一个钟头就知道了。

text.en: It's safe inside the fence. Past Dusklea, keep your blade out. After dark, keep it out everywhere.
text.zh: 围栏里头太平。出了暮牧原就把刀拿在手上。天黑以后，在哪儿都别收刀。

text.en: Hear that shuffling? The dead walk the wild at night. None has got past the fence yet. That's what I'm here for.
text.zh: 听见那拖着脚走路的声音了吗？夜里荒野上有死人在走。到现在还没有一个过得了围栏。我站在这儿，就是为了这个。

text.en: I had him. I had him at the length of my spear, and he looked at me like I was a child, and walked away on the water.
text.zh: 我差一点就抓住他了。他就在我长矛够得着的地方。他看我的样子，像在看一个小孩。然后他就踩着水走了。

text.en: When you go on east, I want to come. Someone has to catch that thief.
text.zh: 你往东走的时候，我想跟你一起去。那个贼，总得有人去抓。

lines.en: The fire eats every day, so I cut every day. My back isn't what it was. The wood I stack by the square is for anyone who needs it.
lines.zh: 火每天都要烧，我就每天都得砍。腰不比从前了。劈好的柴我都码在广场边上，谁要用就自己拿。

text.en: Pine splits with one blow. Oak takes three, and twists the axe. I leave the birches; they burn too fast.
text.zh: 松木一斧子就劈开了。橡木得砍三下，还别斧头。桦木我不砍，烧得太快。

text.en: Cass says I talk to the trees. I do, a bit. I'm out there on my own all morning.
text.zh: 卡丝说我跟树说话。是会说几句。一上午就我一个人在林子里。

text.en: The fire at the shrine is out. Mine isn't, and I won't let it go out.
text.zh: 神龛那边的火灭了。我家的火还烧着，我不会让它灭。

text.en: The fire eats every day, so I cut every day. My back isn't what it was. The wood I stack by the square is for anyone who needs it.
text.zh: 火每天都要烧，我就每天都得砍。腰不比从前了。劈好的柴我都码在广场边上，谁要用就自己拿。

lines.en: I wasn't counting the days. ...Two days and a night, if you want to know.
lines.zh: 我才没数日子。……两天一夜，你要是想知道的话。

ties.npc.ilse: fond of her, never says so

text.en: I still count the days. I got into the habit in the barrow, and I can't seem to stop.
text.zh: 我到现在还在数日子。在长眠冢里养成的习惯，改不掉了。

text.en: There are mushrooms by the north stones that nobody picks. I pick them. If you tell Oskar, I'll know.
text.zh: 北边那几块石头旁边有蘑菇，没人去采，我采。你要是告诉奥斯卡，我会知道的。

text.en: I'll sell you anything, and we can talk about the price. No credit, though. Nobody who said they'd pay me later ever did.
text.zh: 东西我都可以卖你，价钱好商量。赊账免谈。说过几天再给钱的人，没一个给过。

text.en: So the sister forgets things. What of it? Anyone who laughs at her in front of me can buy their herbs somewhere else.
text.zh: 修女是忘性大，那又怎样。谁当着我的面笑话她，就别想再从我这儿买东西。

text.en: I wasn't counting the days. ...Two days and a night, if you want to know.
text.zh: 我才没数日子。……两天一夜，你要是想知道的话。

text.en: I still dream about that barrow at night. In the day I water the herbs and try not to think about it.
text.zh: 我晚上还会梦见那座长眠冢。白天就浇浇草药，尽量不去想。

text.en: A man in grey shut the inner door from outside. Then he left bread by it, with an ash mark pressed into it. Nobody gives anything for free. So what did he want?
text.zh: 有个穿灰衣服的人从外面把里面那道门关上了，后来又在门边放了面包，面包上按着一个灰印。没人会白给东西。他到底想要什么？

text.en: That old almanac the scholar carries everywhere? ...Tobin sells a lot of things. Don't ask him where he gets them.
text.zh: 那个学者走到哪儿都带着的旧历书？……托宾卖的东西多了。他从哪儿弄来的，你别问。

text.en: If you see mushrooms on Pell's doorstep, the wind left them there. The wind's been very generous this year.
text.zh: 你要是在佩尔家门口看见蘑菇，那是风吹过去的。今年的风挺大方。

text.en: This? It was on a woman's hand, in a barrow. Nobody ever went to see her either. ...Don't tell Oskar.
text.zh: 这个？长眠冢里一个女人手上的。也从来没人去看过她。……别告诉奥斯卡。

text.en: I ate at Marta's again. I pay her in mushrooms. It doesn't cover it, and we both know that.
text.zh: 又去玛尔塔那儿吃饭了。我拿蘑菇抵饭钱。根本抵不够，她知道，我也知道。

text.en: The sister never latches the chapel door at night. She says it's for the wind. A few times in winter I slept by the flame, and every time I woke up under a blanket.
text.zh: 修女晚上从来不闩礼拜堂的门，说是给风留的。冬天我在圣火边睡过几回，每回醒来身上都盖着毯子。

text.en: It was the Church that sent my father east, not her. All she did was pray he'd come back. ...She still prays every morning. I've heard her.
text.zh: 把我爹派到东边去的是教会，不是她。她只是为他祷告，求他能回来。……她到现在每天早上还在祷告，我听见过。

text.en: Don't tell the sister where I go at night. She wouldn't scold me. She'd just be sad, and I can't stand that.
text.zh: 我晚上去哪儿，别告诉修女。她不会骂我，只会难过。我受不了那个。

text.en: She's still sweeping that cold altar. ...The dawnbloom on it is mine. Don't look at me like that. I picked too many, that's all.
text.zh: 她还在扫那座冷掉的祭坛。……上面的晨光花是我放的。别那样看我，采多了而已。

text.en: If anything happened to the sister... Nothing will happen to her. Forget I said it.
text.zh: 要是修女出了什么事……她不会出事的。当我没说。

text.en: For me? ...What do you want for it?
text.zh: 给我的？……你想要什么回报？

lines.en: Took you long enough. Well — thank you.
lines.zh: 来得够慢的。好吧——谢谢你。

text.en: My knees are finished, and those barrow steps nearly finished the rest of me. Next time someone crawls into a barrow, they can crawl back out on their own.
text.zh: 我这膝盖早就不中用了，长眠冢那些台阶差点要了我的老命。下回谁再往长眠冢里钻，让他自己爬出来。

text.en: I taught Lina which mushrooms you can eat, back when she was small. Now she finds them before I do. Cheeky girl.
text.zh: 哪些蘑菇能吃，是我在莉娜很小的时候教她的。现在倒好，她总比我先找到。这丫头。

text.en: Took you long enough. Well — thank you.
text.zh: 来得够慢的。好吧——谢谢你。

text.en: Mending baskets. I lost two down in the barrow and the rest got crushed. My hands still shake, so it goes slow.
text.zh: 在补篮子呢。在长眠冢里丢了两个，剩下的也压坏了。手还在抖，补得慢。

text.en: The dead down there wouldn't stay lying down. I've buried my share of people, and they always stayed down before.
text.zh: 下面那些死人不肯躺着。我这辈子也埋过不少人，以前埋下去的，从来都老老实实躺着。

text.en: She says she was sheltering from the storm. Who shelters from a storm three floors down? ...Never mind. She came back.
text.zh: 她说是躲风暴。谁躲风暴会往下钻三层？……算了。人回来就行。

lines.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. It is the proof the debt is being paid. That is what the Five teach us.
lines.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。这是五苦圣教的教诲。

lines.en: The flame is older than any house in Firstlight. The old keeper told me the first houses were built around it, so that someone would always be near to tend it.
lines.zh: 这团火比村里任何一间房子都老。从前的守火人告诉我，最早的几间房子就是围着它盖的，好让身边总有人照看它。

text.en: You've come a long way. There is bread by the altar; please, help yourself. ...Astra would want you fed before the road.
text.zh: 路上辛苦了。祭坛边上放着面包，请别客气。……阿斯特拉也会希望你吃饱了再上路的。

text.en: Brother Anselm reads aloud when he thinks the chapel is empty. I always mean to tell him I'm there... and every time I'm listening too closely, and forget.
text.zh: 安塞姆修士以为礼拜堂里没人的时候，会把书念出声来。我总想告诉他我也在……可每次都听入了神，又忘了说。

text.en: I came out to fetch something... what was it? No matter. If I stand here a little, it will come back to me.
text.zh: 我出来是要拿什么东西的……是什么来着？不要紧，在这里站一会儿，总会想起来的。

text.en: Lina says she needs no one. So I never latch the chapel door at night. That way she never has to ask.
text.zh: 莉娜总说她谁也不需要。所以夜里我从不闩礼拜堂的门，这样她就不必开口求人了。

text.en: Every morning, when the sky grows light, I thank Astra that the night is over. I have done it since I was a novice. In more than thirty years I have not missed a single morning.
text.zh: 每天早上天一亮，我都先谢过阿斯特拉，谢他让这一夜过去了。我当见习修女的时候就这样，三十多年了，一个早上也没落下。

text.en: Ah, it's you. I know your step by now. My eyes have been weak in the light since I was a child; by day, faces are always a blur to me, so I go by my ears. From now on, when you come, you needn't say a word. I'll know it's you.
text.zh: 啊，是你呀。你的脚步声，我已经记住了。我的眼睛从小就怕光，白天看人总是模模糊糊的，只好靠耳朵。所以往后你来，不用出声，我也认得出是你。

text.en: Nessa comes for candles every week, four at a time. She works out her sunsets by lamplight, and says that when the light is poor she copies the numbers wrong.
text.zh: 奈莎每个礼拜都来拿蜡烛，一次拿四支。她夜里点着灯算日落的时辰，说光一暗，数字就会抄错。

text.en: Pell draws the road east, over and over. It is the way his father went. I keep every drawing he gives me.
text.zh: 佩尔总是画往东去的那条路，画了一张又一张。他父亲就是从那条路走的。他送给我的画，我每一张都收着。

text.en: Some mornings there is dawnbloom on the altar before I get there, with the dew still on it. I have never asked who leaves it.
text.zh: 有几个早上，我还没到，祭坛上就已经放好了晨光花，花瓣上的露水都还没干。是谁放的，我从来没有问过。

text.en: I'm a little ashamed to say it, but even a nun has a fondness. Mine is {favourite}. ...Please keep it from Brother Anselm.
text.zh: 说来有些难为情，修女也有偏爱的东西。我喜欢的是{favourite}。……请别让安塞姆修士知道。

text.en: We laid the crown beneath the altar. Nessa says it hums at night, so I sang it a hymn for sleeping. ...It does seem a little quieter.
text.zh: 我们把荆棘冠放在祭坛底下了。奈莎说它夜里会嗡嗡地响，我就给它唱了一首安眠的圣歌。……好像是安静了一点。

text.en: Welcome to Firstlight, traveller. Your hands are cold; please, come closer. This flame was lit from the first dawn after the First Night, and it is glad to warm anyone who has come far.
text.zh: 欢迎来到初原村，旅人。你的手很凉，请靠近些。这团火是从初夜之后的第一道晨光里取来的，远道而来的人，它都乐意温暖。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. It is the proof the debt is being paid. That is what the Five teach us.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。这是五苦圣教的教诲。

text.en: The flame is older than any house in Firstlight. The old keeper told me the first houses were built around it, so that someone would always be near to tend it.
text.zh: 这团火比村里任何一间房子都老。从前的守火人告诉我，最早的几间房子就是围着它盖的，好让身边总有人照看它。

text.en: Good morning. I have just thanked Astra that the night is over, and said one for you as well.
text.zh: 早安。我刚谢过阿斯特拉，让这一夜过去了，也替你谢了一句。

text.en: The evenings come sooner. Every week I light the lamps a little earlier, and write each one down. ...Only I've forgotten which book I wrote them in.
text.zh: 黄昏一天比一天早了。我每个礼拜都提早一点点灯，每次都记下来。……只是记在哪一本册子上，我又忘了。

text.en: It's very late. The flame keeps watch at night; you needn't. ...Sleep well, and come and see me tomorrow.
text.zh: 已经很晚了。守夜有圣火，你不必陪着。……好好睡一觉，明天再来看我吧。

text.en: You're soaked through. Stand by the flame a while, and I'll find you something dry.
text.zh: 你都淋透了。到火边站一会儿吧，我去给你找件干衣服。

text.en: On nights like this I count the doors I hear close. ...Go home early, will you? I'd like to count yours too.
text.zh: 这样的夜里，我会数着听见了几扇门关上。……早些回家好吗？我也想听见你的那一扇。

text.en: Lina and Oskar are home safe. Thanks be to Astra, and to you. Tonight the whole village gives thanks at the flame. You will come, won't you? I'll keep you a seat near the fire.
text.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡平安回来了。感谢阿斯特拉，也谢谢你。今晚全村都要到圣火前谢恩，你也会来吧？我给你留一个靠近火的位子。

text.en: Lina once asked me, as if it were nothing, whether a prayer counts for someone no one visits. Every prayer counts. I didn't ask her for whom.
text.zh: 莉娜有一回像是随口问我：一个没人去看的人，替他祈祷，算不算数。每一句祈祷都算数。我没有问她是替谁问的。

text.en: Some people take a thing to keep it.
text.zh: 有些人拿走一样东西，是为了守住它。

text.en: I still sweep the altar every morning, the taper still in my hand. ...My hands are slower than my heart to believe the flame is gone.
text.zh: 我每天早上还是去扫祭坛，手里照旧拿着点火棒。……心里知道火已经不在了，手却还没习惯。

text.en: The way you stand reminds me of someone I knew. Shoulders always braced, as if the sky might fall at any moment. ...Do sit a while. I'll make tea.
text.zh: 你站着的样子，很像我从前认识的一个人。肩膀总是绷得紧紧的，好像天随时会塌下来。……坐一会儿吧，我去沏茶。

text.en: Astra bore five sufferings so the sun would rise. The Seal-bearers carry them still. Go to the first of them, pilgrim. ...And before you set out, please, eat a proper meal.
text.zh: 阿斯特拉承受了五苦，太阳才重新升起。如今这五苦，由持印者替他担着。去找第一位持印者吧，朝圣者。……还有，出发之前，请一定好好吃顿饭。

text.en: I remember every pilgrim I have blessed by their footsteps. Please come back, so that I may hear yours again.
text.zh: 我祝福过的每一位朝圣者，我都记得他们的脚步声。请一定回来，让我再听一听你的。

text.en: The Crown of Thorns, here in our village. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes. Keep it close to you, please, but not against your heart.
text.zh: 荆棘冠，竟然来到了我们村里。我从没想过这辈子能亲眼见到它。请把它贴身收好。只是……别让它太靠近你的心。

text.en: He always did carry things that were too heavy for him.
text.zh: 他从小就是这样，总要背些他背不动的东西。

text.en: Is this for me? ...Thank you. I'll set it by the altar first, so Astra may see it too, and quietly take it back tonight.
text.zh: 这是给我的吗？……谢谢你。我先把它供在祭坛边，让阿斯特拉也看一看，晚上再悄悄拿回来。

lines.en: An axe fells a tree, and an axe on a log gives you planks. Three planks and the footbridge is whole again.
lines.zh: 用斧头把树砍倒，再拿斧头劈木头，就有木板了。有三块木板，小桥就能补好。

lines.en: Nails pulled straight and laid in a row. No storm pulls nails. Someone wanted that bridge gone, and wanted us to know it.
lines.zh: 钉子拔得直直的，一排摆好。哪有风暴会拔钉子？是有人想拆了那座桥，还想让我们知道。

text.en: Green wood moves as it dries. I cut every board a finger long and plane it to size a week later.
text.zh: 新木头晾干的时候会走形。我裁木板总多留一指长，过一个礼拜再刨到尺寸。

text.en: Aldo could hold a plank level with one hand and argue with the other. I miss arguing with him.
text.zh: 阿尔多能一只手把木板端得平平的，另一只手指着人吵架。我挺怀念跟他吵架的那些日子。

text.en: The dragon's dead, I hear. Emberfall will want beams and roofs mended, then. I might go over.
text.zh: 听说龙死了。那余烬镇的房梁屋顶得修不少。说不定我会过去一趟。

text.en: Joss. I build things: bridges, fences, benches. The footbridge at Vesper Ford was mine and Aldo's.
text.zh: 乔斯。我是做木工的，桥、篱笆、长凳都做。晚祷渡那座小桥，是我跟阿尔多搭的。

text.en: An axe fells a tree, and an axe on a log gives you planks. Three planks and the footbridge is whole again.
text.zh: 用斧头把树砍倒，再拿斧头劈木头，就有木板了。有三块木板，小桥就能补好。

text.en: Nails pulled straight and laid in a row. No storm pulls nails. Someone wanted that bridge gone, and wanted us to know it.
text.zh: 钉子拔得直直的，一排摆好。哪有风暴会拔钉子？是有人想拆了那座桥，还想让我们知道。

text.en: You crossed. Good. Aldo would have laughed to see it. He always said that bridge would outlive us both.
text.zh: 你过去了。好。阿尔多要是看见，准会笑出声来。他以前总说，那座桥会比我们俩活得都长。

text.en: A man in grey paid for that bridge, twenty years back, and a boy at his heel carried the purse. Old coin, no king on it. "A road out of here a cart could take in a hurry," he said. I never knew what he meant.
text.zh: 二十年前，出钱造那座桥的是个穿灰衣的人，身边跟着个男孩，钱袋是男孩拿着的。给的都是旧钱，上面没有国王的头像。他说：“要一条路，马车急着走的时候能从这里出去。”他是什么意思，我到今天也没想明白。

lines.en: I saw the grey man. Three times! Nobody believes me. He gave me a stone that's warm at night.
lines.zh: 我见过那个灰衣人。见过三次！没人信我。他给了我一块晚上会发热的石头。

lines.en: Since I got the stone, the night things don't come near my window. Auntie says that's nonsense.
lines.zh: 自从有了那块石头，夜里的东西就不靠近我的窗户了。姑姑说那是瞎说。

text.en: I drew the grey man again. Aunt Marta says it looks like a chimney. It does not!
text.zh: 我又画了灰衣人。玛尔塔姑姑说画得像个烟囱。才不像呢！

text.en: If you hold the warm stone up to your ear, it hums. Just a little. You can try — no, wait, I'm keeping it.
text.zh: 把那块暖石头贴在耳朵上，它会嗡嗡响，就一点点。你可以试试——不行，还是我自己拿着吧。

text.en: Are you a knight? You've got a fairy! I'm Pell, I draw things. Can I draw her? Just quickly!
text.zh: 你是骑士吗？你身边有个精灵！我叫佩尔，我会画画。我能画她吗？就画一下下！

text.en: I saw the grey man. Three times! Nobody believes me. He gave me a stone that's warm at night.
text.zh: 我见过那个灰衣人。见过三次！没人信我。他给了我一块晚上会发热的石头。

text.en: Since I got the stone, the night things don't come near my window. Auntie says that's nonsense.
text.zh: 自从有了那块石头，夜里的东西就不靠近我的窗户了。姑姑说那是瞎说。

text.en: I TOLD them! I told everyone there was a grey man! Now they believe me, but nobody will talk to me. The grown-ups are all arguing.
text.zh: 我早就说了！我早就跟大家说过有个灰衣人！现在他们信了，可是谁都不理我，大人们都在吵架。

text.en: Was he bad? The grey man? He didn't look bad. He looked tired.
text.zh: 他是坏人吗？那个灰衣人？他看起来不像坏人。他看起来很累。

lines.en: Every month the sun sets earlier. Four minutes, five, six. I write it all down. The numbers make a curve, and I do not like where it goes.
lines.zh: 太阳每个月都落得更早。四分钟、五分钟、六分钟。我全都记下来了。这些数字连成一条曲线，它往哪儿走，我不喜欢。

lines.en: Tobin sold me an almanac from before the First Night. Its curve matches mine. Exactly.
lines.zh: 托宾卖给我一本初夜之前的旧历书。它的曲线和我的一模一样。分毫不差。

text.en: I have four pens and I lose them in the same order every week. There is a pattern. I have not found it.
text.zh: 我有四支笔，每周都按同样的顺序弄丢。这里面有规律。我还没找到。

text.en: The stars do not care what the Church prints about them. That is rather restful, after a day of almanacs.
text.zh: 星星不在乎教会印了它们什么。编了一天历书之后，这一点倒挺让人歇心。

text.en: Hello. I am Nessa Quill; I make the almanacs for the Holy City. I have been stuck here since the bridge went. Do you know what time it is? Exactly, I mean. To the minute.
text.zh: 你好。我叫奈莎·奎尔，给圣城编历书的。桥断了以后，我就困在这里了。你知道现在几点吗？我是说，精确到分钟。

text.en: Every month the sun sets earlier. Four minutes, five, six. I write it all down. The numbers make a curve, and I do not like where it goes.
text.zh: 太阳每个月都落得更早。四分钟、五分钟、六分钟。我全都记下来了。这些数字连成一条曲线，它往哪儿走，我不喜欢。

text.en: Tobin sold me an almanac from before the First Night. Its curve matches mine. Exactly.
text.zh: 托宾卖给我一本初夜之前的旧历书。它的曲线和我的一模一样。分毫不差。

text.en: Hush — the sun is touching the trees. Fourteen. Fifteen. There.
text.zh: 嘘——太阳碰到树梢了。十四。十五。好了。

text.en: Four minutes. The sun set four minutes early tonight, on the day the first seal fell. I am sure it means nothing.
text.zh: 四分钟。今晚太阳早落了四分钟，偏偏是第一道印倒下的那天。我相信这什么都不代表。

lines.en: I carried a lance in the Seal-bearers' escort once. A long time ago.
lines.zh: 我年轻时在持印者的护卫队里扛过长枪。很久以前的事了。

text.en: The first year, armour is heavy. After that you stop noticing it. I wore mine six years, and when I took it off for good I did not know what to do with my hands.
text.zh: 头一年穿盔甲，只觉得沉。后来就不觉得了。我穿了六年，等到真脱下来不再穿了，两只手都不知道往哪儿放。

text.en: Every morning for a month he asked me my name, and it took me that long to understand why. I answered him every time. What else could I do?
text.zh: 他连着一个月，每天早上都问我叫什么名字。过了那么久，我才明白是怎么回事。我每次都答了。不答，又能怎么样呢。

text.en: Sit if you like. I'm Fennick. Don't ask about the armour.
text.zh: 想坐就坐吧。我叫芬尼克。盔甲的事别问。

text.en: I carried a lance in the Seal-bearers' escort once. A long time ago.
text.zh: 我年轻时在持印者的护卫队里扛过长枪。很久以前的事了。

text.en: The White Knight. Alberic. When I served him, he would kneel to talk to children, so his face was level with theirs. Now everyone who passes must kneel to him. The crown did that to him.
text.zh: 白骑士……阿尔贝里克。我跟着他的那些年，他跟孩子说话，总要单膝跪下来，好跟孩子一样高。现在过路的人，都得向他下跪。是那顶冠把他变成这样的。

text.en: A grey cloak, ash on his hands? ...I knew a man like that. He would not rob a chapel. If it was him, he had a reason, and I do not like to think what it was.
text.zh: 灰斗篷，手上沾着灰？……我认识一个这样的人。他不会去偷礼拜堂。要真是他，那他一定有他的理由。是什么理由，我不敢往下想。

text.en: You saw the carving at the barrow mouth? The Order of the Thorn buried its own there, before my time. The warden was one of us. Alberic's brothers, all of them, and none of them lying still.
text.zh: 你看见长眠冢门口的刻纹了？荆棘骑士团的人死了，就葬在那里，比我入团还早。守墓的那位也是我们团里的。他们全是阿尔贝里克的弟兄，没有一个能安安稳稳地躺着。

text.en: You brought him down. Was he — was he himself, at the end? ...Good. Good.
text.zh: 你把他打倒了。他……到最后，他还是原来的他吗？……那就好。那就好。

lines.en: The days got too short for the wheat to ripen. Then the night things came for what was left. The house is all I kept.
lines.zh: 白天短得麦子都熟不了。后来夜里那些东西来了，把剩下的也糟蹋了。我就只保住了这间屋子。

lines.en: There's a knight up the road, all in white. He took my husband's ring off the gatepost. He took everything that shone.
lines.zh: 路那头有个骑士，一身白。他把我丈夫的戒指从门柱上拿走了。凡是会发亮的东西，他都拿走了。

text.en: I still wake at the hour the rooster used to crow. There is no rooster now. I wake anyway.
text.zh: 我每天还是在公鸡打鸣的时辰醒过来。公鸡早就没了，可我还是会醒。

text.en: Sorry — I jump at every sound. Since the night they came, I can't sleep unless my back is to a wall.
text.zh: 对不起，一点动静我就吓一跳。自从那天夜里它们来过，我不背靠着墙就睡不着。

text.en: The crown is in the village now. I went to look at it. It's only thorns. I thought it would look like... more.
text.zh: 荆棘冠现在放在村里了。我去看过一眼，就是一圈荆棘。我还以为它会更……更了不得一点。

text.en: Stay back! ...You're not one of them. Sorry. I haven't seen a living face out here in a long while.
text.zh: 别过来！……你不是那些东西。对不起。这一带我好久没见过活人了。

text.en: The days got too short for the wheat to ripen. Then the night things came for what was left. The house is all I kept.
text.zh: 白天短得麦子都熟不了。后来夜里那些东西来了，把剩下的也糟蹋了。我就只保住了这间屋子。

text.en: There's a knight up the road, all in white. He took my husband's ring off the gatepost. He took everything that shone.
text.zh: 路那头有个骑士，一身白。他把我丈夫的戒指从门柱上拿走了。凡是会发亮的东西，他都拿走了。

text.en: A man in grey came through, the night of the fire. He pulled me out of the smoke. Don't tell anyone in the village I said so.
text.zh: 起火那天夜里，有个穿灰衣服的人路过，是他把我从烟里拖出来的。你别跟村里人说是我讲的。

text.en: The road's gone quiet again. I'll go to Firstlight. There's nothing left for me here but ash.
text.zh: 路上又安静下来了。我要去初原村。这里除了一地灰，什么也不剩了。

lines.en: Every dusk the whole herd goes down on its knees, all facing east. My gran kept cows all her life and never once saw one kneel.
lines.zh: 每天天一黑，整群牛就跪下来，全都朝着东边。我奶奶养了一辈子牛，从没见过牛下跪。

lines.en: The grass is thin this year. The days are short, so the grass is short. I tell myself that's all it is.
lines.zh: 今年的草长得稀。白天短了，草也就长不高。我跟自己说，就是这么回事。

text.en: When rain is coming the hens go in early. I trust them more than I trust the sky.
text.zh: 要下雨了，鸡会早早钻回窝里。比起看天，我更信它们。

text.en: The calves like having their ears scratched. Don't tell Holt I told you that.
text.zh: 小牛喜欢让人挠耳朵。这话你别跟霍尔特说是我讲的。

text.en: Mind the hens. And don't run, the cows spook easily. I'm Brin; I keep the herd.
text.zh: 当心脚下的鸡。也别跑，牛容易受惊。我叫布琳，这群牛归我管。

text.en: Every dusk the whole herd goes down on its knees, all facing east. My gran kept cows all her life and never once saw one kneel.
text.zh: 每天天一黑，整群牛就跪下来，全都朝着东边。我奶奶养了一辈子牛，从没见过牛下跪。

text.en: The grass is thin this year. The days are short, so the grass is short. I tell myself that's all it is.
text.zh: 今年的草长得稀。白天短了，草也就长不高。我跟自己说，就是这么回事。

text.en: Here it comes — watch them. ...There. Down they go. East.
text.zh: 来了，你看着它们。……看，跪下去了。朝着东边。

text.en: They stopped kneeling. The day you came back with that crown, they stopped. ...Now they just stand there and look east.
text.zh: 它们不跪了。你带着那顶冠回来的那天就不跪了。……现在它们只是站在那儿，朝东边看。

lines.en: The wheel turns slower every week. The brook comes off the hills, and the hills get less sun. That is all it is.
lines.zh: 水车一周比一周转得慢。溪水是从山上下来的，山上晒到的太阳越来越少。就这么回事。

lines.en: Something got into the cellar after dark. Slimes, and worse. The vigil oil is down there. I'm not going down.
lines.zh: 天黑以后有东西钻进了地窖。史莱姆，还有更糟的。守夜用的灯油就在下面。我可不下去。

text.en: I can tell the time by the sound of the wheel. It's been turning slower lately, and I keep getting it wrong. I've overslept twice this month.
text.zh: 我听水车的声音就知道几点了。最近它转得慢，我老是听错，这个月已经睡过头两回了。

text.en: Flour gets into everything. I have not owned a black coat in twenty years.
text.zh: 面粉什么地方都钻得进去。我已经二十年没穿过黑外套了。

text.en: I'm Tam. I grind Firstlight's flour and press its lamp oil. Mind the brook; it bites in the cold.
text.zh: 我叫塔姆，给初原村磨面、榨灯油。小心那条溪，天一冷，溪水冰得扎骨头。

text.en: The wheel turns slower every week. The brook comes off the hills, and the hills get less sun. That is all it is.
text.zh: 水车一周比一周转得慢。溪水是从山上下来的，山上晒到的太阳越来越少。就这么回事。

text.en: Something got into the cellar after dark. Slimes, and worse. The vigil oil is down there. I'm not going down.
text.zh: 天黑以后有东西钻进了地窖。史莱姆，还有更糟的。守夜用的灯油就在下面。我可不下去。

text.en: You brought the oil up? The lamps will burn tonight, then. My grandmother said the vigil lamps were lit from the first dawn. I believe her more than I used to.
text.zh: 你把油拿上来了？那今晚的灯能点起来了。我奶奶说守夜灯是用最初的晨光点着的。比起从前，我现在更信她的话了。

lines.en: I swore to hold until I was relieved. It was you who relieved me. So now I hold this ground for you. It is the same vow.
lines.zh: 我立过誓，要守到有人来接替我为止。来接替我的是你。所以如今，我替你守着这片地。誓言还是那一个。

lines.en: Plant what you will, and build what you will. No one need kneel here.
lines.zh: 想种什么就种什么，想盖什么就盖什么。在这里，谁也不必下跪。

lines.en: The mist marks how far I can hold. Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push it further back.
lines.zh: 迷雾在哪里，我能守住的地方就到哪里。把扩地要用的东西带来给我，我就把迷雾再往外推一些。

lines.en: Before I was a knight, my father was a smith. The forge is lit; whenever you carry a hammer, the anvil is yours. If you lack bars or coal, I keep some.
lines.zh: 我做骑士以前，父亲是个铁匠。炉火一直生着，你只要带着锻锤，铁砧随时可以用。缺铁锭、缺煤，就跟我说，我这里备着。

text.en: The mist moves in the night. Each morning I walk its edge and count the tent pegs. None has gone yet.
text.zh: 夜里迷雾会挪动。每天早上，我都沿着它的边走一圈，把帐篷桩数一遍。到今天，一根也没少。

text.en: I asked thy name once, and I have lost it again. Forgive me. Tell it me once more, and I will try to keep it this time.
text.zh: 你的名字，我问过一次，又忘了。原谅我。请再告诉我一遍，这一回我会尽力记住。

text.en: You have come back. Good. While you are away the ground stays quiet; I see to it.
text.zh: 你回来了。很好。你不在的时候，这片地一直很安静，我守着它。

text.en: I swore to hold until I was relieved. It was you who relieved me. So now I hold this ground for you. It is the same vow.
text.zh: 我立过誓，要守到有人来接替我为止。来接替我的是你。所以如今，我替你守着这片地。誓言还是那一个。

text.en: Plant what you will, and build what you will. No one need kneel here.
text.zh: 想种什么就种什么，想盖什么就盖什么。在这里，谁也不必下跪。

text.en: The mist marks how far I can hold. Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push it further back.
text.zh: 迷雾在哪里，我能守住的地方就到哪里。把扩地要用的东西带来给我，我就把迷雾再往外推一些。

text.en: Before I was a knight, my father was a smith. The forge is lit; whenever you carry a hammer, the anvil is yours. If you lack bars or coal, I keep some.
text.zh: 我做骑士以前，父亲是个铁匠。炉火一直生着，你只要带着锻锤，铁砧随时可以用。缺铁锭、缺煤，就跟我说，我这里备着。

text.en: The sun sets early now, earlier than it did. I am sorry for it. I cannot say why I am sorry, but I am.
text.zh: 如今太阳落得早，比从前早。我很抱歉。为什么抱歉，我说不上来，可我心里确实抱歉。

text.en: There was a squire once, who carried my lance. I cannot see his face any more. If you meet him, tell him I am sorry. One morning I asked him his name.
text.zh: 从前有个侍从，替我扛长枪。他的脸，我已经想不起来了。你要是遇见他，替我跟他说声对不起。有一天早上，我问了他叫什么名字。

text.en: Do not follow me. What I am doing has nothing to do with you.
text.zh: 别跟着我。我做的事，跟你没有关系。

text.en: The ash on my hands does not wash off. It never did, for any of us who kept the flames.
text.zh: 我手上的灰洗不掉。以前守火的人，都是这样。

lines.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment.
lines.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。

text.en: The roads east take longer than the maps say. Each month I must set out earlier to arrive before dark.
text.zh: 往东的路，实际走起来比地图上标的要久。我每个月都得比上个月早些动身，才能赶在天黑前到。

text.en: I ride, I deliver, and I ride on. Please do not ask me what the letters say. I am not permitted to read them.
text.zh: 我只管骑马送信，送到了就走。请不要问我信里写了什么，我无权拆阅。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。

lines.en: The wool comes off Dusklea, and I boil the dye from herbs. Winter's coming, and every yard of cloth will be wanted.
lines.zh: 羊毛是暮牧原上来的，染料是拿草药煮的。冬天快到了，织多少布都不嫌多。

lines.en: Gus is out at the wood all day and comes home too tired to eat. I keep the house, and I see that he eats.
lines.zh: 格斯成天在林子里砍柴，回到家累得饭都不想吃。家里的事我管着，饭也得看着他吃下去。

text.en: I can hear a thread go slack before I see it. The loom sounds duller.
text.zh: 线一松，我不用看就听得出来，织机的声音会发闷。

text.en: Gus snores like the kiln. We've been married thirty years, and I sleep right through it.
text.zh: 格斯打呼噜跟窑炉似的。我们成亲三十年了，我早听惯了，倒头就睡。

text.en: You're new here. I'm Cass, Gus's wife. He's out in the wood most days, and I'm at my loom by the square.
text.zh: 你是新来的吧。我叫卡丝，格斯是我男人。他白天多半在林子里砍柴，我就在广场边上织布。

text.en: The wool comes off Dusklea, and I boil the dye from herbs. Winter's coming, and every yard of cloth will be wanted.
text.zh: 羊毛是暮牧原上来的，染料是拿草药煮的。冬天快到了，织多少布都不嫌多。

text.en: Gus is out at the wood all day and comes home too tired to eat. I keep the house, and I see that he eats.
text.zh: 格斯成天在林子里砍柴，回到家累得饭都不想吃。家里的事我管着，饭也得看着他吃下去。

text.en: There's a fire on the square and Marta has something in the pot. Come and sit, if you like.
text.zh: 广场上生着火，玛尔塔锅里还煮着东西。你想坐就过来坐吧。

text.en: Someone died, and nobody here will say how. With everyone keeping their mouths shut like that, I can't sleep at night.
text.zh: 有人死了，可村里谁也不肯说是怎么死的。大家都闭着嘴，我夜里睡不安稳。

text.en: Oh, thank you. I'll save half for Gus.
text.zh: 哎呀，谢谢你。我留一半给格斯。

text.en: For me? Well... thank you.
text.zh: 给我的？哎……谢谢你。

lines.en: Whoever feeds me, I'll carry their pack and fight for them. A few coins and a meal, that's all. Nobody's asked yet.
lines.zh: 谁管我饭，我就给谁背东西、替谁打架。几个钱加一顿饭就行。到今天还没人找过我。

lines.en: The village watch takes a second look at me every time they pass. I know what they're thinking.
lines.zh: 村里的卫兵每回从我身边过，都要多看我两眼。他们在想什么，我清楚得很。

text.en: I'll sit by the fire a while and then go. Nobody asked me, I know. But it's bitter out there.
text.zh: 我在火边坐一会儿就走。没人请我，我知道。可外面实在太冷了。

text.en: I've driven wagons for traders and hauled crates on the docks. Then the storm cut the road, and now there's no work at all.
text.zh: 我给商队赶过车，也在码头上扛过货。风暴把路冲断了，现在什么活儿都没有。

text.en: Don't look at me like that. I'm Vigo. The storm left me stranded here; I'm not looking for trouble.
text.zh: 别那样看我。我叫维戈，是被风暴困在这儿的，不是来惹事的。

text.en: Whoever feeds me, I'll carry their pack and fight for them. A few coins and a meal, that's all. Nobody's asked yet.
text.zh: 谁管我饭，我就给谁背东西、替谁打架。几个钱加一顿饭就行。到今天还没人找过我。

text.en: The village watch takes a second look at me every time they pass. I know what they're thinking.
text.zh: 村里的卫兵每回从我身边过，都要多看我两眼。他们在想什么，我清楚得很。

text.en: It's bitter at night, colder than sleeping on the road. I'll find a corner out of the wind and make do.
text.zh: 夜里冷得厉害，比睡在路上还冷。我找个背风的墙角凑合一晚。

text.en: Don't look at me. …All right, fine. I was hungry.
text.zh: 别看我。……好吧，好吧。我是饿了。

text.en: Oh — gods. Thank you. I owe you for this. Ask, and I'll come with you.
text.zh: 哦，天哪。谢谢你。这份情我记着。你要人帮忙，开口就行，我跟你走。

text.en: Coin's better, but I won't say no.
text.zh: 要是钱就更好了，不过我不会推辞。

lines.en: Two ore and a lump of coal in the forge make two bars. Then the anvil: a dagger, a spear, a helmet. Start small.
lines.zh: 炉子里放两块矿石、一块煤，能炼出两块铁锭。然后上铁砧打：匕首、长矛、头盔都行。先从小件打起。

lines.en: The better you know the craft, the better what you make. Nobody makes masterwork on their first day.
lines.zh: 手艺越熟，打出来的东西越好。没有人头一天就能打出精品。

lines.en: Garrick taught me in Emberfall. If he saw my welds now he'd say I'd got lazy, and he'd be right.
lines.zh: 我是在余烬镇跟加里克学的手艺。他要是看到我现在的焊口，准说我偷懒了。他说得也没错。

ties.npc.garrick: the master who taught him, in Emberfall

text.en: Garrick always kept his forge hotter than I keep mine. He said iron should be worked as hot as it will take. I never could stand at the fire as long as he could.
text.zh: 加里克的炉子一向烧得比我的旺。他说铁要趁最热的时候打。他能在炉边站多久，我可站不了那么久。

text.en: I came west to shoe the drovers' horses. There are hardly any drovers now, so mostly I mend hoes and hinges.
text.zh: 我当初来西边，是给赶牲口的人钉马掌的。现在赶牲口的没几个了，我多半是在修锄头和门轴。

text.en: A new face! I'm Haldor, the smith. The forge is lit and the anvil is free. Bring ore and coal, carry a hammer, and you can make your own. I sell the hammer.
text.zh: 新面孔啊！我叫哈尔多，这里的铁匠。炉子生着火，铁砧也空着。你带矿石和煤来，手里拿把锻锤，就能自己打东西。锻锤我这儿有卖。

text.en: Two ore and a lump of coal in the forge make two bars. Then the anvil: a dagger, a spear, a helmet. Start small.
text.zh: 炉子里放两块矿石、一块煤，能炼出两块铁锭。然后上铁砧打：匕首、长矛、头盔都行。先从小件打起。

text.en: The better you know the craft, the better what you make. Nobody makes masterwork on their first day.
text.zh: 手艺越熟，打出来的东西越好。没有人头一天就能打出精品。

text.en: Garrick taught me in Emberfall. If he saw my welds now he'd say I'd got lazy, and he'd be right.
text.zh: 我是在余烬镇跟加里克学的手艺。他要是看到我现在的焊口，准说我偷懒了。他说得也没错。

text.en: Last heat of the day. Then supper.
text.zh: 今天最后一火了。打完就吃饭。

text.en: Rain on hot iron. Listen to it hiss.
text.zh: 雨点落在热铁上，你听，滋滋地响。

text.en: Thanks. If I can't use it as it is, I'll melt it down. Nothing goes to waste in a smithy.
text.zh: 谢了。能直接用就用，用不上我就拿去回炉。铁匠铺里没有浪费的东西。

lines.en: Take a torch before you go into the woods. Two, if you're going to the barrow.
lines.zh: 进林子前带一支火把。要是去长眠冢，带两支。

lines.en: Marta bakes the bread and I sell it. She says I charge too little. I don't want anyone here going without.
lines.zh: 面包是玛尔塔烤的，我只管卖。她嫌我卖得太便宜。便宜就便宜吧，我不想村里有人买不起。

ties.npc.marta: buys her bread for the shelf

text.en: I keep a book behind the counter of what each house buys. When a house that always comes stops coming, I go and knock on the door.
text.zh: 柜台后面我记着一本账，哪家常买什么都写着。哪家平常总来、忽然不来了，我就去敲敲他家的门。

text.en: The drovers used to bring the news along with the cattle. Since the storms cut the road they don't come, and I'm the last to hear anything.
text.zh: 以前赶牲口的人路过，会把外头的消息一起捎来。自从风暴把路截断，他们就不来了，外头出了什么事，我总是最后一个知道。

text.en: Come in out of the wind. Lamps, rope, bread, a potion for the road — it's all on the shelves; pay at the counter. And if you have herbs or hides, bring them to me. I pay fair.
text.zh: 快进来，外头风大。灯、绳子、面包、路上喝的药水，都在架子上，挑好了到柜台结账。你要是有草药和皮子，也拿来卖给我，我给公道价。

text.en: Take a torch before you go into the woods. Two, if you're going to the barrow.
text.zh: 进林子前带一支火把。要是去长眠冢，带两支。

text.en: Marta bakes the bread and I sell it. She says I charge too little. I don't want anyone here going without.
text.zh: 面包是玛尔塔烤的，我只管卖。她嫌我卖得太便宜。便宜就便宜吧，我不想村里有人买不起。

text.en: I'm closing soon. If you need anything, buy it now; otherwise I open again at seven.
text.zh: 快打烊了。要买什么趁现在，不然就明早七点再来。

text.en: Rain brings customers. Nobody wants to be out in it.
text.zh: 一下雨，店里人就多了。谁也不想在外头淋着。

text.en: For me? I'll put it in the window.
text.zh: 给我的？那我把它摆在窗台上。

lines.en: The common books are for anyone. The ones for a road — dagger, shield, bow or staff — cost more, and teach only those who walk it.
lines.zh: 普通的书谁都能学。专讲一条路的——匕首、盾、弓、法杖——要贵一些，也只有走那条路的人学得会。

lines.en: I have read every book on that stand, and I cannot do a single thing that is in them. My hands were slow when I was young, and they are slower now.
lines.zh: 架子上的书，我每一本都读过，可书里的本事，我一样也使不出来。年轻时手脚就慢，现在更慢了。

ties.npc.ilse: the sister whose chapel he serves

text.en: These books were copied at the monastery over the pass, before the storms, and carried down. I ask only what the carrying cost. Whether any more will come, I do not know.
text.zh: 这些书都是起风暴以前，山口那边的修道院抄好送下山来的。我卖的价钱，只够抵运下来的路费。往后还有没有新的，我也不知道。

text.en: The monastery copied by candlelight. The winter books have drops of wax on their pages; you can tell them at a glance.
text.zh: 修道院是点着蜡烛抄书的。冬天抄的那几本，书页上落着蜡点，一翻就认得出来。

text.en: Welcome to Firstlight's chapel. Sister Ilse keeps the flame; I keep the books. They teach what the hands can learn: a strike, a step, a word of fire. Take one to the light and read it through, and it will stay with you.
text.zh: 欢迎来到初原村的礼拜堂。圣火由伊尔丝修女照看，书由我照看。这些书教的都是手上的功夫：怎么出一击，怎么走一步，怎么念一句火焰的咒语。拿一本到亮处读完，学到的就是你的了。

text.en: The common books are for anyone. The ones for a road — dagger, shield, bow or staff — cost more, and teach only those who walk it.
text.zh: 普通的书谁都能学。专讲一条路的——匕首、盾、弓、法杖——要贵一些，也只有走那条路的人学得会。

text.en: I have read every book on that stand, and I cannot do a single thing that is in them. My hands were slow when I was young, and they are slower now.
text.zh: 架子上的书，我每一本都读过，可书里的本事，我一样也使不出来。年轻时手脚就慢，现在更慢了。

text.en: I light the candles at dusk. Sit a while if you like; the chapel is not locked at night.
text.zh: 黄昏了，我去把蜡烛点上。你想坐就坐一会儿吧，礼拜堂夜里也不锁门。

text.en: Thank you. The chapel will put it to use.
text.zh: 谢谢你。礼拜堂用得着它。

lines.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. I say it at the altar every morning, and on the hard mornings I say it twice.
lines.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。我每天早上都在祭坛前念一遍，日子难熬的时候，就念两遍。

lines.en: There are five shrines on the road, one for each suffering. Lay at each what it asks: a thing for the head, a cord, a meal, metal, a light.
lines.zh: 路上有五座圣龛，一苦一座。每座龛前放上它要的东西：戴在头上的一样，一根绳，一顿饭，一块金属，一盏灯。

lines.en: They say the Seal-bearer on the Sunrise Road was a gentle man. I never met him; that is how Wynn's old rhyme tells it.
lines.zh: 听说朝阳大道上那位持印者，从前是个很温和的人。我没见过他，温唱的那首老童谣里是这么说的。

text.en: I set out as a pilgrim myself, when I was young. I got as far as this Rest, and stayed. Someone has to keep the door here.
text.zh: 我年轻时也是朝圣者。走到这座驿站，就没再往前走，留了下来。这里总得有人守着门。

text.en: Have some tea before you go, if you have the time. The well here is deep and the water is good; pilgrims fill their skins here before they go east.
text.zh: 有空的话，喝杯茶再走。这里的井打得深，水好，朝圣者往东去之前，都在这里把水囊灌满。

text.en: Peace on your road, pilgrim. I am Father Caius. The Holy See keeps me at this Rest to bless the pilgrims it sends east, and to keep the five wounds.
text.zh: 愿你一路平安，朝圣者。我是凯乌斯司铎。圣座派我驻守这座驿站，为往东去的朝圣者祝福，并看守五道圣伤。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment. I say it at the altar every morning, and on the hard mornings I say it twice.
text.zh: 苦难并非神的遗弃。我每天早上都在祭坛前念一遍，日子难熬的时候，就念两遍。

text.en: There are five shrines on the road, one for each suffering. Lay at each what it asks: a thing for the head, a cord, a meal, metal, a light.
text.zh: 路上有五座圣龛，一苦一座。每座龛前放上它要的东西：戴在头上的一样，一根绳，一顿饭，一块金属，一盏灯。

text.en: They say the Seal-bearer on the Sunrise Road was a gentle man. I never met him; that is how Wynn's old rhyme tells it.
text.zh: 听说朝阳大道上那位持印者，从前是个很温和的人。我没见过他，温唱的那首老童谣里是这么说的。

text.en: Evening has come early again. I write the hour in my book, and Sister Ilse writes it in hers, and we send each other the numbers by the pilgrims.
text.zh: 黄昏又提早了。我把时辰记进册子，伊尔丝修女也在她那边记，我们托朝圣者把数字捎给对方。

text.en: You found the writ. ...Yes. I knew. I was told it was not a pilgrim's concern, and I decided to believe it. Go on. Don't look at me like that.
text.zh: 你找到那份文书了。……是，我知道这件事。上面跟我说，这不是朝圣者该过问的，我就决定信了。走吧。别那样看着我。

text.en: Three hundred years, and in the end it took one pilgrim and a fairy. God forgive us for letting him hold so long.
text.zh: 三百年。到头来，只用了一个朝圣者和一个精灵。我们竟让他守了这么久，愿神宽恕我们。

text.en: The road east is open. Go on when you are ready, pilgrim. Four more Seal-bearers wait, and the Crown is only the first of the five.
text.zh: 往东的路通了。准备好了就上路吧，朝圣者。还有四位持印者在等你，荆棘冠只是五件圣器里的第一件。

lines.en: Each shrine wants what its suffering asks. The crown wants something for the head; the scourge wants a cord. I have given them all my cords.
lines.zh: 每座圣龛要的，是它那一苦的东西。荆冠那座要戴在头上的，鞭刑那座要一根绳。我的绳子全都给出去了。

lines.en: At the Rest they taught me that every stroke I take is one Astra need not. So every evening I take a few.
lines.zh: 驿站里教我，我每挨一鞭，阿斯特拉就能少挨一鞭。所以每天晚上，我都抽自己几下。

lines.en: The abbey up the hill is where they made him a knight. I won't go in. The dead there still keep the hours.
lines.zh: 山上那座修道院，是他受封骑士的地方。我不进去。里面的死人，到现在还按着时辰念祷文。

text.en: My feet are bad this year. I wrap them in rags each morning and walk until the rags wear through. Then I stop for the day.
text.zh: 今年我的脚不大好。每天早上拿布条缠上，走到布条磨穿了，这一天就不走了。

text.en: At the Rest they give you bread when you set out. I gave mine to a family on the road in the first week. Since then I eat what people give me.
text.zh: 出发的时候，驿站会给每人发面包。头一个礼拜，我就把我那份给了路边的一家人。从那以后，别人给什么我就吃什么。

text.en: I'm Ezra, a penitent. Every year I walk a little further east along this road, and kneel at the shrines.
text.zh: 我叫以斯拉，是个苦修的人。我每年都沿着这条路往东多走一段，在圣龛前跪拜。

text.en: Each shrine wants what its suffering asks. The crown wants something for the head; the scourge wants a cord. I have given them all my cords.
text.zh: 每座圣龛要的，是它那一苦的东西。荆冠那座要戴在头上的，鞭刑那座要一根绳。我的绳子全都给出去了。

text.en: At the Rest they taught me that every stroke I take is one Astra need not. So every evening I take a few.
text.zh: 驿站里教我，我每挨一鞭，阿斯特拉就能少挨一鞭。所以每天晚上，我都抽自己几下。

text.en: The abbey up the hill is where they made him a knight. I won't go in. The dead there still keep the hours.
text.zh: 山上那座修道院，是他受封骑士的地方。我不进去。里面的死人，到现在还按着时辰念祷文。

text.en: All five burning. I have walked this road eleven years and never seen them all lit at once. Go up to the abbey, pilgrim.
text.zh: 五座都点亮了。我在这条路上走了十一年，从没见过五座同时亮着。上山去修道院吧，朝圣者。

text.en: They say he knelt at the end. To you. I saw him once, years ago, sitting in the field mending a flag. I did not think then that he wanted to fight anyone.
text.zh: 听说他最后跪下了，是向你跪的。我早些年见过他一回，他坐在田里补一面旗子。那时候我就觉得，他并不想跟谁打。

lines.en: Wynn's grandmother taught her a rhyme about the White Knight. It used to be sung to get children to sleep. Now when she sings it, the grown-ups go quiet.
lines.zh: 温的奶奶教过她一首白骑士的童谣。那首歌以前是哄孩子睡觉唱的。现在她一唱，旁边的大人就都不说话了。

lines.en: The hostel book has a page of the names of people who went east. I read it every night. I know I shouldn't.
lines.zh: 客舍的名册里有一页，记的都是往东去的人。我每天晚上都去翻。我知道不该翻。

text.en: Wynn asked me if the sun is tired. I told her no. But it really does get dark earlier every day, and I don't know what to tell her.
text.zh: 温问我，太阳是不是累了。我跟她说没有。可天确实一天比一天黑得早，我也不知道该怎么跟她说。

text.en: We only packed enough food to reach the Holy City. Every day we stay here is a day of it gone.
text.zh: 我们带的干粮只够走到圣城。在这儿多住一天，就少一天的口粮。

text.en: Are you a pilgrim too? I'm Maud, and this is my daughter, Wynn. We were meant to go all the way to the Holy City. When we got here, we heard there's a knight on the road east who lets no one past. So we stopped.
text.zh: 你也是朝圣的吧？我叫莫德，这是我女儿温。我们本来要一路走到圣城去的。到了这儿才听说，东边的路上有个骑士拦着，谁也过不去。我们就停下来了。

text.en: Wynn's grandmother taught her a rhyme about the White Knight. It used to be sung to get children to sleep. Now when she sings it, the grown-ups go quiet.
text.zh: 温的奶奶教过她一首白骑士的童谣。那首歌以前是哄孩子睡觉唱的。现在她一唱，旁边的大人就都不说话了。

text.en: The hostel book has a page of the names of people who went east. I read it every night. I know I shouldn't.
text.zh: 客舍的名册里有一页，记的都是往东去的人。我每天晚上都去翻。我知道不该翻。

text.en: The road's open? Then we can go on. ...Thank you. Now I can teach Wynn the last verse of that rhyme. The one where he kneels.
text.zh: 路通了？那我们可以接着走了。……谢谢你。现在我可以教温那首童谣的最后一段了，就是他跪下的那段。

lines.en: "The White Knight rides, the White Knight bends, / he mends your kite and he minds your friends, / he kneels to the small and he stands for the weak—" ...Gran never finished it. She said the end went wrong.
lines.zh: "白骑士骑马来，白骑士弯下腰，/ 帮你补风筝，替你看朋友，/ 他向小孩子下跪，替弱者站着——"……奶奶从来没唱完过。她说结尾变了。

lines.en: Mama says we're not going east. I think the knight just forgot the end of his rhyme.
lines.zh: 妈妈说我们不往东走了。我觉得那个骑士只是忘了他那首童谣的结尾。

text.en: I'm eight and a quarter. The quarter counts.
text.zh: 我八岁零三个月了。那三个月也要算。

text.en: Mama counts the names in the book every night. I count the stars. I always get more.
text.zh: 妈妈每天晚上数名册上的名字。我数星星。我数得比她多。

text.en: Is that a FAIRY? Can she do magic? Can she sing the White Knight's rhyme? I can.
text.zh: 那是精灵吗？她会变魔法吗？她会唱白骑士的童谣吗？我会唱！

text.en: "The White Knight rides, the White Knight bends, / he mends your kite and he minds your friends, / he kneels to the small and he stands for the weak—" ...Gran never finished it. She said the end went wrong.
text.zh: "白骑士骑马来，白骑士弯下腰，/ 帮你补风筝，替你看朋友，/ 他向小孩子下跪，替弱者站着——"……奶奶从来没唱完过。她说结尾变了。

text.en: Mama says we're not going east. I think the knight just forgot the end of his rhyme.
text.zh: 妈妈说我们不往东走了。我觉得那个骑士只是忘了他那首童谣的结尾。

text.en: You saw him? Did he kneel? I KNEW he would. That's the end of the rhyme: "and when they come, he kneels again."
text.zh: 你见到他了？他跪下了吗？我就知道他会的。那就是童谣的结尾："等他们来了，他又会跪下。"

lines.en: Gus brings me logs when his back lets him. His back lets him less and less. Mine too.
lines.zh: 格斯腰还行的时候会给我送木头来。他的腰越来越不行了。我的也是。

lines.en: The birds came the night the bridge went. Every one in Hushwood, into my oak, and not a note out of them since. I cut a notch for every day. The board is getting full.
lines.zh: 桥没了的那天晚上，鸟就来了。整座林子的鸟，全落在我那棵橡树上，从那以后一声都没叫过。我每天刻一道痕。板子快刻满了。

lines.en: Boars. They root up the coppice stools and the young shoots never come. Six years of growing, gone in a night.
lines.zh: 野猪。它们把矮林的树桩拱翻，新芽就再也发不出来了。六年的功夫，一夜就没了。

text.en: Once a clamp is sealed you leave it be, but you still get up every hour to look at the smoke. Yellow smoke is good. Black means it wants more earth on it.
text.zh: 炭窑封上以后就别去动它，可每个钟头还是得起来看一眼烟。冒黄烟是好的，冒黑烟就得往上补土。

text.en: Forty years of charcoal, and the smoke won't wash out of me. When my wife was alive she made me shake my clothes out at the door before I came in.
text.zh: 烧了四十年炭，身上的烟味是洗不掉了。我老婆在的时候，总要我在门外把衣服抖干净了才准进屋。

text.en: Orrin. I burn charcoal. A clamp takes four days and you sleep next to it or you lose it, so I sleep next to it. You want coal, I have coal.
text.zh: 我叫奥林，烧炭的。一窑炭要烧四天，不睡在旁边就得废掉，所以我就睡在旁边。你要炭，我这儿有炭。

text.en: Gus brings me logs when his back lets him. His back lets him less and less. Mine too.
text.zh: 格斯腰还行的时候会给我送木头来。他的腰越来越不行了。我的也是。

text.en: The birds came the night the bridge went. Every one in Hushwood, into my oak, and not a note out of them since. I cut a notch for every day. The board is getting full.
text.zh: 桥没了的那天晚上，鸟就来了。整座林子的鸟，全落在我那棵橡树上，从那以后一声都没叫过。我每天刻一道痕。板子快刻满了。

text.en: Boars. They root up the coppice stools and the young shoots never come. Six years of growing, gone in a night.
text.zh: 野猪。它们把矮林的树桩拱翻，新芽就再也发不出来了。六年的功夫，一夜就没了。

text.en: You saw them too. Every one of them facing east, like they're waiting for something to come down that road. I still cut a notch every day. When the board's full I'll find another.
text.zh: 你也看见了。它们全都朝着东边，像是在等什么东西从那条路上过来。我还是每天刻一道痕。板子刻满了，我就再找一块。

text.en: For the clamp? Good. It all burns.
text.zh: 给窑里的？好。什么都能烧。

lines.en: Forty years on this water, and I never once saw a god in it. Fish, weed and fog, that's all.
lines.zh: 我在这条河上打了四十年鱼，从没在水里见过什么神。见过的只有鱼、水草和雾。

lines.en: Eels bite after dark, pike in the deep, sunfish when the sun is on the water. A rod is two sticks and two handfuls of grass. Bait makes them bite twice as fast.
lines.zh: 鳗鱼天黑以后才咬钩，狗鱼待在深水里，太阳鱼要等太阳照到水面上。两根树枝加两把草，就能做根鱼竿。挂上饵，鱼咬钩要快一倍。

lines.en: My Rolf went out in the fog nine winters back. The boat came home by itself. The bell's still out on the spit, with the slimes. I don't go out there.
lines.zh: 九年前的冬天，我家罗尔夫在雾里出船。后来船自己漂回来了，人没回来。船上的铃还落在沙洲上，跟那些史莱姆在一块儿。那地方我不去。

text.en: I smoke the eels over alder. Two days on the rack and they keep till spring.
text.zh: 鳗鱼我用桤木熏。在架子上熏两天，能放到开春。

text.en: Fog on the bend means eels in the morning. Rolf taught me that. It still holds.
text.zh: 河湾起雾，第二天早上鳗鱼就多。罗尔夫教我的，到现在也没错过。

text.en: Hilde. I fish. If it's fish you want, I have fish. I'm not much for talk.
text.zh: 我叫希尔德，打鱼的。要鱼的话，我这儿有。说话我不在行。

text.en: Forty years on this water, and I never once saw a god in it. Fish, weed and fog, that's all.
text.zh: 我在这条河上打了四十年鱼，从没在水里见过什么神。见过的只有鱼、水草和雾。

text.en: Eels bite after dark, pike in the deep, sunfish when the sun is on the water. A rod is two sticks and two handfuls of grass. Bait makes them bite twice as fast.
text.zh: 鳗鱼天黑以后才咬钩，狗鱼待在深水里，太阳鱼要等太阳照到水面上。两根树枝加两把草，就能做根鱼竿。挂上饵，鱼咬钩要快一倍。

text.en: My Rolf went out in the fog nine winters back. The boat came home by itself. The bell's still out on the spit, with the slimes. I don't go out there.
text.zh: 九年前的冬天，我家罗尔夫在雾里出船。后来船自己漂回来了，人没回来。船上的铃还落在沙洲上，跟那些史莱姆在一块儿。那地方我不去。

text.en: It rings the same. I thought it would ring different. ...Thank you. I'll hang it over the door, so he knows which one is ours.
text.zh: 还是那个声音。我还以为会不一样了。……谢谢你。我把它挂在门口，好让他认得哪间是我们家。

text.en: The stone? It was here before the village. Before the Church came and told us what to be sorry for. Whoever cut it thought giving a child a fish was worth remembering. So do I.
text.zh: 那块石头？村子还没有的时候它就在那儿了，比教会来教我们该为什么忏悔还早。刻它的人觉得，给孩子一条鱼这件事值得刻下来。我也这么觉得。

text.en: Fish for the smoke? Good. Set it there.
text.zh: 给熏房的鱼？好，放那儿吧。

lines.en: It's ten marks and three wildflowers a time. Hair, face, the colour of your coat — I can change any of it.
lines.zh: 做一次是十枚晨辉币，外加三枝野花。头发、脸、衣服的颜色，哪样都能换。

lines.en: Greta always says I talk too much with scissors in my hand. I've cut her hair every month since I came, and I've never nicked her once.
lines.zh: 葛瑞塔总说我拿着剪刀还说个不停。我来了以后每个月都给她剪头发，一回都没剪着过她。

text.en: Don't laugh at my hair. I do everyone else's all day and never get round to my own.
text.zh: 我自己的头发乱成这样，你可别笑。一整天都在给别人弄，轮不到我自己。

text.en: In the Holy City the ladies wanted gold on everything. Here a sprig of wildflowers looks lovely, and honestly, I like it better.
text.zh: 在圣城，太太们什么都要镶金。到了这儿，别一枝野花就很好看了。说实话，我更喜欢这样。

text.en: New face! Sit, sit. I'm Odette — I do hair, and anything else about you that wants doing. Bring me wildflowers if you find any; I'm always short.
text.zh: 生面孔！坐，坐。我叫奥黛特，做头发的——你身上还有哪儿想改改，也可以找我。看见野花的话给我带点来，我总是不够用。

text.en: It's ten marks and three wildflowers a time. Hair, face, the colour of your coat — I can change any of it.
text.zh: 做一次是十枚晨辉币，外加三枝野花。头发、脸、衣服的颜色，哪样都能换。

text.en: Greta always says I talk too much with scissors in my hand. I've cut her hair every month since I came, and I've never nicked her once.
text.zh: 葛瑞塔总说我拿着剪刀还说个不停。我来了以后每个月都给她剪头发，一回都没剪着过她。

text.en: The light goes and so does my work. Come back when I can see your face.
text.zh: 天一黑，我的活儿也就停了。等我能看清你的脸再来吧。

text.en: Rain. Everyone will come in with their hair flat and blame me.
text.zh: 下雨了。待会儿人人都会顶着塌下来的头发进来，然后怪我。

text.en: Oh — wildflowers! You remembered. These go in the window today.
text.zh: 哎呀，野花！你还记着呢。今天就摆到窗边去。

text.en: For me? You are sweet. Thank you.
text.zh: 给我的？你真好。谢谢。

summary.en: You woke in a clearing in the woods, with a fairy called Lumi at your side. Get through a day and a night here, then take the path south down the mountain.
summary.zh: 你在林间的一片空地上醒来，身边有一个叫露米的精灵。在这里过完一天一夜，再沿小路往南下山。

text.en: Find something to eat
text.zh: 找点吃的

text.en: Gather sticks, stones and grass
text.zh: 收集树枝、石头和草

text.en: Make a stone axe
text.zh: 做一把石斧

text.en: Fell a tree and split planks
text.zh: 砍树，劈出木板

text.en: Build a campfire and light it
text.zh: 搭一堆营火并点燃

text.en: Build a house with a bed
text.zh: 盖一间有床的屋子

text.en: Get through the night
text.zh: 熬过这一夜

text.en: Take the path south
text.zh: 沿小路往南走

log.en: I woke in a clearing. I don't remember how I got here.
log.zh: 我在一片空地上醒来，不记得自己是怎么到这儿的。

hint.en: {key:move} to walk. {key:hands} picks up the thing your mouse points at. Take it in hand with {key:slots}, then left click to eat it.
hint.zh: 用 {key:move} 走路。{key:hands} 捡起鼠标指着的东西。按 {key:slots} 把它拿在手上，再按左键吃掉。

log.en: A fairy called Lumi woke me. I need something to eat first.
log.zh: 一个叫露米的精灵把我叫醒了。我得先找点吃的。

say.en: Come over here. {key:move} to walk.
say.zh: 到这边来，用 {key:move} 走路。

say.en: Berries! Walk up to them and press {key:hands}.
say.zh: 有浆果！走到旁边，按 {key:hands} 捡起来。

say.en: Now take them in hand: press their number on the toolbar.
say.zh: 把浆果拿到手上：按快捷栏上那一格的数字。

say.en: Left click to eat what you're holding.
say.zh: 按左键，把手里的东西吃掉。

hint.en: They lie all over the Waking Glade, and more keep turning up. {key:hands} picks them up; {key:bag} opens your bag.
hint.zh: 空地上到处都是，捡完了还会再有。按 {key:hands} 捡起来，按 {key:bag} 打开背包。

log.en: I've eaten. To make anything, I need sticks, stones and grass.
log.zh: 吃过了。要做东西，得先有树枝、石头和草。

say.en: {key:bag} opens your bag. Everything you carry is in it.
say.zh: 按 {key:bag} 打开背包，身上带的东西都在里面。

say.en: There's a stick. Pick it up with {key:hands}.
say.zh: 那儿有根树枝，按 {key:hands} 捡起来。

say.en: Now a stone.
say.zh: 再捡一块石头。

say.en: And a tuft of grass.
say.zh: 还有一把草。

hint.en: {key:craft} opens crafting. A stone axe takes a stick, a stone and a tuft of grass.
hint.zh: 按 {key:craft} 打开制作。一把石斧要一根树枝、一块石头和一把草。

log.en: I have enough for an axe.
log.zh: 够做一把斧头了。

say.en: {key:craft} opens crafting. Make the stone axe.
say.zh: 按 {key:craft} 打开制作，做一把石斧。

hint.en: Hold the axe and left click a tree until it falls; it leaves logs. Left click a log with the axe to split it into planks.
hint.zh: 拿着斧头左键点树，一直砍到它倒下，会留下原木。再拿斧头左键点原木，就劈成了木板。

log.en: I made a stone axe. Now I need wood.
log.zh: 做好了一把石斧。接下来要木头。

say.en: Take the axe in hand.
say.zh: 把斧头拿到手上。

say.en: Go to the trees in the grove to the east and left click one, again and again.
say.zh: 去东边林子里找棵树，按左键一下一下地砍。

say.en: Open {key:craft} and make the logs into planks. You only need the axe on you.
say.zh: 按 {key:craft}，把原木做成木板。身上带着斧头就行。

hint.en: {key:build} opens building; a campfire is a ring of stones and sticks. Then make a torch with {key:craft} (a stick and grass), hold it and left click the fire.
hint.zh: 按 {key:build} 打开建造，营火用石头和树枝搭。再按 {key:craft} 做一支火把（树枝加草），拿在手上左键点营火。

log.en: I have planks. Night comes early in the woods; I should light a fire first.
log.zh: 有木板了。林子里天黑得早，得先生一堆火。

say.en: {key:build} opens building. Set down a campfire.
say.zh: 按 {key:build} 打开建造，放一堆营火。

say.en: Now make a torch with {key:craft}: a stick and some grass.
say.zh: 再按 {key:craft} 做一支火把，要树枝和草。

say.en: Hold the torch and left click the fire.
say.zh: 拿着火把，左键点营火。

hint.en: {key:craft} makes walls, a door, a floor and a bed out of planks. Take one in hand and right click where it should go; hold and drag to lay a row. Put walls and a door round you, and the bed inside. The ceiling is a floor laid over your head, drawn one tile higher: with a floor in hand press {key:rotate}, then right click just above your head. (In building, {key:build}, {key:rotate} also turns a floor into a ceiling.)
hint.zh: {key:craft} 可以用木板做墙、门、地板和床。拿在手上，右键点哪里就放在哪里，按住拖动能放一排。用墙和门把自己围起来，床放在里面。天花板就是盖在头顶上的地板，画在高一格的位置：手里拿着地板按 {key:rotate}，再右键点头顶上方那一格。（在建造模式 {key:build} 里，按 {key:rotate} 也能把地板换成天花板。）

log.en: The fire is lit. Now I need a roof over my head.
log.zh: 火生起来了。现在得有个遮风挡雨的地方。

say.en: In {key:build}, choose a wall and put the first one on the outline.
say.zh: 在 {key:build} 里选墙，第一面放在画好的轮廓上。

say.en: Wall yourself round, and put in a door.
say.zh: 把墙围起来，再装一扇门。

say.en: A bed inside.
say.zh: 屋里放一张床。

say.en: Last, a ceiling: choose the floor in {key:build} and press {key:rotate} to make it a ceiling.
say.zh: 最后是天花板：在 {key:build} 里选地板，按 {key:rotate} 换成天花板。

hint.en: Things come out after dark. Sleep in your bed ({key:hands}). Eat something first, or hunger will wake you in the night. We leave at first light.
hint.zh: 天黑以后会有东西出来。到床上睡一觉（{key:hands}）。睡前先吃点东西，不然半夜会饿醒。天一亮我们就走。

log.en: I built a house. Now I only have to get through the night.
log.zh: 屋子盖好了。现在只要熬过今晚。

say.en: Hold {key:hands} on the bed. Everything in that cell is listed, and you can choose which one you mean.
say.zh: 对着床按住 {key:hands}，这一格里的东西都会列出来，你可以选要哪一样。

say.en: There's a dummy by the house. Left click it until it falls over.
say.zh: 屋子旁边有个假人，用左键打它，直到把它打倒。

say.en: Shut the door before dark: {key:hands}.
say.zh: 天黑前把门关上：按 {key:hands}。

say.en: Then sleep in your bed: {key:hands}.
say.zh: 然后上床睡觉：按 {key:hands}。

hint.en: The path out of the Waking Glade runs south, down to the foot of the mountain.
hint.zh: 空地南边有条小路，一直通到伤石山麓。

log.en: It's morning. Lumi says the path south is open now.
log.zh: 天亮了。露米说，南边的小路可以走了。

say.en: {key:map} opens the world map. Every place you've been is on it.
say.zh: 按 {key:map} 打开世界地图，去过的地方都在上面。

log.en: I've come down to the foot of the mountain.
log.zh: 下到伤石山麓了。

summary.en: You woke on the mountain with a fairy at your side. Go down past the old stone at Woundstone Foot, take the cliff stair down to Vesper Ford, and go west from there to the village.
summary.zh: 你在山上醒来，身边跟着一个精灵。下山去吧：经过伤石山麓那块古老的路碑，顺着悬崖台阶下到晚祷渡，再往西走到村子。

text.en: Find the shrine stone at Woundstone Foot
text.zh: 找到伤石山麓的路碑

text.en: Try something the world has never seen
text.zh: 做一件世界从没见过的事

text.en: Take the cliff stair down to Vesper Ford
text.zh: 顺着悬崖台阶下到晚祷渡

text.en: Go west to Firstlight Village
text.zh: 往西到初原村

hint.en: The only way down is the cut in the rocks to the south. Below it is Woundstone Foot, where an old stone stands. Do anything you like to it: use what you hold on it, put something on it, or strike it. Whatever you try, the world will answer.
hint.zh: 下山的路只有一条，是南边岩壁上的那道豁口。下面是伤石山麓，那里立着一块古老的路碑。对它做什么都可以：用手里的东西碰它，往上面放点东西，或者打它一下。不管你做什么，世界都会回应。

log.en: Lumi says the way down is to the south, through a cut in the rocks.
log.zh: 露米说，下山的路在南边，要从岩壁上的豁口下去。

hint.en: Do something to the old stone: use what you hold on it, put something on it, or strike it. Whatever you try, the world will answer.
hint.zh: 对路碑做点什么：用手里的东西碰它，往上面放点东西，或者打它一下。不管你做什么，世界都会回应。

log.en: An old stone with five marks cut in it; the first one is cracked. Lumi said it was cold near it.
log.zh: 一块古老的石头，上面刻着五道痕，第一道裂开了。露米说它旁边很冷。

hint.en: The trail goes on south, down off the mountain to Vesper Ford. What the world has learned is written in the Threadbook ({key:journal}).
hint.zh: 小路继续往南，一直下到山下的晚祷渡。世界学会的事都写在织线簿里（{key:journal}）。

log.en: I did something the world had never seen, and it answered. What it learns is kept in the Threadbook.
log.zh: 我做了一件世界从没见过的事，它给出了回应。它学会的东西都记在织线簿里。

hint.en: Hesper says two people from the village west of Vesper Ford are lost, and its elder, Rowan, is asking for anyone who can fight. Someone with a yellow "!" over their head has a task for you; talk to them with {key:hands}.
hint.zh: 赫斯珀说，晚祷渡西边的村子里有两个人失踪了，村里的长老罗万在找能打的人。头顶有黄色"！"的人有事要托你，按 {key:hands} 和他们说话。

log.en: I reached Vesper Ford. The bridge is broken and the ferry rope has snapped. Hesper, the ferrykeeper, sent me west to the village first.
log.zh: 到了晚祷渡。桥坏了，渡绳也断了。摆渡人赫斯珀让我先往西去村子里看看。

log.en: I came to Firstlight Village. A flame is kept burning in its chapel.
log.zh: 到了初原村。村里的礼拜堂供着一团圣火。

summary.en: Lina and Oskar went into Longsleep Barrow to the south for shelter the day the storm broke, and have not come back. Rowan, the village elder, has asked you to find them.
summary.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡在起风暴那天躲进了南边的长眠冢，一直没有回来。长老罗万托你去找他们。

text.en: Go south through Dusklea and Hushwood to the barrow mouth in Thornwood Hollow
text.zh: 往南穿过暮牧原和噤声林，到荆棘谷的长眠冢入口

text.en: Find Lina
text.zh: 找到莉娜

say.en: Took you long enough. ...The way's clear? Fine. Tell Rowan I'm alive — and tell him nothing else.
say.zh: 慢死了。……路通了？行吧。跟罗万说我还活着——别的什么都别说。

text.en: Find Oskar in the ossuary, on the second floor
text.zh: 到第二层的骸骨堂找到奥斯卡

say.en: About time. I'll follow the girl home. The warden is down at the bottom of the stairs. If it's still walking, watch yourself.
say.zh: 可算来了。我跟着那丫头回去。守墓者在楼梯最底下，它要是还在走动，你当心点。

text.en: Put down the warden in the sanctum, on the deepest floor
text.zh: 在最深一层的圣所打倒守墓者

text.en: Back to Rowan
text.zh: 回去找罗万

hint.en: The barrow is to the south, in Thornwood Hollow, past Dusklea and Hushwood. Its mouth is between two standing stones.
hint.zh: 长眠冢在南边的荆棘谷，要先穿过暮牧原和噤声林。入口在两块立石中间。

log.en: Rowan says Lina and Oskar went into Longsleep Barrow when the storm broke. He says the dead down there haven't been lying quiet.
log.zh: 罗万说，起风暴那天莉娜和奥斯卡进了长眠冢。他还说，长眠冢里的死人最近不肯安息。

log.en: I found them both and put the warden down. Now back to Rowan.
log.zh: 两个人都找到了，守墓者也倒下了。该回去找罗万了。

say.en: You brought them both home, and the thing in the barrow is down. Firstlight owes you. The village will give thanks for them at the flame; I hope you'll stay for it.
say.zh: 两个人都平安回来了，长眠冢里那个东西也倒下了。初原村欠你一份情。村里要在圣火前为他们感恩，希望你也留下来。

log.en: Lina and Oskar are home. The village is to give thanks for them at the flame.
log.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡回家了。村里要在圣火前为他们感恩。

log.en: I did all of it on my way east.
log.zh: 这些事，我在往东走的路上都办完了。

log.en: I went on east before it was done. Lina and Oskar found their own way home.
log.zh: 这件事没办完，我就往东去了。莉娜和奥斯卡自己找路回了家。

waiting.en: The barrow is to the south, in Thornwood Hollow, between two standing stones. Lina and Oskar — I'm counting on you.
waiting.zh: 长眠冢在南边的荆棘谷，两块立石中间。莉娜和奥斯卡，拜托你了。

summary.en: When someone comes home safe, Firstlight keeps a vigil at its flame, and Sister Ilse has asked you to help her prepare it. She needs lamp oil from the cellar at Millbrook, west of the village, dawnbloom from Dawn Hill to the north, and the old bell rung in the Chapel of the First Dawn on the hill's top.
summary.zh: 初原村有个规矩：有人平安归来，就在圣火前守夜。伊尔丝修女托你帮她准备：村子西边水车磨坊地窖里的灯油，北边晨光丘上的晨光花，还要去丘顶的初晓礼拜堂敲响那口旧钟。

text.en: Fetch the lamp oil from the mill cellar at Millbrook (west)
text.zh: 去西边水车磨坊的地窖取灯油

nudge.en: The oil! Here, before the shelves at the back. Two flasks!
nudge.zh: 灯油！在这儿，后面架子前头。要两瓶哦！

text.en: Pick dawnbloom on Dawn Hill (north)
text.zh: 去北边的晨光丘采晨光花

nudge.en: Hi, here! This one is dawnbloom — not the little flowers round it. Pick three!
nudge.zh: 嗨，在这里！这朵就是晨光花——不是旁边那些小花哦。要摘三朵！

text.en: Ring the bell in the Chapel of the First Dawn, on top of Dawn Hill
text.zh: 敲响晨光丘顶初晓礼拜堂里的钟

nudge.en: The bell is up here! Ring it!
nudge.zh: 钟就在这上面！敲响它吧！

text.en: Back to Sister Ilse
text.zh: 回去找伊尔丝修女

hint.en: Millbrook is west of the village; Tam keeps the lamp oil in his cellar. Dawn Hill is to the north: the dawnbloom grows on its east slope, and the chapel with the bell stands on its top.
hint.zh: 水车磨坊在村子西边，塔姆把灯油放在他的地窖里。晨光丘在村子北边：晨光花长在东坡上，那口钟在丘顶的礼拜堂里。

log.en: Sister Ilse is preparing a vigil for Lina and Oskar. She asked me to fetch lamp oil and dawnbloom, and to ring the old bell on Dawn Hill.
log.zh: 伊尔丝修女在为莉娜和奥斯卡准备守夜。她托我取灯油、采晨光花，再去晨光丘敲响那口旧钟。

log.en: I have the oil and the dawnbloom, and the bell has been rung. Back to Sister Ilse.
log.zh: 灯油和晨光花都有了，钟也敲过了。回去找伊尔丝修女。

say.en: The lamps are trimmed, and the bell has been rung. Thank you for going so far for us. ...And this time I did not lose a single wick. Tonight after dark Firstlight gives thanks at the flame. Please stay for it.
say.zh: 灯都备好了，钟也敲过了。辛苦你走了这么远的路。……这一回，我一根灯芯也没有弄丢。今晚天黑以后，初原村要在圣火前感恩，请你也留下来。

log.en: Everything for the vigil is ready. Tonight the village gives thanks at the flame.
log.zh: 守夜的东西备齐了。今晚全村要在圣火前感恩。

log.en: I went east before the vigil, but I had brought everything. Sister Ilse took the oil and the dawnbloom all the same.
log.zh: 守夜没赶上，但东西我都带回来了。伊尔丝修女还是收下了灯油和晨光花。

log.en: I went on east before the vigil.
log.zh: 还没等到守夜，我已经往东去了。

waiting.en: The oil from Tam's cellar, the dawnbloom from the hill, and the bell. They say that bell was rung on the morning the sun came back. It ought to be rung for them, too.
