waiting.zh: 塔姆地窖里的灯油，丘上的晨光花，还有那口钟。听说太阳回来的那天早上，敲响的就是那口钟。这一回，也该为他们敲一敲。

summary.en: The days are growing shorter, and the Church is calling pilgrims east. Beyond Vesper Ford the Pilgrim's Road leads to the Sunrise Road, where the White Knight Alberic lets no one pass who will not kneel.
summary.zh: 白昼一天比一天短，教会在召朝圣者东行。过了晚祷渡，朝圣者之路一直通到朝阳大道；白骑士阿尔贝里克守在那里，不肯下跪的人，他一个也不放过去。

text.en: Be at the flame in Firstlight after dark, for the night of thanks
text.zh: 入夜后到初原村的圣火前，参加感恩之夜

text.en: Wait in Firstlight for the Church's letter the next morning
text.zh: 第二天早上，在初原村等教会的来信

text.en: Ask Sister Ilse where the pilgrimage begins
text.zh: 问伊尔丝修女朝圣从哪里开始

text.en: Cross the river at Vesper Ford
text.zh: 在晚祷渡过河

text.en: Take the pilgrim's oath at the Pilgrims' Rest: kneel at the altar of the five wounds
text.zh: 到朝圣者驿站立朝圣者之誓：在五伤祭坛前跪下

text.en: Light the Shrine of the Crown with something worn on the head
text.zh: 点亮荆棘冠之龛（献上一件戴在头上的东西）

text.en: Light the Shrine of the Pillar with a rope or a cord
text.zh: 点亮鞭刑柱之龛（献上一根绳索）

text.en: Light the Shrine of the Scales with something to eat
text.zh: 点亮饥刑之秤之龛（献上一样吃的）

text.en: Light the Shrine of the Nails with something made of metal
text.zh: 点亮钉刑圣木之龛（献上一件金属的东西）

text.en: Light the Shrine of the Lance with a torch or a candle
text.zh: 点亮穿心圣枪之龛（献上火把或蜡烛）

text.en: At the Abbey of the Thorn, north of the road, find out what became of the knight
text.zh: 到大路北边的荆棘修道院，查明骑士后来怎么了

text.en: Take the Order's seal from its last keeper, in the abbey's crypt
text.zh: 从修道院墓室里最后一位看守手中取得骑士团的印章

text.en: Go on east to the Kneeling Field
text.zh: 继续往东，到跪石原

text.en: Bring down the White Knight Alberic on the Sunrise Road
text.zh: 在朝阳大道打倒白骑士阿尔贝里克

hint.en: Tonight Firstlight gives thanks at the flame. Be in the village after dark.
hint.zh: 今晚初原村要在圣火前感恩。天黑时待在村里。

log.en: Tonight Firstlight gives thanks at the flame.
log.zh: 今晚初原村要在圣火前感恩。

hint.en: The Firstlight is gone. Wait in the village until morning.
hint.zh: 初火不见了。在村里等到天亮。

log.en: In the night a man in grey took the Firstlight from the chapel. He walked east across the river, and the water froze under his feet as he went.
log.zh: 夜里，一个穿灰衣的人从礼拜堂拿走了初火。他往东过了河，走到哪里，脚下的河水就冻到哪里。

hint.en: Hesper says the White Knight tore three planks out of the footbridge by the marsh. Mend it, or find another way across. An axe fells a tree and splits the logs into planks; {key:put} lays a plank down on the water.
hint.zh: 赫斯珀说，白骑士拆走了沼泽边小桥上的三块木板。补上它，或者另找办法过河。斧头能砍树，也能把原木劈成木板；按 {key:put} 把木板铺到水上。

log.en: A letter came from the Holy City. The Church has called the pilgrimage and named me a pilgrim. Sister Ilse says the road begins across the river.
log.zh: 圣城来了一封信。教会发布了朝圣令，信里点了我的名。伊尔丝修女说，朝圣的路从河对岸开始。

hint.en: East of the river the Church keeps a Rest for pilgrims. Father Caius takes the pilgrim's oath there: kneel at the altar of the five wounds in its chapel.
hint.zh: 河东边，教会为朝圣者设了一处驿站，由凯乌斯司铎主持朝圣者之誓。到驿站礼拜堂的五伤祭坛前跪下。

log.en: I crossed the river. On the road east the Church keeps a Rest for pilgrims.
log.zh: 过了河。往东的路上，教会为朝圣者设了一处驿站。

hint.en: Five wayside shrines stand along the Pilgrim's Road, one for each of the Five Sufferings. Each asks for an offering, and the words cut on it say what; lay it on the shrine with {key:put}.
hint.zh: 朝圣者之路上立着五座路边圣龛，五苦各一座。每座龛都要一样供品，石上刻的字写着要什么；按 {key:put} 把它放上去。

log.en: I knelt at the altar of the five wounds and swore the pilgrim's oath. Father Caius said the knight was due to be relieved once, and would say no more about it.
log.zh: 我在五伤祭坛前跪下，立了朝圣者之誓。凯乌斯司铎说，那位骑士本来早该有人去接替，之后就不肯再多说了。

hint.en: Halfway along the road a path climbs north to the Abbey of the Thorn, where the knight was knighted. Read what was left in its chapter hall. The Order's last keeper is in the crypt under the shrine.
hint.zh: 大路走到一半，有条小路往北上山，通到荆棘修道院，那位骑士就是在那里受封的。去骑士团大厅看看留下了什么。骑士团最后的看守在神龛下面的墓室里。

log.en: All five shrines are lit. North of the road stands the abbey where the knight was knighted.
log.zh: 五座圣龛都亮了。大路北边，就是骑士受封的那座修道院。

hint.en: Follow the road east to the Kneeling Field. The knight's kingdom lies beyond it, on the Sunrise Road.
hint.zh: 沿大路往东走，就到跪石原。骑士的王国在它后面的朝阳大道上。

log.en: In the abbey I found a writ that should have relieved the knight after forty years. It was sealed, and never sent.
log.zh: 我在修道院里找到一份替任文书：骑士守满四十年，就该另派人接替他。文书封得好好的，从来没有寄出去。

hint.en: Cross the field to the Sunrise Road and go on past the burned farm to the knight's ring of thorns. Watch the ground for where his blows will land, and step out of the way.
hint.zh: 穿过跪石原到朝阳大道，经过烧毁的农庄，就是骑士的荆棘圈。留意地上标出的他要打下来的地方，及时躲开。

log.en: The Kneeling Field is full of stone figures carved on their knees. Each has a name and a year cut on it.
log.zh: 跪石原上立满了石像，个个都跪着，每一座上都刻着一个名字和一个年份。

log.en: The White Knight fell to his knees, took off the Crown of Thorns and gave it to me.
log.zh: 白骑士跪倒在地，摘下荆棘冠，交到了我手里。

summary.en: Where the White Knight fell, one thorn of his crown stayed green. Lumi says there is a field on the other side of it, and someone waiting.
summary.zh: 白骑士倒下的地方，荆棘冠上有一根刺还是绿的。露米说，它的另一边有一片田野，还有人在等。

text.en: Hold the Oath-Thorn ({key:slots}) and left click to enter the Held Ground
text.zh: 把誓约之棘拿在手上（{key:slots}），按左键，进入誓守之地

text.en: Speak to Alberic by the planted sword
text.zh: 到插在地上的那把剑旁边，和阿尔贝里克说话

say.en: The ground is yours, but the mist still holds most of it. Ask me of the Held Ground, and I will show you what each ring of mist asks before it lifts, and what may be built here. When you would leave, use the thorn on yourself again. It returns you to where you stood.
say.zh: 这片土地归你了，只是大半还在雾里。问我「领地扩建」的事，我便告诉你每一圈雾退开之前要些什么，这里又能盖些什么。要走的时候，再对自己用一次那根刺，它会送你回到原来站的地方。

text.en: Hold the Oath-Thorn and left click again to go back where you stood
text.zh: 再拿着誓约之棘按一次左键，回到原来的地方

hint.en: The Oath-Thorn is in your bag. Take it in hand ({key:slots}) and left click: it is used on you. It does not open in the middle of a fight.
hint.zh: 誓约之棘在你的背包里。把它拿在手上（{key:slots}），按左键，它就用在你自己身上。打斗中它打不开。

log.en: Where the knight fell, one thorn of his crown was still green, and warm to the touch. I took it. Lumi says it wants to be used on me.
log.zh: 骑士倒下的地方，荆棘冠上有一根刺还是绿的，摸着是温的。我把它收下了。露米说，它想让我对自己用一下。

hint.en: Alberic keeps the Held Ground now. He stands by the sword planted at its heart; speak to him with {key:hands}.
hint.zh: 如今阿尔贝里克替你守着誓守之地。他就在正中那把插在地上的剑旁边，按 {key:hands} 和他说话。

log.en: Beyond the thorn is a field ringed by mist. The White Knight is there, without his helm. He says he holds this ground for me now.
log.zh: 棘刺的另一边是一片被雾围着的田野。白骑士也在那里，没戴头盔。他说，如今换他替我守着这片土地。

hint.en: To go back, take the Oath-Thorn in hand and left click again. It takes you back to where you were standing.
hint.zh: 要回去的话，把誓约之棘拿在手上，再按一次左键。它会把你送回原来站的地方。

log.en: Alberic will push the mist back if I bring what the ground asks. He keeps a stall by the sword, too.
log.zh: 只要把扩地要的东西带来，阿尔贝里克就会把雾推远些。剑旁边还有他的货摊。

log.en: The thorn brought me back to where I had stood. I can go back to the Held Ground whenever I want. The Crown is still to be carried home to Firstlight.
log.zh: 棘刺把我送回了原来站的地方。以后想回誓守之地，随时都能回去。荆棘冠还得带回初原村。

log.en: I had been to the Held Ground already.
log.zh: 誓守之地，我已经去过了。

log.en: I carried the Crown home before I went through the thorn.
log.zh: 我没穿过那根刺，就先把荆棘冠带回了家。

summary.en: You took the Crown of Thorns from the White Knight. Carry it home to Firstlight.
summary.zh: 你从白骑士手里得到了荆棘冠。把它带回初原村。

text.en: Bring the Crown home to Firstlight
text.zh: 把荆棘冠带回初原村

hint.en: Carry the Crown of Thorns back west across the river, to Firstlight.
hint.zh: 往西过河，把荆棘冠带回初原村。

log.en: I carry the Crown now. The man in grey drew the rest of its light into his lantern and went east.
log.zh: 荆棘冠现在由我带着。那个灰衣人把剩下的光收进了他的灯里，往东走了。

log.en: I brought the Crown home to Firstlight. Nessa says the sun set four minutes early tonight.
log.zh: 我把荆棘冠带回了初原村。奈莎说，今晚太阳早落了四分钟。

summary.en: With the knight gone, the Sunrise Road is open. It runs on east to Emberfall, where smoke hangs over the hills.
summary.zh: 骑士倒下了，朝阳大道通了。顺着它往东是余烬镇，那边的山头上一直冒着烟。

text.en: Follow the road east to Emberfall
text.zh: 沿大路往东到余烬镇

text.en: Find Mara, the elder of Emberfall
text.zh: 找到余烬镇的长老玛拉

text.en: Iron ore for Garrick, from the Embervein Mine north of town
text.zh: 给加里克的铁矿石（镇北的烬脉旧矿）

text.en: Coal for Garrick
text.zh: 给加里克的煤

text.en: Fireweed for Wren (Firstlight Village)
text.zh: 给雷恩的火焰草（初原村）

text.en: Frostcap for Wren (Hushwood)
text.zh: 给雷恩的霜盖菇（噤声林）

text.en: Collect Dragonsbane from Garrick ({key:hands})
text.zh: 找加里克拿屠龙剑（{key:hands}）

text.en: Collect the fireproof draught from Wren ({key:hands})
text.zh: 找雷恩拿防火药剂（{key:hands}）

text.en: Climb Cinder Pass to the dragon's lair
text.zh: 翻过烬岭山道，到魔龙的巢穴

text.en: Defeat the dragon of Cinder Peak
text.zh: 打倒烬峰魔龙

hint.en: The Sunrise Road is open. Follow it east to Emberfall.
hint.zh: 朝阳大道通了。顺着它往东走，就到余烬镇。

log.en: I took the road east, toward Emberfall.
log.zh: 我沿着大路往东，朝余烬镇走去。

hint.en: Mara is the elder of Emberfall. Ask her about the smoke on the hills.
hint.zh: 玛拉是余烬镇的长老。去问问她，山上的烟是怎么回事。

log.en: Half the roofs in Emberfall are new thatch. The rest are still black from the fire.
log.zh: 余烬镇一半的屋顶是新铺的茅草，另一半还是烧黑的。

hint.en: Garrick the smith will forge a blade if you bring him 5 iron ore and 3 coal; there are veins in the Embervein Mine north of town, and a pickaxe breaks them. Wren the herbalist will brew a fireproof draught from 3 fireweed, which grows around Firstlight Village, and 3 frostcap from Hushwood. Give them what they ask for with {key:put}, then talk to them with {key:hands}.
hint.zh: 铁匠加里克说，给他 5 块铁矿石和 3 块煤，他就能锻一把剑。镇北的烬脉旧矿里有矿脉，用镐能敲开。草药师雷恩说，有 3 株火焰草和 3 朵霜盖菇，她就能熬防火的药；火焰草长在初原村一带，霜盖菇长在噤声林里。按 {key:put} 把东西交给他们，再按 {key:hands} 和他们说话。

log.en: Mara says a dragon nests on Cinder Peak. Garrick can forge a blade that will cut its hide, and Wren can brew a draught against its fire.
log.zh: 玛拉说，烬峰上住着一头魔龙。加里克能锻一把砍得进龙皮的剑，雷恩能熬一种挡得住龙火的药。

hint.en: Climb the pass east of Emberfall to the dragon's lair. Drink the fireproof draught before you go in.
hint.zh: 翻过余烬镇东边的山道，就是魔龙的巢穴。进去之前，先喝下防火药剂。

log.en: I have Dragonsbane and the draughts. The pass east of town climbs to Cinder Peak.
log.zh: 屠龙剑和药剂都拿到了。镇子东边的山道一直通到烬峰。

hint.en: The dragon breathes fire in a straight line; keep out of it, and watch for its whelps. Left click swings your weapon.
hint.zh: 魔龙会朝一条直线喷火，别站在那条线上，也要留心它的幼龙。左键挥动武器。

log.en: Heat, and the smell of scorched stone. Something huge is breathing in the dark.
log.zh: 一股热浪，还有烧焦的石头味。黑暗里有个巨大的东西在呼吸。

hint.en: The dragon is dead. What you taught the world along the way is written in the Threadbook ({key:journal}).
hint.zh: 魔龙死了。一路上你教会这个世界的事，都写在织线簿里（{key:journal}）。

log.en: The dragon is dead. Emberfall can sleep at night again.
log.zh: 魔龙死了。余烬镇的人晚上又能睡安稳觉了。

summary.en: Marta is making the village's stew and is short 3 raw beef and 2 eggs. The cows and hens are on Dusklea south of the village.
summary.zh: 玛尔塔要炖一锅全村人吃的菜，还缺 3 块生牛肉和 2 个鸡蛋。牛和鸡都在村子南边的暮牧原上。

text.en: Raw beef
text.zh: 生牛肉

text.en: Eggs
text.zh: 鸡蛋

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Marta is making the village's stew and is short 3 raw beef and 2 eggs. The cows and hens are on Dusklea south of the village.
log.zh: 玛尔塔要炖一锅全村人吃的菜，还缺 3 块生牛肉和 2 个鸡蛋。牛和鸡都在村子南边的暮牧原上。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Now that is a stew. Here, the first bowl is yours, and take some bread for the road.
say.zh: 这才像一锅菜。来，第一碗给你，再拿几块面包路上吃。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Everyone in Firstlight eats from this pot, and since the storm there has been little to put in it. Bring me three cuts of beef and two eggs, and the whole village eats tonight. The cows and hens are on Dusklea, south of here.
offer.zh: 全村人都在我这口锅里吃饭。起风暴以后，锅里就没什么可放的了。你要是能给我带三块牛肉、两个鸡蛋回来，今晚全村人都能吃上一顿。牛和鸡都在南边的暮牧原上。

waiting.en: Three cuts of beef and two eggs. The pot is on already.
waiting.zh: 三块牛肉，两个鸡蛋。锅已经架上了。

summary.en: Mia lost her grandmother's silver ring in the thorns of Thornwood Hollow. She asks you to find it and bring it back.
summary.zh: 米娅把奶奶的银戒指丢在了荆棘谷的荆棘丛里，想请你帮她找回来。

text.en: Mia's ring
text.zh: 米娅的戒指

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Mia lost her grandmother's silver ring in the thorns of Thornwood Hollow. She asks you to find it and bring it back.
log.zh: 米娅把奶奶的银戒指丢在了荆棘谷的荆棘丛里，想请你帮她找回来。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: You found it! That's Gran's ring! Here, you can have my best stone. It's a lucky one.
say.zh: 你找到了！是奶奶的戒指！给你，这是我最好的一块石头，它会给你带来好运的。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Can you promise not to tell Mum? I went to the hollow, just to look, and Gran's ring fell into the thorns on the east side. Could you find it for me?
offer.zh: 你能不告诉我妈妈吗？我去了荆棘谷，就去看了一眼，结果奶奶的戒指掉进东边的荆棘丛里了。你能帮我找回来吗？

waiting.en: It's on the east side of the hollow, where the thorns are thickest. It's silver.
waiting.zh: 在荆棘谷东边，荆棘最密的那里。是银的。

summary.en: Holt wants the trail through Thornwood Hollow made safe. Fell 6 creatures there.
summary.zh: 霍尔特想让穿过荆棘谷的那条小路太平些。去那里打倒 6 只怪物。

text.en: Creatures felled in the hollow
text.zh: 在荆棘谷打倒的怪物

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Holt wants the trail through Thornwood Hollow made safe. Fell 6 creatures there.
log.zh: 霍尔特想让穿过荆棘谷的那条小路太平些。去那里打倒 6 只怪物。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: It's quieter already. Take this spear. I keep a spare, and you'll use it more than I will.
say.zh: 已经安静多了。这杆矛你拿着。我多备了一杆，你比我用得上。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: I'm the only guard Firstlight has, and I can't leave the gate. The things in the hollow have been coming up as far as Dusklea. Go down and thin them out. Six would do it.
offer.zh: 村里就我一个守卫，我不能离开村口。荆棘谷里的东西，最近都跑到暮牧原上来了。你下去清一清，打掉六只就行。

waiting.en: Six. Slimes, spiders, wolves, whatever moves in the hollow.
waiting.zh: 六只。史莱姆、蜘蛛、狼，荆棘谷里会动的都算。

summary.en: Gus needs 4 logs a day for the village fire. Fell a tree with an axe; it comes down in two swings. He asks again every day.
summary.zh: 格斯每天要 4 根木头给村里的火堆。用斧头砍树，砍两下就倒。这件事每天都能再接。

text.en: Logs
text.zh: 木头

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Gus needs 4 logs a day for the village fire. Fell a tree with an axe; it comes down in two swings. He asks again every day.
log.zh: 格斯每天要 4 根木头给村里的火堆。用斧头砍树，砍两下就倒。这件事每天都能再接。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: That will see us through the night. Same again tomorrow?
say.zh: 够烧一晚了。明天还来？

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: My back's not what it was. Bring me four logs and you'll spare it. Mind, the fire wants them every day.
offer.zh: 我这腰不行了。你给我弄四根木头来，就算帮了它。不过这火天天都要烧。

waiting.en: Four logs. Any tree will do.
waiting.zh: 四根木头，哪棵树都行。

summary.en: Sister Ilse sends you on the pilgrimage: the first Seal-bearer, the White Knight Alberic, holds the road east beyond Vesper Ford. Before you go, hear what Fennick, Joss and Hesper can tell you.
summary.zh: 伊尔丝修女送你踏上朝圣之路：第一位持印者白骑士阿尔贝里克，守在晚祷渡以东的大路上。出发前，先去听听芬尼克、乔斯和赫斯珀怎么说。

text.en: Hear Fennick on the knight
text.zh: 听芬尼克讲那位骑士

say.en: Alberic. When he plants his sword in the ground, thorns come up in a ring round him. Stand inside the ring, or well outside it, but never on it. And when he draws his bow, don't be in front of him.
say.zh: 阿尔贝里克。他把剑插进地里，周围就会长出一圈荆棘。要么站在圈里，要么离得远远的，千万别站在圈上。他拉弓的时候，别站在他正前方。

text.en: Ask Joss about the bridge
text.zh: 问乔斯桥的事

say.en: The gap is three planks wide. Fell a tree with an axe, split the logs into planks, and lay them on the water where the boards were. Or find some other way across.
say.zh: 缺口要三块木板才补得上。用斧头砍棵树，把木头劈成木板，铺在原来桥板的位置上。要不然，你就另找办法过河。

text.en: Ask Hesper what she saw
text.zh: 问赫斯珀她看到了什么

say.en: White, all of him. A crown of thorns grown through his helm. He pulled my bridge up board by board and laid the nails out on the pier, like a toll paid. He never looked at me once.
say.zh: 他从头到脚都是白的，头上戴着一顶荆棘冠，荆棘是从头盔里面长穿出来的。他把我的桥一块一块拆了，钉子整整齐齐摆在码头上，像是付了过桥钱。从头到尾，他没看我一眼。

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Sister Ilse sends you on the pilgrimage: the first Seal-bearer, the White Knight Alberic, holds the road east beyond Vesper Ford. Before you go, hear what Fennick, Joss and Hesper can tell you.
log.zh: 伊尔丝修女送你踏上朝圣之路：第一位持印者白骑士阿尔贝里克，守在晚祷渡以东的大路上。出发前，先去听听芬尼克、乔斯和赫斯珀怎么说。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Then go with the blessing of the Five. Suffering is not God's abandonment; remember that, out there. And come back, so that I may hear your step again.
say.zh: 那就带着五苦的祝福去吧。苦难并非神的遗弃，到了外面，要记住这句话。还有，要回来，让我再听听你的脚步声。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

log.en: All of it was done along the way.
log.zh: 一路走来，这件事也办完了。

log.en: It is too late for this now.
log.zh: 这件事已经来不及了。

offer.en: The Church teaches that Astra bore the Five Sufferings so that the sun would rise again, and that five Seal-bearers carry them still. The nights are growing longer, and the Church says the Seal-bearers are failing. The first of them holds the road beyond our Ford. Before you go, speak with those who know that road: Fennick, Joss and Hesper.
offer.zh: 教会教导我们：阿斯特拉承受了五苦，太阳才重新升起；如今仍有五位持印者背负着五苦。夜一天比一天长，教会说，持印者们已经撑不住了。第一位就守在我们晚祷渡那边的路上。出发之前，去找认得那条路的人问一问吧：芬尼克、乔斯，还有赫斯珀。

waiting.en: Fennick by the bench, Joss at his workbench, Hesper at Vesper Ford. Each of them knows a piece of the road.
waiting.zh: 芬尼克在长凳那边，乔斯在他的工作台，赫斯珀在晚祷渡。那条路，他们每人都知道一段。

summary.en: Pell has drawn the grey man in every place he saw him: by the shrine stone at Woundstone Foot, at the barrow door, by the footbridge, and by the flame in the village. Find all four drawings ({key:hands} looks at one).
summary.zh: 佩尔在每个见过灰衣人的地方都画了一幅画：伤石山麓的路碑旁、长眠冢门口、小桥边，还有村里的圣火旁。把四幅画都找到（按 {key:hands} 查看）。

text.en: The shrine stone
text.zh: 路碑

text.en: The barrow door
text.zh: 长眠冢的门

text.en: The footbridge
text.zh: 小桥

text.en: The flame
text.zh: 圣火旁

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Pell has drawn the grey man in every place he saw him: by the shrine stone at Woundstone Foot, at the barrow door, by the footbridge, and by the flame in the village. Find all four drawings ({key:hands} looks at one).
log.zh: 佩尔在每个见过灰衣人的地方都画了一幅画：伤石山麓的路碑旁、长眠冢门口、小桥边，还有村里的圣火旁。把四幅画都找到（按 {key:hands} 查看）。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: You saw them? He was there every time, the night before something bad happened. He wasn't the one doing the bad thing. He just got there first. Here, you can have my other warm stone.
say.zh: 你都看到了吧？每次都是出坏事的前一天晚上，他就在那儿。坏事不是他干的，他只是先到了。给，我另一块暖石头给你。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Nobody believes me about the grey man. So I drew him everywhere I saw him, four places! Go and find them all and you'll see. Then you'll believe me.
offer.zh: 灰衣人的事，谁都不信我。所以我在每个见过他的地方都画了他，一共四个地方！你去把它们都找到，就知道了。到时候你就信我了。

waiting.en: The shrine stone up the mountain, the barrow door, the little bridge, and here by the fire. I draw small, so look down low.
waiting.zh: 山上的路碑、长眠冢的门、小桥，还有这边的火堆旁。我画得很小，你要往地上看。

summary.en: Nessa wants readings of the sky from the waypoint statues. Wake three of them, at Woundstone Foot, in the village, at Vesper Ford or on the Sunrise Road ({key:hands} on each).
summary.zh: 奈莎想从传送雕像上读出天象的数据。唤醒其中三座：伤石山麓的、村里的、晚祷渡的，或者朝阳大道上的那座（对每座按 {key:hands}）。

text.en: Waypoint statues woken
text.zh: 唤醒的传送雕像

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Nessa wants readings of the sky from the waypoint statues. Wake three of them, at Woundstone Foot, in the village, at Vesper Ford or on the Sunrise Road ({key:hands} on each).
log.zh: 奈莎想从传送雕像上读出天象的数据。唤醒其中三座：伤石山麓的、村里的、晚祷渡的，或者朝阳大道上的那座（对每座按 {key:hands}）。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Lower every week, and faster than the old almanac says. Take it; I have copied what I need. Read the last pages. I cannot make sense of them.
say.zh: 一个礼拜比一个礼拜低，比旧历书上算的还快。这本你拿去吧，我要的都抄下来了。你看看最后几页，我怎么也看不明白。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: The waypoint statues hum at the hour of sunset. The old almanacs say they are older than the Church. If I can read three of them, I can work out how fast the days are shortening, to the minute. Will you wake three for me?
offer.zh: 那些传送雕像，每到日落就会嗡嗡响。旧历书上说，它们比教会还要古老。只要能读到三座，我就能算出白天缩短得有多快，精确到分钟。你能帮我唤醒三座吗？

waiting.en: Three statues. The one at Woundstone Foot, ours by the square, Vesper Ford's... They are all humming the same note, and it is lower every week.
waiting.zh: 三座雕像。伤石山麓那座，广场边我们这座，晚祷渡那座……它们哼的都是同一个音，一个礼拜比一个礼拜低。

summary.en: Fennick won't send anyone against a Seal-bearer who hasn't stood a night in the wild. Put down 3 of the dead that walk outside the village after dark.
summary.zh: 没在野外熬过一夜的人，芬尼克不会放他去找持印者。天黑以后，到村外打倒 3 个游荡的亡灵。

text.en: The dead put down
text.zh: 打倒的亡灵

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Fennick won't send anyone against a Seal-bearer who hasn't stood a night in the wild. Put down 3 of the dead that walk outside the village after dark.
log.zh: 没在野外熬过一夜的人，芬尼克不会放他去找持印者。天黑以后，到村外打倒 3 个游荡的亡灵。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Still standing. Good. Take my old helm. I wore it as a squire, and it stopped worse than claws.
say.zh: 还站着。好。我的旧头盔你拿去。这是我当侍从时戴的，挡过比爪子狠得多的东西。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: You mean to go against a Seal-bearer. Then stand a night out there first. The dead walk Dusklea after dark. Put three of them down and walk back here on your own feet.
offer.zh: 你要去找持印者。那就先去外面熬一夜。天黑以后，暮牧原上有亡灵游荡。打倒三个，再自己走回来。

waiting.en: Three of the dead. They come out after dark, past the fence. Keep moving.
waiting.zh: 三个亡灵。天黑以后出来，在围栏外面。别站着不动。

summary.en: Nine nails held the footbridge's three boards, and only eight were left on the pier. Joss wants the ninth back; it went east with whoever took the bridge.
summary.zh: 小桥的三块木板一共钉了九根钉子，码头上只摆着八根。乔斯想把第九根找回来；拆桥的人往东去了，钉子也在那边。

text.en: The ninth nail
text.zh: 第九根钉子

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Nine nails held the footbridge's three boards, and only eight were left on the pier. Joss wants the ninth back; it went east with whoever took the bridge.
log.zh: 小桥的三块木板一共钉了九根钉子，码头上只摆着八根。乔斯想把第九根找回来；拆桥的人往东去了，钉子也在那边。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: The ninth. ...Twenty years that bridge stood. Here, a proper hammer. You've earned it.
say.zh: 第九根。……那座桥立了二十年。给，一把像样的锤子，你该拿着。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Eight nails on the pier. Eight. I drove nine. Whoever took my bridge kept one. Find it for me, if you go that way.
offer.zh: 码头上八根钉子。八根。我钉的是九根。拆我桥的人带走了一根。你要是往东边去，帮我找回来。

waiting.en: The ninth nail. Square-headed, pulled out straight. You'll know it.
waiting.zh: 第九根钉子。方头，拔出来还是直的。你一看就认得。

summary.en: Nessa wants to know what the log of the Church's watch on Cloudtop says. Find it in the ruined shelter at the top of the mountain and read it ({key:hands}).
summary.zh: 奈莎想知道教会在云顶台地的观日哨留下的日志里写了什么。到山顶那间破小屋里找到日志，读一读（按 {key:hands}）。

text.en: Read the watchman's log on Cloudtop
text.zh: 读云顶台地上守夜人的日志

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Nessa wants to know what the log of the Church's watch on Cloudtop says. Find it in the ruined shelter at the top of the mountain and read it ({key:hands}).
log.zh: 奈莎想知道教会在云顶台地的观日哨留下的日志里写了什么。到山顶那间破小屋里找到日志，读一读（按 {key:hands}）。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Eleven years. The sunsets were coming early eleven years ago, and he wrote it down every night, and nobody read it. ...A sleeping light in the snow. I do not know what he meant by that. I am sure it means nothing.
say.zh: 十一年。十一年前日落就开始提前了，他每天晚上都记下来，可是没有人读过。……雪里有一点睡着的光。我不明白他写的是什么意思。应该没什么吧。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: There was a Church watch on Cloudtop: one man, timing every sunset for the almanacs. His reports stopped coming years ago. If his log is still up there, I need to know what it says.
offer.zh: 云顶台地上以前有个教会的观日哨，只有一个人，给历书记下每一天的日落时刻。他的报告好几年前就断了。要是他的日志还在山上，我得知道上面写了什么。

waiting.en: Cloudtop, above Woundstone Foot. A shelter on the snow. He kept his log on the table, if I know watchmen.
waiting.zh: 云顶台地，在伤石山麓上面。雪地里有间小屋。守夜的人都把日志放在桌上，他应该也一样。

summary.en: Brin's herd will not settle: more of the dead come up onto Dusklea every week. Put down 3 of them there after nightfall.
summary.zh: 布琳的牛群夜里不得安宁，暮牧原上的亡灵一周比一周多。入夜以后，在暮牧原上打倒 3 个。

text.en: The dead put down on Dusklea
text.zh: 在暮牧原上打倒的亡灵

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Brin's herd will not settle: more of the dead come up onto Dusklea every week. Put down 3 of them there after nightfall.
log.zh: 布琳的牛群夜里不得安宁，暮牧原上的亡灵一周比一周多。入夜以后，在暮牧原上打倒 3 个。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: They're lying down. Lying down properly, not kneeling. ...Here, cheese from the last of the good milk. Thank you.
say.zh: 它们躺下了。是好好地躺下，不是跪着。……给，这是用最后一点好奶做的奶酪。谢谢你。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Three cows gone this month. Not wolves; wolves leave something. The dead walk the grass after dark now, and the herd knows it. Will you stand a night out here with me?
offer.zh: 这个月丢了三头牛。不是狼，狼总会剩下点什么。现在天一黑，死人就在草地上走，牛都知道。你能陪我在这儿守一夜吗？

waiting.en: They come up after dark from the south end, by the trees. Put three of them down and the herd will sleep.
waiting.zh: 它们天黑以后从南头的树林那边上来。打倒三个，牛就能睡了。

summary.en: A pilgrim camped deep in Hushwood long ago and never came back. Bring his scallop shell to Sister Ilse.
summary.zh: 很久以前，有个朝圣者在噤声林深处扎过营，后来再也没有回来。把他的扇贝徽记带给伊尔丝修女。

text.en: The pilgrim's scallop
text.zh: 朝圣者的扇贝

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: A pilgrim camped deep in Hushwood long ago and never came back. Bring his scallop shell to Sister Ilse.
log.zh: 很久以前，有个朝圣者在噤声林深处扎过营，后来再也没有回来。把他的扇贝徽记带给伊尔丝修女。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Brother Cassian. He sat in this chapel when I was a novice and asked me to pray for him. The Church named him pilgrim thirty-one years ago. ...They told us he reached the Holy City. Keep it, and wear it on the road. He would want that.
say.zh: 是卡西安修士。我还是见习修女的时候，他坐在这间礼拜堂里，请我为他祈祷。三十一年前，教会点了他的名。……他们告诉我们，他走到了圣城。你留着吧，戴着它上路。他会愿意的。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: A camp in Hushwood, with the Church's proclamation nailed up beside it? ...Then a pilgrim slept there. Would you bring me what he left? If he wore the scallop, bring me that.
offer.zh: 噤声林里的营地，旁边还钉着教会的朝圣令？……那是朝圣者歇过脚的地方。能把他留下的东西带给我吗？他要是戴着扇贝徽记，就把徽记带来。

waiting.en: The scallop is the pilgrim's mark. Every one of us is given one when we are named.
waiting.zh: 扇贝是朝圣者的记号。被教会点名的人，每人都会领到一枚。

summary.en: The White Knight took Edda's late husband's wedding band from her gatepost, along with everything else that shone. It is somewhere in his kingdom, up the road.
summary.zh: 白骑士从艾达家的门柱上拿走了她亡夫的婚戒，会反光的东西他都拿走了。戒指就在大路那头、他的王国里。

text.en: The wedding band
text.zh: 婚戒

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: The White Knight took Edda's late husband's wedding band from her gatepost, along with everything else that shone. It is somewhere in his kingdom, up the road.
log.zh: 白骑士从艾达家的门柱上拿走了她亡夫的婚戒，会反光的东西他都拿走了。戒指就在大路那头、他的王国里。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: ...Thank you. I'll wear it now. I was keeping it on the gate so he could find his way home.
say.zh: ……谢谢你。我现在就戴上。我原先把它挂在门上，是想让他认得回家的路。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: If you're going up the road... my husband's ring. The knight took it with everything else. I don't care about the rest.
offer.zh: 你要是往那条路上走……我丈夫的戒指。骑士把它和别的东西一起拿走了。别的我都不要。

waiting.en: A plain band. It's all I have of him.
waiting.zh: 一枚素圈戒指。他就留下这么一样东西。

summary.en: Orrin the charcoal burner needs 6 logs to build his next clamp. Fell trees with an axe, two swings each; the coppice round his dell is full of them.
summary.zh: 烧炭的奥林要 6 根木头垒下一窑炭。用斧头砍树，砍两下就倒；他谷地周围的矮林里树多得是。

text.en: Logs
text.zh: 木头

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Orrin the charcoal burner needs 6 logs to build his next clamp. Fell trees with an axe, two swings each; the coppice round his dell is full of them.
log.zh: 烧炭的奥林要 6 根木头垒下一窑炭。用斧头砍树，砍两下就倒；他谷地周围的矮林里树多得是。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: That is a clamp's worth. Four days and it is charcoal. Here, coal from the last burn, and a cap. The ash gets in your hair.
say.zh: 够一窑了。烧四天就成炭。给，这是上一窑的炭，还有一顶帽子。烧炭的灰会落进头发里。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Six logs and I can build another clamp. My back will not carry them any more, and Gus's is going the same way. I will pay you in coal. It burns hotter than wood.
offer.zh: 有六根木头，我就能再垒一窑。我的腰扛不动了，格斯的腰也快不行了。你帮我这个忙，我拿炭谢你。炭比木头烧得旺。

waiting.en: Six logs. Any tree will do; the coppice is nearest.
waiting.zh: 六根木头。哪棵树都行，矮林最近。

summary.en: Boars root up the coppice stools round the Charcoal Dell, and the young wood never comes up. Fell 4 of them there for Orrin.
summary.zh: 野猪把烧炭谷周围矮林的树桩都拱翻了，新枝长不出来。替奥林在那里打倒 4 头野猪。

text.en: Boars felled in the dell
text.zh: 在烧炭谷打倒的野猪

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Boars root up the coppice stools round the Charcoal Dell, and the young wood never comes up. Fell 4 of them there for Orrin.
log.zh: 野猪把烧炭谷周围矮林的树桩都拱翻了，新枝长不出来。替奥林在那里打倒 4 头野猪。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Quieter. The stools might come back now. Take these, the boots I cut the coppice in before my knees went.
say.zh: 安静了。树桩兴许能重新发芽了。这双靴子给你，是我膝盖还没坏的时候，在矮林里干活穿的。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: Boars in the coppice again. Six years of growth, rooted up in one night. Put four of them down and the rest will keep to the deep woods. Mind the tusks.
offer.zh: 矮林里又来野猪了。长了六年的林子，一夜就给拱没了。打掉四头，剩下的就会躲回深林里去。小心獠牙。

waiting.en: Four boars, in the woods round the dell. They come out of the undergrowth at you. Stand your ground.
waiting.zh: 四头野猪，就在谷地周围的林子里。它们会从矮树丛里朝你冲出来，站稳了。

summary.en: There are no birds in Hushwood: Orrin says they all roost in his old oak at dusk and never sing. Ask Gus whether Hushwood was always so quiet, and bring Orrin 3 feathers from under the roost.
summary.zh: 噤声林里一只鸟都没有。奥林说，鸟每天黄昏全落在他那棵老橡树上，一声也不叫。去问问格斯噤声林是不是一直这么安静，再从那棵橡树底下捡 3 根羽毛给奥林。

text.en: Ask Gus about the quiet
text.zh: 问格斯噤声林为什么安静

say.en: Quiet? ...It went quiet the night the bridge came down. Every bird in it got up at once and flew west. I never told anyone. Nobody wants to hear a woodcutter go on about birds.
say.zh: 安静？……桥塌的那天晚上就安静了。林子里的鸟一下子全飞起来，往西去了。我没跟人说过。谁会听一个砍柴的讲鸟的事。

text.en: Feathers from under the roost
text.zh: 栖鸟橡树下的羽毛

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: There are no birds in Hushwood: Orrin says they all roost in his old oak at dusk and never sing. Ask Gus whether Hushwood was always so quiet, and bring Orrin 3 feathers from under the roost.
log.zh: 噤声林里一只鸟都没有。奥林说，鸟每天黄昏全落在他那棵老橡树上，一声也不叫。去问问格斯噤声林是不是一直这么安静，再从那棵橡树底下捡 3 根羽毛给奥林。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Every kind. Thrush, finch, jay, birds that never roost together. And Gus says it began the night the bridge came down. I have burned charcoal under that oak for forty years. They never cared for it before.
say.zh: 什么鸟都有。画眉、金翅雀、松鸦，这几种鸟从来不在一处过夜。格斯还说，是从桥塌那晚开始的。我在那棵橡树底下烧了四十年炭，以前它们从不稀罕那棵树。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: You came through Hushwood. Hear any birds? No. They are all in my oak, west of here, every dusk, and not a note out of them. Ask Gus if it was always like that; he will not tell me. And bring me three of their feathers. I want to know what kind they are.
offer.zh: 你是穿过噤声林来的。听见鸟叫了吗？没有吧。它们全在我西边那棵橡树上，天天黄昏都在，一声不吭。去问问格斯，是不是一直这样，他不肯跟我说。再给我捡三根它们的羽毛来，我想知道是什么鸟。

waiting.en: Ask Gus about Hushwood. The feathers are under the oak at the west end of the dell; they drop them at dawn when they go.
waiting.zh: 噤声林的事去问格斯。羽毛在谷地西头那棵橡树底下，它们天亮飞走的时候会掉下来。

summary.en: Hilde smokes fish at the Reed Bend and wants 3 of any kind for the smoke-fire. A rod is made from two sticks and two tufts of grass.
summary.zh: 希尔德在芦苇湾熏鱼，要 3 条鱼，什么鱼都行。鱼竿用两根树枝、两把草就能做。

text.en: Fish
text.zh: 鱼

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Hilde smokes fish at the Reed Bend and wants 3 of any kind for the smoke-fire. A rod is made from two sticks and two tufts of grass.
log.zh: 希尔德在芦苇湾熏鱼，要 3 条鱼，什么鱼都行。鱼竿用两根树枝、两把草就能做。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: Those will smoke. Here, bait, and my spare oilskin. You will want it on this river.
say.zh: 这几条能熏。给，鱼饵，还有我多出来的那件油布斗篷。在这条河上你用得着。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: You want to be useful? Three fish for the smoke, any kind. Make a rod from two sticks and two handfuls of grass, and cast off the pier. I sell bait, if you are in a hurry.
offer.zh: 想帮忙？给我弄三条鱼来熏，什么鱼都行。拿两根树枝、两把草做根鱼竿，站在码头上甩。着急的话，我这儿有饵卖。

waiting.en: Three fish. The pier, the shallows, anywhere there is water. Eels come after dark.
waiting.zh: 三条鱼。码头、浅滩，有水的地方都行。鳗鱼天黑以后才出来。

summary.en: Nine winters ago the fog took Hilde's husband Rolf and sent the boat back without him. Its bell lies on the spit at the Reed Bend, among the water slimes. Bring it to her.
summary.zh: 九个冬天以前，雾带走了希尔德的丈夫罗尔夫，只把空船送了回来。船铃还在芦苇湾的沙洲上，那里有水史莱姆。把船铃带给她。

text.en: Rolf's boat bell
text.zh: 罗尔夫的船铃

text.en: Back to {giver}
text.zh: 回去找{giver}

log.en: Nine winters ago the fog took Hilde's husband Rolf and sent the boat back without him. Its bell lies on the spit at the Reed Bend, among the water slimes. Bring it to her.
log.zh: 九个冬天以前，雾带走了希尔德的丈夫罗尔夫，只把空船送了回来。船铃还在芦苇湾的沙洲上，那里有水史莱姆。把船铃带给她。

log.en: All of it is done. Back to {giver}.
log.zh: 都办齐了。回去找{giver}。

say.en: It rings the same. I thought it would sound different. ...This was his ring. He mended nets with it on. You keep it. I can't wear it, and I won't sell it.
say.zh: 还是那个声音。我还以为会变的。……这是他的戒指，他戴着它补网。你留着吧。我戴不了，也不会卖。

log.en: Handed in to {giver}.
log.zh: 交给了{giver}。

offer.en: The bell. Rolf's boat bell. It is out on the spit where the boat ran aground, and the slimes have had it nine years. I don't go out there. ...You could.
offer.zh: 那个铃。罗尔夫的船铃。船搁浅在沙洲上，铃也落在那儿，让史莱姆占了九年。我不去那边。……你可以去。

waiting.en: The spit, south of the pier. Bronze, the size of your fist. Mind the slimes; you will come back soaked.
waiting.zh: 码头南边的沙洲。青铜的，拳头那么大。小心史莱姆，打完一身都是水。

summary.en: {hungry} has not eaten all day and has no coin for a meal. Bring them something to eat ({key:put} hands it over).
summary.zh: {hungry}一整天没吃东西了，身上也没钱买。给{hungry}带点吃的（按 {key:put} 递给对方）。

text.en: Something to eat for {hungry}
text.zh: 给{hungry}的吃的

log.en: {hungry} is hungry, with no coin for a meal.
log.zh: {hungry}饿着肚子，身上没钱买吃的。

say.en: Oh — thank you. I will not forget it.
say.zh: 哦——谢谢你。我不会忘的。

log.en: {hungry} ate.
log.zh: {hungry}吃上了东西。

log.en: {hungry} is gone.
log.zh: {hungry}已经不在了。

offer.en: I have not eaten since yesterday, and there is not a coin on me. ...If you have anything to spare, I would be grateful.
offer.zh: 我从昨天到现在什么都没吃，身上一个子儿也没有。……你要是有多余的吃的，能不能分我一点？

waiting.en: Anything to eat. Anything.
waiting.zh: 吃的就行。什么都行。

summary.en: {thief} took {thing} from {owner}, who saw it. Get it back and bring it to {owner}.
summary.zh: {thief}拿走了{owner}的{thing}，被{owner}看见了。把它拿回来，交还给{owner}。

text.en: Get {thing} back from {thief}
text.zh: 从{thief}那里拿回{thing}

text.en: Give {thing} back to {owner}
text.zh: 把{thing}还给{owner}

label.zh: 把你拿走的东西交出来。

log.en: {owner} saw {thief} take {thing}.
log.zh: {owner}看见{thief}拿走了{thing}。

say.en: ...Fine. Take it. It was not worth the trouble.
say.zh: ……行吧。拿去。为这个不值得惹麻烦。

log.en: {thief} gave {thing} up.
log.zh: {thief}交出了{thing}。

say.en: My {thing}! I did not think I would see it again.
say.zh: 我的{thing}！我还以为再也见不到它了。

log.en: {thing} is back with {owner}.
log.zh: {thing}回到了{owner}手里。

log.en: {thing} is gone for good.
log.zh: {thing}已经没了。

offer.en: {thief} took my {thing}, right in front of me. If you can get it back, I will make it worth your while.
offer.zh: {thief}当着我的面拿走了我的{thing}。你要是能拿回来，我不会亏待你。

accepted.en: Thank you. {thief} will not have gone far.

waiting.en: My {thing}. {thief} still has it.
waiting.zh: 我的{thing}。还在{thief}那里。

summary.en: {sender} has a letter for {recipient}. Carry it over ({key:put} hands it to them).
summary.zh: {sender}有一封信要给{recipient}。帮忙送过去（按 {key:put} 递给对方）。

text.en: The letter to {recipient}
text.zh: 把信交给{recipient}

log.en: {sender} gave me a letter for {recipient}.
log.zh: {sender}托我把一封信带给{recipient}。

say.en: A letter? From {sender}? ...Thank you for bringing it.
say.zh: 一封信？{sender}写的？……谢谢你送来。

log.en: {recipient} has the letter.
log.zh: 信交到了{recipient}手里。

log.en: {recipient} is gone.
log.zh: {recipient}已经不在了。

log.en: The letter is lost.
log.zh: 信丢了。

offer.en: Would you carry a letter to {recipient} for me? My legs are not what they were.
offer.zh: 能帮我给{recipient}捎封信吗？我的腿脚不如从前了。

accepted.en: Here. Mind you do not read it.

waiting.en: The letter, to {recipient}.
waiting.zh: 那封信，交给{recipient}。

summary.en: {guard} wants the night-born kept away tonight. Put down 3 of them out past the fence, then go back to {guard}.
summary.zh: {guard}想让夜行者今晚别靠近。到围栏外面打倒 3 个，再回去找{guard}。

text.en: Night-born put down
text.zh: 打倒的夜行者

text.en: Back to {guard}
text.zh: 回去找{guard}

log.en: {guard} asked me to thin the night-born out.
log.zh: {guard}托我去清一清夜里的东西。

log.en: Three of them down. Back to {guard}.
log.zh: 打倒了三个。回去找{guard}。

say.en: Good. The village sleeps easier for it.
say.zh: 好。村子今晚能睡得安稳些。

log.en: {guard} paid me for the night's work.
log.zh: {guard}为这一晚的活儿付了钱。

offer.en: The night-born are thick out past the fence again. Put three of them down before morning, and the watch will pay.
offer.zh: 围栏外面的夜行者又多起来了。天亮之前打倒三个，守卫队给你钱。

accepted.en: Mind the trees. They come out of the dark there.
accepted.zh: 小心树林。它们从那边的黑暗里出来。

waiting.en: Three of them, before morning.
waiting.zh: 三个，天亮之前。

summary.en: Every level gives a skill point, spent in the skill tree ({key:skills}). Anyone can learn the general skills: gathering, crafting, fighting.
summary.zh: 每升一级得一个技能点，在技能树（{key:skills}）里花。通用技能谁都能学：采集、制作、战斗都有。

text.en: Open the skill tree ({key:skills}) and learn a skill
text.zh: 打开技能树（{key:skills}），学一个技能

say.en: You went up a level! That means a skill point. Press {key:skills} to open the skill tree and learn something. Anyone can learn the general skills; the profession skills need a profession first.
say.zh: 你升级了！这就有一个技能点了。按 {key:skills} 打开技能树，学一个吧。通用技能谁都能学，职业技能要先有职业。

hint.en: {key:skills} opens the skill tree. A skill you can learn now is lit; click it to learn it. Hunting, gathering, crafting, fighting: pick what you do most.
hint.zh: {key:skills} 打开技能树。现在能学的技能会亮着，点一下就学会了。打猎、采集、制作、战斗，挑你最常做的。

log.en: I went up a level and have a skill point to spend. The skill tree is {key:skills}.
log.zh: 升了一级，有一个技能点可以花。技能树在 {key:skills}。

say.en: Learned! You get another point every level, so come back to the tree when you have one.
say.zh: 学会了！每升一级还会有一点，有了就回来看看技能树。

log.en: I learned my first skill.
log.zh: 学会了第一个技能。

summary.en: At level five, Bram the trainer in the drill yard of Firstlight Village will set you on a profession: assassin, warrior, ranger or mage. Each has its own weapon, skill-tree branch and gear sets; you can change later, but its branch starts over.
summary.zh: 到了五级，初原村操练场的导师布拉姆会让你选一个职业：刺客、战士、游侠或法师。每个职业有自己的武器、技能分支和套装；以后也能换，但那条分支要从头来过。

text.en: Speak to Bram, the trainer, in the drill yard of Firstlight Village
text.zh: 去初原村操练场找导师布拉姆说话

text.en: Choose a profession
text.zh: 选择一个职业

say.en: Level five! Bram said he takes people on at level five. His drill yard is in Firstlight, by the north-east cottage; look for the crossed blades over his head. Let's go and pick a profession!
say.zh: 五级了！布拉姆说过，到了五级他就收人。他的操练场在初原村东北角那间小屋旁边，认准他头顶的交叉双剑。我们去选个职业吧！

hint.en: Bram is in the drill yard of Firstlight Village day and night, with crossed blades over his head. {key:hands} on him opens his panel: four professions, each with its weapon. The dagger strikes from behind, the sword and shield from the front, the bow from afar, and the staff from wherever you stand.
hint.zh: 布拉姆日夜都在初原村的操练场，头顶有交叉双剑。对他按 {key:hands} 打开面板：四个职业，各用各的武器。匕首从背后下手，剑盾正面迎敌，弓从远处射，法杖站在哪儿都能用。

log.en: Level five. Lumi says Bram will take me on now.
log.zh: 五级了。露米说，布拉姆现在肯收我了。

hint.en: Choose in his panel. You will fight with the profession's weapon, and its branch of the skill tree opens with it. You can change later, but the branch starts over.
hint.zh: 在他的面板里选。选了哪个职业，就用它的武器打，技能树里对应的分支也一起开。以后能换，但分支要从头来过。

log.en: Bram offers four: dagger, sword and shield, bow, or staff.
log.zh: 布拉姆给了四条路：匕首、剑盾、弓、法杖。

say.en: You have a profession now! Its branch is open in the skill tree ({key:skills}). If you don't have its weapon yet, Bram sells one.
say.zh: 你有职业了！技能树（{key:skills}）里它的分支已经开了。要是还没有那种武器，布拉姆那里有卖。

log.en: I chose a profession. Its branch is open in the skill tree.
log.zh: 选好了职业。技能树里它的分支开了。

summary.en: Any water with fish in it will do; the nearest is the pond south of Firstlight's square. Make a rod from two sticks and two tufts of grass ({key:craft}) or buy one at the general store, then stand on the bank, hold it and left click the water.
summary.zh: 有鱼的水都能钓，最近的是初原村广场南边的池塘。用两根树枝、两把草做一根鱼竿（{key:craft}），或者去杂货店买，然后站在岸边，拿着鱼竿左键点水。

text.en: Get a fishing rod ({key:craft}: two sticks and two tufts of grass; or the general store)
text.zh: 弄一根鱼竿（{key:craft} 制作：两根树枝、两把草；或在杂货店买）

text.en: Catch a fish in the pond (hold the rod, left click the water)
text.zh: 在池塘里钓起一条鱼（拿着鱼竿，左键点水）

say.en: Look, a pond! Something just jumped. Make a rod from two sticks and two tufts of grass; you can do it by hand ({key:craft}). Then stand on the bank, hold it and left click the water.
say.zh: 看，池塘！刚才有东西跳了一下。用两根树枝、两把草就能徒手做根鱼竿（{key:craft}）。然后站到岸边，拿着它左键点水。

hint.en: A rod is two sticks and two tufts of grass, made by hand ({key:craft}); the general store sells one too. On the bank, hold it and left click the water, and sometimes something bites. A cast stirs the water, so wait a moment before the next.
hint.zh: 鱼竿用两根树枝、两把草徒手做（{key:craft}），杂货店也有卖。站在岸边拿着它左键点水，有时会有鱼咬钩。甩一竿会惊动水面，等一会儿再甩下一竿。

log.en: There is a pond in the village. Lumi wants me to try fishing.
log.zh: 村里有个池塘。露米让我试试钓鱼。

say.en: You have a rod! Now to the water. Hold it and left click the pond; if nothing bites, cast again when the ripples settle. Bait on the hook makes them bite twice as fast: hold the bait and right click the rod.
say.zh: 有鱼竿了！去水边吧。拿着它左键点池塘；没咬钩的话，等水面平了再甩。钩上挂了鱼饵，咬钩会快一倍：拿着鱼饵，右键点鱼竿。

hint.en: Stand on the bank with the rod in hand and left click the water. A cast stirs it, so wait a moment between casts. At first light, now and then, a Dawnscale bites.
hint.zh: 站在岸边，手拿鱼竿，左键点水。甩一竿水面会被惊动，两竿之间要等一会儿。天刚亮的时候，偶尔能钓到晨鳞鱼。

log.en: I have a fishing rod of my own. Now the pond.
log.zh: 有了自己的鱼竿。该去池塘了。

say.en: You caught one! Cook it on a fire, or eat it as it is. What bites depends on the hour and the weather: eels at night, catfish in the rain. Here, some bait for next time.
say.zh: 钓到了！可以放在火上烤，也可以直接吃。钓到什么鱼，要看时辰和天气：夜里有鳗鱼，下雨天有鲶鱼。这点鱼饵给你，下次用。

log.en: My first fish. What bites depends on the hour and the weather.
log.zh: 钓到了第一条鱼。钓到什么，要看时辰和天气。

summary.en: The supplies crate by the kitchen garden of Firstlight Village holds a hoe, a sickle, a bucket of water and seeds. Harvest a ripe crop with the sickle, sow a seed on the bare row and water it.
summary.zh: 初原村菜圃旁的工具箱里有锄头、镰刀、一桶水和种子。用镰刀收一株熟了的作物，在空着的那一行播一粒种子，再浇上水。

text.en: Take the hoe from the garden supplies ({key:hands} on the crate)
text.zh: 从菜圃工具箱里拿锄头（对箱子按 {key:hands}）

text.en: Take the sickle
text.zh: 拿镰刀

text.en: Take some seeds
text.zh: 拿一些种子

text.en: Harvest a ripe crop with the sickle (hold it, left click the crop)
text.zh: 用镰刀收割一株成熟的作物（拿着镰刀，左键点作物）

text.en: Sow a seed on the bare row of the garden (hold the seed, right click the farmland)
text.zh: 在菜圃空着的那一行播一粒种子（拿着种子，右键点耕地）

text.en: Water a crop (hold the bucket of water, left click the crop)
text.zh: 给一株作物浇水（拿着水桶，左键点作物）

say.en: This is the village garden! The crate at its corner has a hoe, a sickle, a bucket of water and seeds. Open it ({key:hands}) and take the hoe, the sickle and some seeds. We can borrow them.
say.zh: 这是村里的菜圃！角上的箱子里有锄头、镰刀、一桶水和种子。打开它（{key:hands}），把锄头、镰刀和一些种子拿上。借来用用没关系的。

hint.en: The supplies crate stands at the garden's east corner. {key:hands} opens it; take the hoe, the sickle and some seeds (and the bucket of water, for later).
hint.zh: 工具箱在菜圃东边的角上。按 {key:hands} 打开，拿锄头、镰刀和一些种子（水桶也拿上，待会儿用）。

log.en: The village garden, with a crate of tools beside it. Lumi wants to teach me to grow things.
log.zh: 村里的菜圃，旁边有一箱工具。露米想教我种地。

say.en: Good! See the rows? Sprouts, young plants, and the top row is ripe. Cut one with the sickle; you get the crop and its seeds back. Then sow a seed on the bare bottom row and water it with the bucket. A crop grows a stage every one to four hours, as its seed says, and needs water at each stage. Once you know Irrigation, one watering lasts two stages.
say.zh: 好！看见那几排了吗？嫩芽、小苗，最上面一排已经熟了。用镰刀割一株，作物和种子都能拿到。然后在最下面空着的那行播一粒种子，用水桶浇上水。作物每一到四个小时长一个阶段，种子说明上写着；每个阶段都要浇水。学会引水以后，浇一次管两个阶段。

hint.en: Hold the sickle and left click a ripe plant to harvest it. Hold a seed and right click the bare farmland on the bottom row to sow it. Hold the bucket of water and left click a growing plant to water it (the well by the square fills an empty bucket). A hoe on grass makes new farmland.
hint.zh: 拿着镰刀左键点熟了的作物就能收割。拿着种子右键点最下面一行的空耕地就是播种。拿着水桶左键点正在长的作物就是浇水（广场边的井能装满空桶）。拿锄头点草地就能开出新的耕地。

log.en: Hoe, sickle and seeds in hand. The top row is ripe; the bottom row is bare.
log.zh: 锄头、镰刀和种子都拿了。最上面一排熟了；最下面一行空着。

say.en: You did it! Crops are food, and you can sell them too. With the hoe you can turn any grass into a garden of your own. Here, a few more seeds.
say.zh: 种成了！收下的作物能吃，也能卖。有了锄头，哪片草地都能开成你自己的菜圃。再给你几粒种子。

log.en: Harvested, sowed and watered. With a hoe I can start a garden on any grass.
log.zh: 收了，种了，也浇了。有了锄头，哪片草地都能开成菜圃。

summary.en: Five wayside shrines stand along the Pilgrim's Road, one for each of the Five Sufferings, each on its square of flagstones. Hold what a shrine asks, face it and put it down ({key:put}): it takes the offering and lights. The words cut on it ({key:hands}) say what it asks.
summary.zh: 朝圣者之路上立着五座路边圣龛，五苦各一座，每座都立在一小块石板地上。拿着它要的东西，面对它放下（{key:put}），它就收下供品亮起来。石上刻的字（{key:hands}）写着它要什么。

text.en: Lay something worn on the head on the Shrine of the Crown (hold it, face the shrine, {key:put})
text.zh: 给荆棘冠之龛献上一件戴在头上的东西（拿在手上，面对圣龛按 {key:put}）

text.en: Lay a rope or a cord on the Shrine of the Pillar (hold it, face the shrine, {key:put})
text.zh: 给鞭刑柱之龛献上一根绳索（拿在手上，面对圣龛按 {key:put}）

text.en: Lay something to eat on the Shrine of the Scales (hold it, face the shrine, {key:put})
text.zh: 给饥刑之秤之龛献上一样吃的（拿在手上，面对圣龛按 {key:put}）

text.en: Lay something made of metal on the Shrine of the Nails (hold it, face the shrine, {key:put})
text.zh: 给钉刑圣木之龛献上一件金属的东西（拿在手上，面对圣龛按 {key:put}）

text.en: Lay a torch or a candle on the Shrine of the Lance (hold it, face the shrine, {key:put})
text.zh: 给穿心圣枪之龛献上火把或蜡烛（拿在手上，面对圣龛按 {key:put}）

say.en: See the dark stone on the flagstones by the road? That's one of the shrines the priest talked about! Each one asks for something different; read the carving ({key:hands}) and it tells you. Hold what it asks, face the shrine and put it down ({key:put}). I'll mark all five for you.
say.zh: 看见路边石板地上那块深色的石头了吗？那就是司铎说的圣龛！每座要的东西不一样，读一读上面刻的字（{key:hands}）就知道了。把它要的东西拿在手上，面对圣龛放下（{key:put}）。五座我都给你标出来了。

hint.en: The five shrines, west to east: the Crown asks for something worn on the head (a hat, a hood, a helmet); the Pillar a rope or a cord (cut grass will do); the Scales something to eat; the Nails something made of metal (iron ore will do); the Lance a torch or a candle. The road itself holds one of each: a pilgrim's hat, a plaited cord, a loaf in the abandoned cart, a dented helm and a candle ({key:hands} picks them up). Hold the offering, face the shrine and press {key:put}. It will not take a relic, a keepsake, or anything that matters most.
hint.zh: 五座圣龛从西往东：荆棘冠之龛要戴在头上的（帽子、兜帽、头盔）；鞭刑柱之龛要一根绳索（干草也行）；饥刑之秤之龛要一样吃的；钉刑圣木之龛要金属的东西（铁矿石也行）；穿心圣枪之龛要火把或蜡烛。这条路上就各有一样：朝圣者的帽子、苦修者编的草绳、被丢下的推车里的面包、一顶凹陷的头盔、一支蜡烛（按 {key:hands} 捡起来）。拿着供品，面对圣龛按 {key:put}。遗物、纪念品和最要紧的东西，它不收。

log.en: Five shrines along the Pilgrim's Road, each asking its own offering. Lumi marked them for me.
log.zh: 朝圣者之路上有五座圣龛，各要一样供品。露米替我标出来了。

say.en: It lit! See the little light in the carving? The others work the same way. Pilgrims left things all along this road; what the others ask for is lying about if you look.
say.zh: 亮了！看见刻痕里那点小光了吗？别的几座也是这样。以前的朝圣者在这条路上丢下了不少东西，别的几座要的，仔细找找都能捡到。

hint.en: Hold the offering, face the shrine and press {key:put}. A shrine that asks for something else says what it wants. The markers show the ones still dark.
hint.zh: 拿着供品，面对圣龛按 {key:put}。献错了，圣龛会说它要什么。标记指着还没亮的那几座。

log.en: The first shrine took my offering and lit.
log.zh: 第一座圣龛收下供品，亮了。

log.en: All five shrines took their offerings.
log.zh: 五座圣龛都收下了供品。

say.en: Hey! You're awake at last! I'm Lumi. I'm a fairy, and from today I go where you go.
say.zh: 嘿！你总算醒了！我叫露米，是个精灵。从今天起，你去哪儿，我就跟到哪儿。

say.en: Feeling better? If we want to make anything, we'll need sticks, stones and grass.
say.zh: 好点了吧？要做东西的话，得先有树枝、石头和草。

say.en: That's enough for an axe!
say.zh: 这些够做一把斧头了！

say.en: An axe! Now we need wood.
say.zh: 有斧头了！现在去弄点木头吧。

say.en: Planks! It gets dark early in the woods, and things come out at night. Let's get a fire going first.
say.zh: 木板！林子里天黑得早，天一黑就会有东西出来。我们先生一堆火吧。

say.en: Oh, that's warm! Now you need a roof over your head.
say.zh: 好暖和！接下来，给自己盖个屋子吧。

say.en: A house of your own! Now we just have to get through the night. Eat something before you sleep; there are always more berries. We'll leave at first light.
say.zh: 你有自己的屋子了！现在只要熬过今晚就好。睡前吃点东西吧，浆果摘完了还会再长。天一亮我们就出发。

say.en: It's morning! You made it. The path to the south is clear now. Let's go down to the foot of the mountain!
say.zh: 天亮了！你熬过来了。南边的小路现在能走了，我们下山去吧！

say.en: Not that way yet. We'd get lost in those woods. Let's settle in here first.
say.zh: 先别往那边走，在那片林子里会迷路的。我们先在这儿安顿下来吧。

say.en: The foot of the mountain! See the old stone in the flowers down there?
say.zh: 到伤石山麓了！你看，下面花丛里有块旧石头。

say.en: You're awake! I'm Lumi. I'm a fairy, and from today I go where you go. We're on Cloudtop, at the very top of the mountain. The only way down is through the cut in the rocks to the south.
say.zh: 你醒啦！我叫露米，是个精灵。从今天起，你去哪儿，我就跟到哪儿。这里是云顶台地，在山的最高处。下山的路只有一条，就是南边岩壁上那道豁口。

say.en: Look, a waypoint statue! Walk up to it and press {key:hands} to wake it. After that, the map ({key:map}) can bring you back to it from anywhere.
say.zh: 看，是传送雕像！走过去按 {key:hands} 唤醒它。以后打开地图（{key:map}），从哪儿都能传送回这里。

say.en: It's cold near it. I don't like it. I don't know why I don't like it. ...Try doing something to it, anything. Whatever you do, the world will answer.
say.zh: 它旁边好冷。我不喜欢它。我也不知道为什么不喜欢。……你对它做点什么试试，做什么都行。不管你做什么，世界都会回应的。

say.en: Did you see that? It answered! Whatever the world learns is kept in the Threadbook: {key:journal}. Come on, down to Vesper Ford!
say.zh: 你看到了吗？它回应了！世界学会的东西都记在织线簿里，按 {key:journal} 就能看。走吧，下山去晚祷渡！

say.en: That's Vesper Ford! Someone down there looks like they need help.
say.zh: 是晚祷渡！下面那个人好像遇到麻烦了。

say.en: Steam! It's a warm spring. If you sit in it, your wounds heal. Come back here when you're hurt.
say.zh: 冒热气了！是温泉。泡在里面，伤口会慢慢长好。受了伤就回这里来。

say.en: We're across! But the village still needs us, and we don't know yet what's down that road. Let's not go too far.
say.zh: 我们过来了！不过村里还等着我们呢，这条路通到哪儿也还不知道。先别走太远。

text.en: Off the mountain? Nobody has come down that stair since the storm. And the evenings come sooner every week.
text.zh: 从山上下来的？风暴以后，那道石阶就没人走过。天也一个礼拜比一个礼拜黑得早。

text.en: The storm took my ferry rope. The bridge was a rider. He was all in white, with a crown of thorns grown through his helm. He pulled the planks up with his hands and laid the nails out on my pier in a row, like a toll.
text.zh: 风暴扯断了我的渡绳。桥是一个骑手拆的。那人一身白，荆棘冠长进了头盔里。他徒手把木板一块块拔起来，把钉子在我的码头上摆成一排，像是交了过路钱。

text.en: Three planks would mend it. There's an old axe by the stump, and the woods are full of trees.
text.zh: 补上三块木板，桥就能走。树桩边上有把旧斧头，林子里树有的是。

text.en: West of here is Firstlight Village. Tobin keeps his cart there now. A meal might buy you something useful from him.
text.zh: 往西是初原村。托宾现在把货车停在那边。给他一顿饭，兴许能换到点有用的东西。

text.en: It's a small place. Good soil, a well, and a roof when the weather turns.
text.zh: 村子不大。地好，有口井，变天了也有个躲雨的地方。

text.en: They've had it worse than me, though. Two of theirs went missing in the storm, I hear. Rowan, their elder, is asking anyone who can hold a blade. The bridge can wait. Go to them first.
text.zh: 不过他们比我惨。听说村里有两个人在风暴里没了音信。他们的长老罗万在找会使兵器的人。桥不急，你先去那边。

text.en: (In your pack: the end of a travel loaf.)
text.zh: （行囊里还剩一截路上吃的面包。）

text.en: There. Mind the step. Mind the road, too. Nobody has walked it since the storm.
text.zh: 到了。上岸当心脚下。那条路风暴以后还没人走过，路上也当心。

text.en: Go on, then. East, the road comes first to the Church's Rest. The rider went a long way past it, beyond the burned farm. If you find him, mind his bow.
text.zh: 去吧。往东走，先到教会的驿站。那个骑手去得远多了，在烧掉的农庄再过去。真找着他，当心他的弓。

text.en: If you need anything before the road, Firstlight Village is just west of here.
text.zh: 上路前要是还缺什么，初原村就在西边，不远。

text.en: A traveller down from the mountain, and a fairy with you... We have not had a guest like you in a long while. Welcome to Firstlight. Come and warm your hands at the flame; it was lit on the first morning after the First Night.
text.zh: 从山上下来的旅人，身边还跟着一位精灵……村里很久没有来过这样的客人了。欢迎来到初原村。过来烤烤手吧，这团火是初夜过后的第一个清晨点起来的。

text.en: A fairy! Can I draw her? Can I? Don't move, either of you!
text.zh: 是精灵！我能画她吗？能吗？你们俩都先别动！

text.en: Draw me? ...All right. But be quick. I'm no good at keeping still.
text.zh: 画我？……好吧。不过要快一点，我可停不了太久。

text.en: Pell, let them be. — Traveller, I am sorry you have come at a bad time. Two of ours are missing. When you have warmed up, come and find me, and I will tell you the rest.
text.zh: 佩尔，别缠着人家。——旅人，你来得不巧，村里有两个人不见了。等你暖和过来，来找我，我再跟你细说。

text.en: So somebody did come. ...Listen. It wasn't the dead that shut us in. A man in grey pulled the inner door shut from the outside. Later he pushed a loaf under it.
text.zh: 还真有人来了。……听着，把我们关在这儿的不是死人。是一个穿灰衣服的男人，从外面把里头那道门拉上的。后来他又从门缝底下塞进来一块面包。

text.en: There's a mark on the bread. Ash, pressed in with a thumb.
text.zh: 面包上有个印子。是灰，用拇指按上去的。

text.en: Oskar took the stair in the east cell to look for another way out. He hasn't come back. It goes a long way down, further than any barrow should. ...I'm not asking you to go after him.
text.zh: 奥斯卡从东边那间的楼梯下去找别的出路，到现在也没回来。那底下很深，比哪座古墓都深。……我可没求你去找他。

text.en: I can hear them moving in the dark. All the time.
text.zh: 我一直听见它们在黑暗里走动。一刻都没停过。

text.en: (As the warden falls apart, its jaw moves. A sound comes out of it, something like a voice.)
text.zh: （守墓者散架的时候，它的下巴动了动，发出一点像是人声的响动。）

text.en: ("The night... is coming back. I could not... lie down.")
text.zh: （"夜……又回来了。我……躺不下去。"）

text.en: It spoke. ...Can the dead speak?
text.zh: 它说话了……死人也会说话吗？

text.en: (On the altar behind where it stood, words are cut into the stone: "I WILL HOLD UNTIL I AM RELIEVED. — ALBERIC." Under them, pressed into the soot, is a thumbprint of ash.)
text.zh: （它原先站的地方后面是一座祭坛，石头上刻着字："我将坚守，直到有人来接替我。——阿尔贝里克。"字下面的烟灰里，按着一个灰色的拇指印。）

text.en: Sister Ilse, tell the one where the sun goes out. Please? The pilgrim has never heard it.
text.zh: 伊尔丝修女，讲太阳熄灭的那个故事吧。求你了，朝圣者还没听过呢。

text.en: Long ago the days grew shorter and shorter, until one morning the sun did not rise at all. The crops died. The beasts changed. The dead found no rest. That was the First Night.
text.zh: 很久以前，白昼一天比一天短，到后来，太阳再也没有升起。庄稼枯死，野兽变了样子，死去的人不得安息。那就是初夜。

text.en: Then Astra came. He took the crown of thorns. He was scourged at the pillar. He starved upon the scales. He was nailed to the holy wood.
text.zh: 后来，阿斯特拉来了。他戴上荆棘冠，在刑柱上受鞭，在天平上忍饥，被钉在圣木之上。

text.en: And when the spear went through his heart, the sun rose.
text.zh: 圣枪刺穿他心脏的那一刻，太阳升起来了。

text.en: Lumi? You're shaking.
text.zh: 露米？你在发抖。

text.en: No, I'm not. It's just cold.
text.zh: 我没有……是天太冷了。

text.en: Suffering is not God's abandonment, Pell. It is the proof the debt is being paid. ...Now, children, tonight we give thanks at the flame. Pell, wash your hands first; your sleeves are covered in chalk.
text.zh: 佩尔，苦难并非神的遗弃。苦难，是灾厄得以被偿还的证明。……好了，孩子们，今晚我们要在圣火前感恩。佩尔，先去把手洗干净，你的袖子上全是粉笔灰。

text.en: You saw him too? A man in grey walked across my river. The water froze under each step he took, and it had melted again behind him before I had my boots on.
text.zh: 你也看见了？一个灰衣人从我的河上走过去了。他走一步，脚底下就结一层冰。我还没套上靴子，他身后的冰就化没了。

text.en: (Far off to the east, beyond the far bank, a small light bobs along the road, and goes out.)
text.zh: （远远的东边，过了对岸，一点小小的灯光沿着大路晃着，后来灭了。）

text.en: Thirty-one years I have kept this water. I have never seen it hold a man up.
text.zh: 我在这条河上守了三十一年，从没见它托住过一个人。

text.en: I carried his lance for six years, when I was young. He had worn the crown two hundred and fifty years by then, and still he would stop the whole column to kneel down and talk to children by the road. Knights don't do that. He did.
text.zh: 我年轻的时候给他扛过六年长枪。那时候他戴那顶冠已经两百五十年了，可走在路上，他还会让整支队伍停下来，自己单膝跪下，跟路边的孩子说话。骑士是不会这样做的。他会。

text.en: But the crown kept taking. Every year I was with him, there was a little less of him. One morning he looked at me and asked me my name.
text.zh: 可那顶冠一直在拿走他的东西。我在他身边的那几年，他一年比一年少一点。有一天早上，他看着我，问我叫什么名字。

text.en: I left that night. ...If he asks your name, pilgrim, tell him. Somebody should.
text.zh: 我当天夜里就走了。……朝圣者，要是他问你叫什么，告诉他。总得有人告诉他。

text.en: Look at the stumps by the bridge. Where the planks were, he drove thorns into the wood, like a man marking what is his.
text.zh: 你去看桥边那几根桩子。原来搭木板的地方，他都钉上了荆棘，像是在自己的东西上做记号。

text.en: Aldo and Joss built that bridge the year before the river took Aldo. Every board I walked on, he cut.
text.zh: 那座桥是阿尔多和乔斯一起搭的，搭好的第二年，河就把阿尔多带走了。我脚下踩的每一块板子，都是他锯的。

text.en: Mend it. Then go and tell that knight whose bridge it was.
text.zh: 把桥修好。然后去告诉那个骑士，那是谁的桥。

say.en: Is the sun lower than it was this morning? It's only just past noon. — And there are thorns all along the road, planted in a line.
say.zh: 太阳是不是比早上低了？明明才过中午。——路边全是荆棘，一棵挨着一棵，种成了一排。

text.en: Stay back! ...You're alive. I'm sorry. Nothing alive has come up this road in a long time.
text.zh: 站住！……你是活人。对不住。这条路上很久没来过活人了。

text.en: The days were too short, and the wheat died in the field. Then the night things came. Then a knight in white rode through and took everything that shone: the hinges, the pans, my husband's ring off the gatepost.
text.zh: 白天太短，麦子没长成就死在地里了。后来夜里那些东西来了。再后来，一个穿白的骑士骑马过来，把会发亮的东西全拿走了——门上的铰链、锅，还有我丈夫挂在门柱上的戒指。

text.en: The night the barn burned, a man in grey dragged me out of the smoke. Please don't tell them in the village. They wouldn't understand.
text.zh: 谷仓烧起来的那天夜里，是一个灰衣人把我从烟里拖出来的。你别跟村里人说。他们不会明白的。

text.en: Pilgrim, go back. There is nothing at the end of this road that you are looking for.
text.zh: 朝圣者，回去吧。这条路走到头，也没有你要找的东西。

text.en: The knight beyond the thorns has held this road for three hundred years. He was a good man, and he still is.
text.zh: 荆棘后面那位骑士，守这条路守了三百年。他是个好人，到现在也还是。

text.en: Your Church wants you to take his crown. Take it, then. I will not stop you.
text.zh: 教会要你去取他的冠冕。你去取吧，我不拦你。

text.en: Only, when the crown comes off, something will come out of it. That, I will take with me.
text.zh: 只是冠冕摘下来的时候，会有东西从里面出来。那个东西，我要带走。

text.en: (He looks at Lumi, for a long time, and says nothing. Then he turns and walks away.)
text.zh: （他看了露米一眼，看了很久，什么也没说，转身走了。）

text.en: (A logbook lies open on the table, its pages stiff with cold. Column after column of sunset times, year after year, each a little earlier than the last.)
text.zh: （桌上摊着一本日志，纸页冻得发硬。上面一栏一栏记着日落的时刻，一年接一年，每一年都比前一年早一点。）

text.en: (The last page: "Found a small light asleep in the snow by the cairn, warm as a coal. It woke and asked me how old it was.")
text.zh: （最后一页："在石堆旁的雪里发现一点睡着的光，暖得像炭火。它醒了，问我它多大了。"）

text.en: It's so cold in here... Let's go.
text.zh: 这里好冷……我们快走吧。

say.en: The cows are all crowded at the north end, as far from the trees as they can get. Are they afraid of something?
say.zh: 牛都挤在北头，离树林能多远就多远。它们在怕什么吗？

text.en: (The light turns amber. One by one the cows fold their front legs and go down on their knees, every one of them facing east.)
text.zh: （天光变成了琥珀色。牛一头接一头屈下前腿，跪了下去，全都朝着东边。）

text.en: Every dusk, ever since the bridge went down. My gran never saw a cow kneel in her whole life.
text.zh: 每天黄昏都这样，从桥断了那天起就是。我奶奶活了一辈子，也没见过牛下跪。

text.en: And after dark the dead come up out of the trees. I've lost three cows this month. If you can swing a weapon, come and find me.
text.zh: 天一黑，死人就从林子里爬出来。这个月我已经丢了三头牛。你要是会使兵器，来找我。

say.en: Listen. ...There are no birds. Not one. A forest this big ought to be noisy in the afternoon.
say.zh: 你听……一声鸟叫都没有。这么大的林子，下午本来该很热闹的。

text.en: (A camp nobody has used in a very long time: a tent gone to rags, a ring of cold stones, and a cairn with a pilgrim's staff leaning on it.)
text.zh: （一处很久没人用过的营地：帐篷烂成了布条，一圈冷掉的石头，还有一座石冢，上面靠着一根朝圣杖。）

text.en: There's a paper nailed to that tree. It says, "The Seal-bearers weaken. Let the pilgrimage be called."
text.zh: 那棵树上钉着一张纸。上面写着："持印者渐衰，当发朝圣令。"

text.en: It's very old. The name on it is Brother Cassian, of Firstlight. Sister Ilse might have known him.
text.zh: 这张纸好旧了。上面的名字是初原村的卡西安修士。伊尔丝修女说不定认识他。

text.en: (Something glints by the cairn: a scallop shell on a cord, the pilgrim's mark.)
text.zh: （石冢旁边有东西在闪：一枚穿在绳上的扇贝壳，朝圣者的标记。）

text.en: (By the cold fire ring a pale shape is kneeling, its head bowed, as if it has knelt there for a very long time.)
text.zh: （冷掉的火圈旁跪着一个苍白的影子，低着头，像是已经在那里跪了很久。）

text.en: ("Do not kneel to him," it says, without looking up.)
text.zh: （"别向他下跪。"它说，没有抬头。）

text.en: It's gone. It was right there... Can we go now? Please?
text.zh: 它不见了。刚才明明就在那儿……我们走吧，好不好？

say.en: Down there, past the thorns, the dead are sleeping badly. I can feel it from here, like a draught under a door.
say.zh: 荆棘那边，地底下的死人睡得很不安稳。我在这儿都感觉得到，像门缝底下钻进来的风。

say.en: There's a knight carved on these stones, wearing a crown of thorns. Fennick might know who is buried down there.
say.zh: 这些石头上刻着一个骑士，戴着荆棘冠。下面埋的是谁，芬尼克也许知道。

say.en: Listen to the wheel. It keeps stopping and starting. Tam says something has got into his cellar, and that's where the lamp oil is kept.
say.zh: 你听那水车，转一阵停一阵的。塔姆说他的地窖里钻进了东西，灯油就放在那下面。

say.en: Slimes, down here in the cellar! The oil flasks are on the shelves at the back.
say.zh: 地窖里有史莱姆！油瓶在最里面的架子上。

say.en: They say this is where the sun came back after the First Night. Look, all the flowers up here face east. Those must be the dawnbloom.
say.zh: 听说初夜过后，太阳就是从这里重新升起来的。你看，这里的花全都朝着东边。那些应该就是晨光花了。

text.en: (You take the old rope in both hands and pull. High above, the bell swings once, twice, and its voice rolls down the hill toward Firstlight.)
text.zh: （你双手握住那根旧绳，用力往下拉。高处的钟晃了一下，又一下，钟声顺着山坡一路传向初原村。）

text.en: They'll hear that in the village!
text.zh: 村里一定听得见！

text.en: Sister Ilse says the Firstlight was lit on that hearth, from the first sun of that morning.
text.zh: 伊尔丝修女说，初火就是在那座火坛上，借着那天早上的第一道阳光点起来的。

say.en: Bones in every wall, and a name over each one. Knights. A whole order of knights, buried down here together. ...They aren't resting either.
say.zh: 每面墙里都是骨头，每一具上面都刻着名字。是骑士，一整个骑士团都埋在这底下。……他们也没有安息。

say.en: This niche has a name on it, but nobody inside. "Fennick, squire to the Commander." Fennick? The old man on the bench in the village? And it has been swept clean.
say.zh: 这个墓龛刻了名字，里面却是空的。"芬尼克，骑士长的侍从。"芬尼克？是村里坐在长凳上的那位老爷爷吗？而且这里扫得干干净净。

text.en: About time. I came down looking for another way out, and the dead herded me in here like a sheep.
text.zh: 总算来了。我下来找别的出路，结果被那些死人像赶羊一样赶进了这儿。

text.en: Did you read the roll on the altar back there? Forty-odd knights of some Order of the Thorn. The last name is cut deeper than the rest.
text.zh: 后面祭坛上那份名册，你看了没有？四十来个骑士，什么荆棘骑士团的。最后那个名字刻得比别的都深。

text.en: Whatever keeps this place is further down, at the bottom of the stair in the north-east corner. I heard it walking all night, back and forth, like a guard on a wall.
text.zh: 看守这地方的东西在更底下，东北角那道楼梯下去就是。我听它走了一整夜，来来回回的，跟城墙上站岗的一样。

say.en: It's standing in front of the altar, and it isn't coming for us. Is it keeping watch?
say.zh: 它站在祭坛前面，没有朝我们过来。它是在站岗吗？

say.en: A statue. We can rest here. If I ever have more than one power, this is where I can change it. ...It's cold past those thorns. Colder than at the shrine stone.
say.zh: 是传送雕像，可以在这儿歇一歇。以后我要是有了不止一种力量，就在这种地方换。……荆棘那边好冷，比路碑那里还冷。

text.en: You must be the pilgrim the letter named, the one with the fairy. Welcome to the Rest. I am Father Caius. The Holy See keeps me here to see its pilgrims on their way east.
text.zh: 你就是信上说的那位朝圣者吧，带着一位精灵。欢迎来到驿站。我是凯乌斯司铎，圣座派我守在这里，送朝圣者往东去。

text.en: Before the road, the oath. Come into the chapel and kneel at the five wounds. Every pilgrim the Holy See has sent east took the oath there first.
text.zh: 上路之前，要先立誓。请到礼拜堂里来，在五道圣伤前跪下。圣座派往东边的朝圣者，都是在那里立过誓才走的。

text.en: Kneel, and say it after me. The first suffering, the Crown: they pressed the thorns into his brow, and he did not lift his hand.
text.zh: 请跪下，随我诵念。第一苦，戴冠：荆棘刺入他的额头，他不曾抬手。

text.en: The second, the Scourge: bound to the pillar, he bled for every one of us. The third, Hunger: his flesh at last weighed less than sin.
text.zh: 第二苦，受鞭：他被缚于刑柱，为我们每一个人流血。第三苦，受饥：他的肉身最终轻于罪。

text.en: The fourth, the Nails: upon the holy wood he accepted death. The fifth, the Lance: when it pierced his heart, the sun rose again.
text.zh: 第四苦，受钉：他在圣木之上接受了死亡。第五苦，受枪：圣枪穿透他心口的那一刻，太阳重新升起。

text.en: Rise. There are five wayside shrines on the road east, one for each suffering. Lay at each what its suffering asks, and it will light. Halfway along, a path goes north to the old abbey. The knight is further east.
text.zh: 起来吧。往东的路上有五座圣龛，一苦一座。在每座龛前放下那一苦所求之物，它就会亮起来。路走到一半，有条小路往北通到旧修道院。骑士还在更东边。

text.en: The Seal-bearer has held that road for three hundred years. The Holy See asks you to overcome him and bring home the Crown, the first of the five instruments. ...He was due to be relieved, once. That is not a pilgrim's concern.
text.zh: 那位持印者守着那条路，已经三百年了。圣座要你击败他，把荆棘冠带回来，那是五件圣器中的第一件。……从前，本该有人去接替他的。这不是朝圣者该过问的事。

text.en: "Relieved"? By who?
text.zh: 接替？谁去接替？

text.en: I have seen you pray. You say every word the way you were taught. Not many still do. — Take these: holy water, sent from the Holy See. The dead on the road will keep away from it.
text.zh: 我看见你祈祷了，一字一句，都是照着教的来。如今这样的人不多了。——这个给你，是圣座送来的圣水。路上的死人怕它。

text.en: One thing more. The abbey kept its papers in the chapter hall. If you come across a writ of relief there, come back and tell me what it says. I was told not to ask about it.
text.zh: 还有一件事。修道院的文书都收在骑士团大厅里。你要是在那里看到一份替任文书，回来告诉我上面写了什么。上头吩咐过，这件事我不许打听。

text.en: I am told you say there are no gods. And yet you walk to the Seal-bearer with the Church's letter in your bag.
text.zh: 我听说，你到处说世上没有神。可你包里揣着教会的信，正往持印者那里去。

text.en: Go on, then. But the Rest's blessing is for pilgrims, and I will not pretend you are one.
text.zh: 那你就走吧。驿站的祝福是给朝圣者的，我不能装作你也是。

text.en: Come on. We can find the shrines without him.
text.zh: 走吧。没有他，我们也找得到圣龛。

text.en: You no longer pray at their altars. Then I will say this once.
text.zh: 你不再去他们的祭坛前祈祷了。那我就说一次。

text.en: Leave the shrines on this road unlit. Walk past them.
text.zh: 这条路上的圣龛，不要去点。从旁边走过去。

text.en: In the abbey north of the road there is a letter that was never sent. Read it.
text.zh: 路北边的修道院里，有一封从没寄出去的信。去读一读。

text.en: You have come from the east. ...Then it is done, and the road is open. The Holy See will have the Crown, the first of the five.
text.zh: 你是从东边过来的。……那么，事情已经了结，路也通了。圣座会收到荆棘冠，五件圣器中的第一件。

text.en: Stay as long as you need, pilgrim. The chapel is always open.
text.zh: 想歇多久就歇多久，朝圣者。礼拜堂一直开着。

say.en: There are white flags all along this road. Whose are they?
say.zh: 这条路上插着好多白旗。是谁插的呢？

text.en: (A man kneels by the road, his back bare, a cord in his hand. He strikes himself once, steadily, and looks up.)
text.zh: （路边跪着一个男人，赤着脊背，手里握着一根绳子。他稳稳地抽了自己一下，抬起头来。）

text.en: Don't be frightened, pilgrim. I am Brother Ezra. The Seal-bearers bear Astra's pain for all of us, and I take a little of theirs, a stroke at a time. It is what I can do.
text.zh: 别怕，朝圣者。我是以斯拉修士。持印者替我们大家承受阿斯特拉的痛苦，我就替他们分担一点，一下一下地来。我能做的，也就这些。

text.en: Once I went as far as the field of stones. The knight was there, mending one of his flags. When he saw me his hands stopped, and he stood a long while holding the needle. Then he told me to kneel. I knelt, and I came back.
text.zh: 有一回，我走到了跪石原。那位骑士就在那里，在补他的一面旗子。他看见我，手就停了，捏着针站了好久。然后他叫我跪下。我跪了，后来就回来了。

text.en: (The fifth carving kindles. All along the road the five small lights burn at once, and the middle one throws its light up the path north, to the abbey.)
text.zh: （第五道刻痕亮了。整条路上，五点小小的火光同时燃起，中间那一点的光顺着往北的小路，一直照到修道院。）

text.en: The crown one is cold. Colder than the others... — Look, the light goes up that path. That's the abbey the priest told us about.
text.zh: 荆棘冠那一座好冷，比别的都冷……——你看，光照到那条小路上去了。那就是司铎说的修道院吧。

say.en: There's a statue in the middle of the yard. It's the only thing here nobody knocked down.
say.zh: 院子正中间有一座雕像。这里只有它没被推倒。

say.en: This room is tiny, and so cold. There are pages lying by the desk.
say.zh: 这间屋子好小，也好冷。书桌旁边掉了几页纸。

text.en: (A writ of relief under the Order's wax seal. It reads: Alberic, bearer of the Crown, has borne it forty years; another shall be sent to take it up from him.)
text.zh: （一份盖着骑士团火漆的替任文书。上面写着：持冠者阿尔贝里克承印已满四十年，当另派一人接替。）

text.en: (The seal is whole. It was never opened, and never sent. On the back is a line in newer ink: "No one can be found who will bear it. Let him go on holding.")
text.zh: （火漆完好，没有拆过，也没有寄出去。背面有一行字，墨色比正文新：找不到愿意承受的人。就让他继续守着吧。）

text.en: It was never sent... Let's take it with us.
text.zh: 一直没有寄出去……我们把它带上吧。

text.en: Who comes for the seal? ...The Crown went east, as was ordained. The relief stays here, with me. We hold, that others need not.
text.zh: 何人……前来取印？……荆冠已遵命东去。替任之书，留在我这里。我们坚守，好让别人不必。

text.en: He's getting up! Watch out!
text.zh: 他站起来了！小心！

text.en: (A bronze seal: a knight on one knee before a child. Round the rim: WE HOLD, THAT OTHERS NEED NOT. The bronze is warm in the hand.)
text.zh: （一枚青铜印章，印面是一个骑士单膝跪在孩子面前。边缘刻着：我们坚守，好让别人不必。青铜握在手里是温的。）

text.en: (Two rows of stones stand across the field, each carved as a pilgrim on their knees, each with a name and a year cut in it. Between the rows, straw figures in pilgrims' coats are tied kneeling, all facing east.)
text.zh: （原野上立着两排石像，雕的都是跪着的朝圣者，每块上都刻着名字和年份。两排之间，一个个稻草人穿着朝圣者的外衣，被捆成跪姿，全都面朝东方。）

text.en: Oh! That straw one moved — no. It was only the wind.
text.zh: 啊！那个稻草人动了——不对，是风。

say.en: This stone says Corin was "sent with the blessing of the Holy See". Then he stopped at the Rest too, didn't he?
say.zh: 这块石头上说，科林是"奉圣座祝福而来"的。那他也在驿站停过脚吧？

say.en: You don't believe any of it. So why did they all come this far?
say.zh: 你不信这些。那他们为什么都要走这么远，来到这里呢？

say.en: Smoke... It smells like a fire that has been burning for days.
say.zh: 有烟味……闻起来像是一堆烧了好几天的火。

text.en: (The old oak is black with birds. Hundreds of them, wing to wing on every branch, all facing east. Not one makes a sound.)
text.zh: （老橡树上落满了鸟，黑压压一片。几百只，翅膀挨着翅膀，挤满了每一根枝条，全都朝着东边。没有一只出声。）

text.en: So this is where they all went...
text.zh: 原来它们都在这里……

text.en: Don't make a sound. I don't want them all to fly up at once.
text.zh: 别出声。我怕它们一下子全飞起来。

say.en: The river! It's the same one as at Vesper Ford. It bends round this way.
say.zh: 是那条河！和晚祷渡那条是同一条，它在这里拐了个弯。

text.en: (A standing stone half in the river. On it, a boat, and a figure in it handing a fish down to a child. The carving is worn almost smooth.)
text.zh: （一块半泡在河里的立石。上面刻着一条船，船上的人把一条鱼递给岸上的孩子。刻纹几乎磨平了。）

text.en: Who carved this? It looks older than the village.
text.zh: 这是谁刻的呀？看上去比村子还老。

text.en: Lina and Oskar are home. Tonight Firstlight gives thanks to the flame that has kept us, and to our guest, who went down into the barrow and brought them back.
text.zh: 莉娜和奥斯卡回家了。今晚，初原村在这里感谢守护我们的圣火，也感谢这位客人——是你下到长眠冢里，把他们带了回来。

text.en: May Astra watch over us tonight. ...Go to your beds now. The flame keeps the night.
text.zh: 愿阿斯特拉看顾今夜。……都回去睡吧，圣火会守着夜晚。

text.en: (A man in a grey cloak stands at the flame, ash on his hands. He lifts the fire into a hooded lantern as if it weighs nothing.)
text.zh: （一个披灰斗篷的男人站在圣火前，手上沾着灰。他把火捧起来，放进一盏带罩的提灯里，像是那团火没有一点分量。）

text.en: Thief! Stop — THIEF!
text.zh: 有贼！站住——抓贼！

text.en: ...Not tonight.
text.zh: ……今晚不行。

text.en: He went east, over the river! The water froze under his feet, and he walked straight across.
text.zh: 他往东跑了，过河了！河水在他脚底下结了冰，他就那么走过去了。

text.en: By order of the Holy City: the Seal-bearers weaken, and the Long Night returns. Let the pilgrimage be called.
text.zh: 奉圣城之命：持印者渐衰，极夜将返。当发朝圣令。

text.en: One has come down from the mountain with a fairy at their side. The Church names this one pilgrim.
text.zh: 有一人携精灵自山上而来。圣教点名此人为朝圣者。

text.en: (The courier stares at Lumi for a long moment, and says nothing.)
text.zh: （信使盯着露米看了很久，什么也没说。）

text.en: The flame taken, and the Church's letter come, in the same night. ...When you are ready, pilgrim, come to me.
text.zh: 圣火被拿走的这一夜，圣教的信也到了。……朝圣者，等你准备好了，就来找我吧。

text.en: (A field ringed with thorns, and stones carved as kneeling pilgrims. In the middle stands a knight in white, a crown of briars grown through his helm.)
text.zh: （一片被荆棘围起来的田野，一块块石头雕成跪着的朝圣者。正中间站着一位白衣骑士，荆棘冠长进了他的头盔里。）

text.en: None cross that do not kneel.
text.zh: 不跪者，不得过。

text.en: Another pilgrim. They always send another.
text.zh: 又一个朝圣者。他们总会再派一个来。

text.en: I hold. I... hold. I no longer remember what.
text.zh: 我守着。我……守着。守的是什么，我已经不记得了。

text.en: Be careful! When he plants his sword in the ground, thorns come up in a ring around him!
text.zh: 小心！他把剑插进地里的时候，周围会冒出一圈荆棘！

text.en: (The knight kneels. For the first time in a long while he lifts the crown from his own head, and holds it out.)
text.zh: （骑士跪了下来。很久以来头一回，他亲手把荆棘冠从头上摘下，递了过来。）

text.en: ("Take it. It was never mine to hold.")
text.zh: （"拿去吧。它本来就不该由我戴着。"）

text.en: (Something comes loose from the crown, a cold light, and runs to Lumi like water finding an old riverbed.)
text.zh: （荆棘冠上有什么东西散了出来，是一道冷光。它像水寻着旧河床一样，流向了露米。）

text.en: It came to me! ...It's cold. Am I allowed to keep it?
text.zh: 它到我这儿来了！……凉凉的。我可以留着它吗？

text.en: (The grey man opens his lantern. The rest of the light goes into the stolen flame. It flares gold and gutters, and his hand shakes.)
text.zh: （灰衣人打开提灯，剩下的光流进了那团被偷走的圣火。火苗一下子变成金色，摇晃起来；他的手在发抖。）

text.en: Every seal you break makes the night longer. Ask your Church why.
text.zh: 你每打破一道印，夜就会更长一些。去问你的教会，这是为什么。

text.en: Keep what the little one caught. Go home, and tell Rowan the light is safer with me than with any of you.
text.zh: 那个小家伙接住的，你留着。回去吧，告诉罗万，光在我手里，比在你们那里安全。

text.en: The Crown of Thorns, here in Firstlight. ...And that heretic still has our flame.
text.zh: 荆棘冠到了初原村。……可我们的圣火，还在那个异端手里。

text.en: He always did carry things that were too heavy for him.
text.zh: 他从小就总是背着对他来说太重的东西。

text.en: Four minutes. The sun set four minutes early tonight. I am sure it means nothing.
text.zh: 四分钟。今晚太阳早落了四分钟。……我想这应该不代表什么。

card.en:
CHAPTER ONE · THE FIRST SEAL

The White Knight knelt, and gave up the Crown.
The grey man took the light east.
And the night came a little sooner.
card.zh:

白骑士跪下，交出了荆棘冠。
灰衣人带着光往东去了。
夜晚来得更早了一些。

card.en:
CHAPTER ONE · THE FIRST SEAL

The White Knight knelt, and gave up the Crown.
The grey man took the light east.
And the night came a little sooner.

The road on east opens in Part Two.
Until then, Firstlight, its country and the Held Ground are yours.
card.zh:
第一章 · 第一印

白骑士跪下，交出了荆棘冠。
灰衣人带着光往东去了。
夜晚来得更早了一些。

继续往东的路，在第二部开放。
在那之前，初原村、它周围的山野和誓守之地都是你的。

text.en: (Among the thorns where the knight fell, one is still green. It is warm to the touch, and it hums, very faintly, like a door left open.)
text.zh: （骑士倒下的荆棘丛里，有一根还是绿的。摸上去是温的，还在很轻很轻地嗡嗡响，像一扇没关严的门。）

text.en: I think it wants to be used, on you. Hold it and left click. I can hear a field on the other side of it. And... someone waiting.
text.zh: 它好像想让你用一下——对你自己用。拿着它，按左键。我听见它另一边有一片田野。还有……有人在等。

text.en: You have come. ...You are the one who took the crown from me. I could not see your face then. Now I can.
text.zh: 你来了。……替我摘下冠冕的，就是你。那时我看不清你的面容，如今看得清了。

text.en: I swore to hold until I was relieved. You relieved me. So now I hold for you: this ground, as far as the mist. It is yours. Build on it, sow it, keep beasts on it.
text.zh: 我曾立誓，坚守到有人来接替为止。你接替了我。所以如今换我替你守着——这片土地，一直到雾的边缘。它归你了。盖屋、播种、养牲畜，都随你。

text.en: Bring me what a wider ground needs, and I will push the mist back. ...And tell me your name. This time, I would like to keep one.
text.zh: 把扩地所需的东西带来，我便把雾推远些。……还有，请告诉我你的名字。这一次，我想记住一个名字。

text.en: Take this, the coin of this ground. My stall keeps seeds, feed and bait, and buys back what you grow, raise and catch. There are fish in the pond.
text.zh: 拿着，这是这片土地的钱币。我的货摊有种子、饲料和鱼饵；你种的、养的、钓的，我也收。池塘里有鱼。

say.en: The mist pulled back! There's a grove out there, and stones.
say.zh: 雾退开了！那边有一片树林，还有石头。

say.en: Further again: a meadow, and water.
say.zh: 又退远了一圈——一片草地，还有水。

say.en: All of it now. Boundary stones at the edges... and iron in the rocks.
say.zh: 雾全散了。边上立着界石……岩石里还有铁。

text.en: (Everything here has burned: the hay, the orchard, the hen house. Only the house is still standing.)
text.zh: （这里的东西全烧光了：干草、果园、鸡舍。只有那座房子还立着。）

text.en: (There are marks in the ash, each one longer than an arm. Something with claws made them.)
text.zh: （灰烬里有几道印子，每一道都比胳膊还长，是爪子抓出来的。）

text.en: (Emberfall. Half its roofs are new thatch; the rest are still black.)
text.zh: （余烬镇。一半的屋顶铺着新茅草，另一半还是焦黑的。）

text.en: You came up the Sunrise Road. Then you saw the farm.
text.zh: 你是从朝阳大道上来的。那你看见那座农庄了。

text.en: A dragon nests on Cinder Peak, up the pass east of here. It comes down every spring. This spring it has come down twice.
text.zh: 顺着镇东的山道上去，烬峰上住着一头魔龙。它每年春天下山一回。今年春天，它已经下来两回了。

text.en: Garrick the smith has a pattern for a blade that can cut its hide. He needs iron and coal from the Embervein Mine.
text.zh: 铁匠加里克手上有一张剑的图样，打出来能砍穿龙皮。他缺铁和煤，烬脉旧矿里有。

text.en: And Wren, our herbalist, knows a draught against fire. Bring them what they ask for. And take this bread with you.
text.zh: 我们的草药师雷恩会熬一种防火的药。他们要什么，你就给他们带去。这些面包你也拿上。

text.en: (Dragonsbane at my side, the draughts in my pack. The pass east of the village climbs to Cinder Peak.)
text.zh: （屠龙剑在身侧，药剂在行囊里。镇东的山道一直通到烬峰。）

text.en: (Heat, and the smell of scorched stone. Something vast breathes in the dark.)
text.zh: （一股热浪，还有烧焦石头的气味。有个庞然大物在黑暗里呼吸。）

text.en: (It is over. The fire in the lair is going out.)
text.zh: （结束了。巢穴里的火正在熄灭。）

card.en:
THE DRAGON OF CINDER PEAK

The dragon is dead.
Emberfall will sleep tonight, and the road east is open.

Everything the world learned from you is in the Threadbook (J).
card.zh:
烬峰魔龙

魔龙死了。
今夜余烬镇可以安睡，东边的路也通了。

世界从你身上学到的一切，都记在织线簿里（J）。

text.en: Hesper's ferry is mended with a rope: while the winch is broken, a rope must exist somewhere at the ford.
text.zh: 赫斯珀的渡船要靠一根绳子来修：绞盘没修好之前，渡口总得有一根绳子。

text.en: That was my last good rope. ...No, wait. There's the old one off the raft. It's frayed, but it'll splice.
text.zh: 那是我最后一根好绳子。……不对，筏子上还拆下来一根旧的。磨毛了，接一接还能用。

text.en: There must always be some way across the river: rope for the ferry, the dead tree to fell, or frost to freeze the water.
text.zh: 过河总得有条路：修渡船的绳子、能砍倒的枯树，或者能冻住河水的寒气。

text.en: The water's going down. Come on, I'll pole you over on the raft myself, line or no line.
text.zh: 水退下去了。来吧，有没有渡绳都一样，我自己撑筏子送你过去。
